20581.label: Ezekiel 1:1
20581.text: In the 30th year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiled people by the river Cheʹbar, the heavens were opened and I began to see visions of God.

20582.label: Ezekiel 1:2
20582.text: On the fifth day of the month—that is, in the fifth year of the exile of King Je·hoiʹa·chin —

20583.label: Ezekiel 1:3
20583.text: the word of Jehovah came to Ezekiel son of Buʹzi the priest by the river Cheʹbar in the land of the Chal·deʹans. There the hand of Jehovah came upon him.

20584.label: Ezekiel 1:4
20584.text: As I was looking, I saw a tempestuous wind coming from the north, and there was a huge cloud and flashing fire surrounded by a bright light, and from the midst of the fire was something that looked like electrum.

20585.label: Ezekiel 1:5
20585.text: Within it were what looked like four living creatures, and the appearance of each one was like that of a human.

20586.label: Ezekiel 1:6
20586.text: Each one had four faces and four wings.

20587.label: Ezekiel 1:7
20587.text: Their feet were straight, and the soles of their feet were like those of a calf, and they were shining like the glow of burnished copper.

20588.label: Ezekiel 1:8
20588.text: They had human hands under their wings on all four sides, and the four of them had faces and wings.

20589.label: Ezekiel 1:9
20589.text: Their wings were touching one another. They would not turn when they went; they would each go straight forward.

20590.label: Ezekiel 1:10
20590.text: Their faces had this appearance: Each of the four had a man’s face with a lion’s face on the right, a bull’s face on the left, and each of the four had an eagle’s face.

20591.label: Ezekiel 1:11
20591.text: That is how their faces were. Their wings were spread out above them. Each had two wings that were touching one another and two wings covering their bodies.

20592.label: Ezekiel 1:12
20592.text: They would each go straight forward, going wherever the spirit would incline them to go. They would not turn as they went.

20593.label: Ezekiel 1:13
20593.text: And the living creatures had the appearance of burning coals of fire, and something that looked like torches of bright fire was moving back and forth between the living creatures, and lightning was flashing out from the fire.

20594.label: Ezekiel 1:14
20594.text: And when the living creatures would go forth and return, their movement had the appearance of flashes of lightning.

20595.label: Ezekiel 1:15
20595.text: As I was watching the living creatures, I saw one wheel on the earth beside each of the living creatures with four faces.

20596.label: Ezekiel 1:16
20596.text: The wheels and their structure appeared to glow like chrysʹo·lite, and the four of them looked alike. Their appearance and structure looked as though a wheel were within a wheel.

20597.label: Ezekiel 1:17
20597.text: When they moved, they could go in any of the four directions without turning as they went.

20598.label: Ezekiel 1:18
20598.text: Their rims were so high that they inspired awe, and the rims of all four were full of eyes all around.

20599.label: Ezekiel 1:19
20599.text: Whenever the living creatures moved, the wheels would move along with them, and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels would also be lifted up.

20600.label: Ezekiel 1:20
20600.text: They would go where the spirit inclined them to go, wherever the spirit went. The wheels would be lifted up together with them, for the spirit operating on the living creatures was also in the wheels.

20601.label: Ezekiel 1:21
20601.text: When they moved, these would move; and when they stood still, these would stand still; and when they were lifted up from the earth, the wheels would be lifted up together with them, for the spirit operating on the living creatures was also in the wheels.

20602.label: Ezekiel 1:22
20602.text: Over the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an expanse that sparkled like awesome ice, stretched out above their heads.

20603.label: Ezekiel 1:23
20603.text: Under the expanse their wings were straight, one to the other. Each one had two wings for covering one side of their bodies and two for covering the other side.

20604.label: Ezekiel 1:24
20604.text: When I heard the sound of their wings, it was like a sound of rushing waters, like the sound of the Almighty. When they moved, it was like the sound of an army. When they stood still, they would let their wings down.

20605.label: Ezekiel 1:25
20605.text: There was a voice above the expanse over their heads. (When they stood still, they would let their wings down.)

20606.label: Ezekiel 1:26
20606.text: Above the expanse that was over their heads was what looked like a sapphire stone, and it resembled a throne. Sitting on the throne up above was someone whose appearance resembled that of a human.

20607.label: Ezekiel 1:27
20607.text: I saw something glowing like electrum that was like a fire radiating from what appeared to be his waist and upward; and from his waist down, I saw something that resembled fire. There was a brilliance all around him

20608.label: Ezekiel 1:28
20608.text: like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. That was how the surrounding brilliant light appeared. It was like the appearance of the glory of Jehovah. When I saw it, I fell facedown and began to hear the voice of someone speaking.

20609.label: Ezekiel 2:1
20609.text: He then said to me: “Son of man, stand up on your feet that I may speak with you.”

20610.label: Ezekiel 2:2
20610.text: When he spoke to me, spirit came into me and made me stand up on my feet so that I could hear the One speaking to me.

20611.label: Ezekiel 2:3
20611.text: He went on to say to me: “Son of man, I am sending you to the people of Israel, to rebellious nations that have rebelled against me. They and their forefathers have transgressed against me down to this very day.

20612.label: Ezekiel 2:4
20612.text: I am sending you to sons who are defiant and hardhearted, and you must say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says.’

20613.label: Ezekiel 2:5
20613.text: As for them, whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house —they will certainly know that a prophet was among them.

20614.label: Ezekiel 2:6
20614.text: “But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them, and do not be afraid of their words, although you are surrounded by briars and thorns and are dwelling among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words, and do not be terrified by their faces, for they are a rebellious house.

20615.label: Ezekiel 2:7
20615.text: You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or not, for they are a rebellious people.

20616.label: Ezekiel 2:8
20616.text: “But you, son of man, listen to what I am telling you. Do not become rebellious like this rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I am giving you.”

20617.label: Ezekiel 2:9
20617.text: When I looked, I saw a hand stretched out to me, and in it I saw a written scroll.

20618.label: Ezekiel 2:10
20618.text: When he spread it out before me, it had writing on both front and back. Dirges and mourning and wailing were written on it.

20619.label: Ezekiel 3:1
20619.text: Then he said to me: “Son of man, eat what is before you. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

20620.label: Ezekiel 3:2
20620.text: So I opened my mouth, and he made me eat this scroll.

20621.label: Ezekiel 3:3
20621.text: He went on to say to me: “Son of man, eat this scroll that I am giving you, and fill your stomach with it.” So I began to eat it, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

20622.label: Ezekiel 3:4
20622.text: He said to me: “Son of man, go in among the house of Israel and speak my words to them.

20623.label: Ezekiel 3:5
20623.text: For you are not being sent to a people who speak an unintelligible language or an unknown tongue, but to the house of Israel.

20624.label: Ezekiel 3:6
20624.text: You are not being sent to many peoples speaking an unintelligible language or an unknown tongue, whose words you cannot understand. If I would send you to them, they would listen to you.

20625.label: Ezekiel 3:7
20625.text: But the house of Israel will refuse to listen to you, for they do not want to listen to me. All those of the house of Israel are hardheaded and hardhearted.

20626.label: Ezekiel 3:8
20626.text: Look! I have made your face exactly as hard as their faces and your forehead exactly as hard as their foreheads.

20627.label: Ezekiel 3:9
20627.text: I have made your forehead like a diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or be terrified by their faces, for they are a rebellious house.”

20628.label: Ezekiel 3:10
20628.text: He went on to say to me: “Son of man, take to heart and listen to all my words that I speak to you.

20629.label: Ezekiel 3:11
20629.text: Go in among the exiles of your people and speak to them. Tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”

20630.label: Ezekiel 3:12
20630.text: A spirit then carried me along and I heard behind me a great rumbling sound that said: “May the glory of Jehovah be praised from his place.”

20631.label: Ezekiel 3:13
20631.text: There was the sound of the wings of the living creatures as they were brushing against one another, and the sound of the wheels next to them, and the sound of a great rumbling.

20632.label: Ezekiel 3:14
20632.text: And the spirit carried me along and took me, and I went in bitterness and in the rage of my spirit, and the hand of Jehovah rested strongly on me.

20633.label: Ezekiel 3:15
20633.text: So I went to the exiled people at Tel-aʹbib, who were dwelling by the river Cheʹbar, and I stayed there where they were dwelling; and in a dazed condition, I stayed among them for seven days.

20634.label: Ezekiel 3:16
20634.text: At the end of seven days the word of Jehovah came to me:

20635.label: Ezekiel 3:17
20635.text: “Son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman to the house of Israel; and when you hear a word from my mouth, you must warn them from me.

20636.label: Ezekiel 3:18
20636.text: When I say to someone wicked, ‘You will surely die,’ but you do not warn him, and you fail to speak in order to warn the wicked one to turn from his wicked course so that he may stay alive, he will die for his error because he is wicked, but I will ask his blood back from you.

20637.label: Ezekiel 3:19
20637.text: But if you warn someone wicked and he does not turn back from his wickedness and from his wicked course, he will die for his error, but you will certainly save your own life.

20638.label: Ezekiel 3:20
20638.text: But when someone righteous abandons his righteousness and does what is wrong, I will put a stumbling block before him and he will die. If you did not warn him, he will die for his sin and his righteous acts will not be remembered, but I will ask his blood back from you.

20639.label: Ezekiel 3:21
20639.text: But if you have warned the righteous one not to sin, and he does not sin, he will surely keep alive because he was warned, and you will have saved your own life.”

20640.label: Ezekiel 3:22
20640.text: The hand of Jehovah came upon me there, and he said to me: “Get up, go to the valley plain, and I will speak with you there.”

20641.label: Ezekiel 3:23
20641.text: So I got up and went to the valley plain, and look! the glory of Jehovah was there, like the glory that I saw by the river Cheʹbar, and I fell facedown.

20642.label: Ezekiel 3:24
20642.text: Then spirit entered into me and made me stand up on my feet, and he spoke to me and said: “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

20643.label: Ezekiel 3:25
20643.text: As for you, son of man, they will put ropes on you and tie you with them so that you cannot go out among them.

20644.label: Ezekiel 3:26
20644.text: And I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, and you will become mute, unable to reprove them, because they are a rebellious house.

20645.label: Ezekiel 3:27
20645.text: But when I speak with you I will open your mouth, and you must say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says.’ Let the one listening listen, and let the one refusing to listen refuse, because they are a rebellious house.

20646.label: Ezekiel 4:1
20646.text: “And you, son of man, take a brick and put it in front of you. Engrave on it a city—Jerusalem.

20647.label: Ezekiel 4:2
20647.text: Lay siege to it, build a siege wall against it, raise up a siege rampart against it, set up camps against it, and surround it with battering rams.

20648.label: Ezekiel 4:3
20648.text: Take an iron griddle and place it as an iron wall between you and the city. Then set your face against it, and it will be under siege; you are to besiege it. This is a sign to the house of Israel.

20649.label: Ezekiel 4:4
20649.text: “Then you should lie on your left side and lay the guilt of the house of Israel on yourself. You will carry their guilt for the number of days that you lie on your side.

20650.label: Ezekiel 4:5
20650.text: And I will impose on you 390 days, corresponding to the years of their guilt, and you will carry the guilt of the house of Israel.

20651.label: Ezekiel 4:6
20651.text: And you must complete them. “Then for a second time you will lie down, on your right side, and you will carry the guilt of the house of Judah for 40 days. A day for a year, a day for a year, is what I have given you.

20652.label: Ezekiel 4:7
20652.text: And you will turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and you must prophesy against it.

20653.label: Ezekiel 4:8
20653.text: “Look! I will tie you with ropes so that you cannot turn from your one side to your other side until you have completed the days of your siege.

20654.label: Ezekiel 4:9
20654.text: “And you should take wheat, barley, broad beans, lentils, millet, and spelt and put them in one container and make them into bread for yourself. For the number of the days that you are lying on your side, 390 days, you will eat it.

20655.label: Ezekiel 4:10
20655.text: You will weigh out and eat 20 shekels of food per day. You will eat it at set times.

20656.label: Ezekiel 4:11
20656.text: “And you will drink water by measure, a sixth of a hin. You will drink it at set times.

20657.label: Ezekiel 4:12
20657.text: “You will eat it as you would a round barley loaf; you will bake it before their eyes, using dried human excrement as fuel.”

20658.label: Ezekiel 4:13
20658.text: Jehovah went on to say: “This is how the Israelites will eat their bread—unclean—among the nations where I will disperse them.”

20659.label: Ezekiel 4:14
20659.text: I then said: “Not that, Sovereign Lord Jehovah! From my youth until now, I have not been defiled by eating meat from an animal found dead or a torn animal, and no unclean meat has entered my mouth.”

20660.label: Ezekiel 4:15
20660.text: So he said to me: “All right, I will allow you to use cattle manure instead of human excrement, and you will bake your bread over it.”

20661.label: Ezekiel 4:16
20661.text: He then said to me: “Son of man, here I am cutting off the food supply in Jerusalem, and with great anxiety they will eat their bread ration by weight, and in horror they will drink their water ration by measure.

20662.label: Ezekiel 4:17
20662.text: This will happen so that lacking bread and water, they may look in shock at one another and waste away because of their error.

20663.label: Ezekiel 5:1
20663.text: “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword for yourself to use as a barber’s razor. Shave your head and your beard, and then take scales to weigh and divide the hair into portions.

20664.label: Ezekiel 5:2
20664.text: You will burn a third of it in the fire inside the city when the days of the siege are completed. Then you will take another third and strike it with the sword all around the city, and the last third you will scatter to the wind, and I will draw a sword to chase after them.

20665.label: Ezekiel 5:3
20665.text: “You must also take a few strands of them and wrap them up in the folds of your garment.

20666.label: Ezekiel 5:4
20666.text: And take some more of them and throw them into the fire and incinerate them. From this a fire will spread to all the house of Israel.

20667.label: Ezekiel 5:5
20667.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, with lands all around her.

20668.label: Ezekiel 5:6
20668.text: But she has rebelled against my judicial decisions and my statutes, acting more wickedly than the nations and the lands all around her. For they have rejected my judicial decisions, and they did not walk in my statutes.’

20669.label: Ezekiel 5:7
20669.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because you were more troublesome than the nations all around you and you did not walk in my statutes or carry out my judicial decisions but, instead, you followed the judicial decisions of the nations all around you,

20670.label: Ezekiel 5:8
20670.text: this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am against you, O city, and I myself will execute judgment in your midst before the eyes of the nations.

20671.label: Ezekiel 5:9
20671.text: I will do in you what I have never done before, and the likes of which I will not do again, because of all your detestable practices.

20672.label: Ezekiel 5:10
20672.text: “‘“So fathers among you will eat their sons, and sons will eat their fathers, and I will execute judgment among you and scatter all the rest of you in every direction.”’

20673.label: Ezekiel 5:11
20673.text: “‘Therefore as surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘because it was my sanctuary that you defiled with all your disgusting idols and with all your detestable practices, I will also reject you; my eye will not feel sorry, and I will show no compassion.

20674.label: Ezekiel 5:12
20674.text: A third of you will die by the pestilence or perish in your midst by famine. Another third will fall all around you by the sword. And I will scatter the last third in every direction, and I will draw a sword to chase after them.

20675.label: Ezekiel 5:13
20675.text: Then my anger will come to an end, and my wrath against them will subside, and I will be satisfied. And they will have to know that I, Jehovah, have spoken in my insistence on exclusive devotion, when I have finished unleashing my wrath against them.

20676.label: Ezekiel 5:14
20676.text: “‘I will make you a devastated place and an object of reproach among the surrounding nations and in the eyes of everyone passing by.

20677.label: Ezekiel 5:15
20677.text: You will become an object of reproach and scorn, a warning example and a horror to the nations around you, when I execute judgment on you in anger and in wrath and with furious punishments. I, Jehovah, have spoken.

20678.label: Ezekiel 5:16
20678.text: “‘I will send against them the deadly arrows of famine to destroy them. The arrows that I send will bring you to ruin. I will make the famine worse for you by cutting off your food supply.

20679.label: Ezekiel 5:17
20679.text: I will send against you famine and vicious wild beasts, and they will bereave you of children. Pestilence and bloodshed will overwhelm you, and I will bring a sword against you. I, Jehovah, have spoken.’”

20680.label: Ezekiel 6:1
20680.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20681.label: Ezekiel 6:2
20681.text: “Son of man, turn your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.

20682.label: Ezekiel 6:3
20682.text: You must say, ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says to the mountains, to the hills, to the streams, and to the valleys: “Look! I will bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.

20683.label: Ezekiel 6:4
20683.text: Your altars will be demolished, your incense stands will be broken, and I will throw your slain ones down before your disgusting idols.

20684.label: Ezekiel 6:5
20684.text: I will throw the carcasses of the people of Israel before their disgusting idols, and I will scatter your bones all around your altars.

20685.label: Ezekiel 6:6
20685.text: In all the places where you dwell, the cities will be devastated and the high places will be demolished and will lie devastated. Your altars will be demolished and shattered, your disgusting idols will perish, your incense stands will be cut down, and your works will be wiped out.

20686.label: Ezekiel 6:7
20686.text: And those slain will fall in your midst, and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.

20687.label: Ezekiel 6:8
20687.text: “‘“But I will leave a remnant, for some of you will escape the sword among the nations when you are scattered throughout the lands.

20688.label: Ezekiel 6:9
20688.text: And those who escape will remember me among the nations where they are taken captive. They will realize that I was brokenhearted over their unfaithful heart that turned away from me and at their eyes that are lusting after their disgusting idols. They will be ashamed of and loathe all the evil and detestable things they have done.

20689.label: Ezekiel 6:10
20689.text: They will have to know that I am Jehovah and that my threats to bring this calamity on them were not empty.”’

20690.label: Ezekiel 6:11
20690.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Clap your hands and stamp your foot and bemoan all the evil and detestable things done by the house of Israel, for they will fall by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.

20691.label: Ezekiel 6:12
20691.text: The one far away will die by pestilence, the one nearby will fall by the sword, and whoever escapes these and is left remaining will die by famine; and I will fully unleash my wrath against them.

20692.label: Ezekiel 6:13
20692.text: And you will have to know that I am Jehovah, when their slain lie among their disgusting idols, all around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, under every luxuriant tree, and under the branches of big trees where they have made fragrant offerings to appease all their disgusting idols.

20693.label: Ezekiel 6:14
20693.text: I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land desolate, and all their dwelling places will become more desolate than the wilderness near Dibʹlah. And they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

20694.label: Ezekiel 7:1
20694.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20695.label: Ezekiel 7:2
20695.text: “As for you, son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says to the land of Israel: ‘An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.

20696.label: Ezekiel 7:3
20696.text: The end is now upon you, and I will unleash my anger against you, and I will judge you according to your ways and call you to account for all your detestable deeds.

20697.label: Ezekiel 7:4
20697.text: My eye will not feel sorry for you; nor will I feel compassion, for I will bring upon you the results of your own ways, and you will suffer the consequences of your detestable deeds. And you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

20698.label: Ezekiel 7:5
20698.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Look! A calamity, a unique calamity, is coming.

20699.label: Ezekiel 7:6
20699.text: An end is coming; the end will come; it will rouse itself against you. Look! It is coming.

20700.label: Ezekiel 7:7
20700.text: Your turn has come, you who inhabit the land. The time is coming, the day is near. There is confusion and not joyful shouting on the mountains.

20701.label: Ezekiel 7:8
20701.text: “‘Very soon I will pour out my rage on you, and I will fully unleash my anger against you, and I will judge you according to your ways and call you to account for all your detestable deeds.

20702.label: Ezekiel 7:9
20702.text: My eye will not feel sorry; nor will I feel compassion. I will bring on you the results of your ways, and you will suffer the consequences of your own detestable deeds. And you will have to know that I, Jehovah, am striking you.

20703.label: Ezekiel 7:10
20703.text: “‘Look, the day! Look, it is coming! Your turn has come; the rod has blossomed and presumptuousness has sprouted.

20704.label: Ezekiel 7:11
20704.text: Violence has grown into a rod of wickedness. Neither they nor their wealth nor their crowds nor their prominence will survive.

20705.label: Ezekiel 7:12
20705.text: The time will come, the day will arrive. Let the buyer not rejoice, and let the seller not mourn, for there is wrath against their whole crowd.

20706.label: Ezekiel 7:13
20706.text: For the seller will not return to what was sold, even if his life is spared, for the vision is against the entire multitude. No one will return, and because of his error, no one will preserve his life.

20707.label: Ezekiel 7:14
20707.text: “‘They have blown the trumpet, and everyone is ready, but no one is going to the battle, because my wrath is against the whole multitude.

20708.label: Ezekiel 7:15
20708.text: The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine are inside. Whoever is in the field will die by the sword, and famine and pestilence will consume those in the city.

20709.label: Ezekiel 7:16
20709.text: Their survivors who manage to escape will go to the mountains, and like the doves of the valleys, each one will moan over his error.

20710.label: Ezekiel 7:17
20710.text: All their hands will hang limp, and all their knees will drip with water.

20711.label: Ezekiel 7:18
20711.text: They have put on sackcloth, and shuddering has seized them. Everyone will be put to shame, and every head will be bald.

20712.label: Ezekiel 7:19
20712.text: “‘They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will become abhorrent to them. Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them in the day of Jehovah’s fury. They will not be satisfied, nor will they fill their stomachs, for it has become a stumbling block causing their error.

20713.label: Ezekiel 7:20
20713.text: They took pride in the beauty of their ornaments, and they made with them their detestable images, their disgusting idols. That is why I will make it an abhorrent thing to them.

20714.label: Ezekiel 7:21
20714.text: I will give it into the hand of the foreigners for plunder and to the wicked ones of the earth for spoil, and they will profane it.

20715.label: Ezekiel 7:22
20715.text: “‘I will turn my face away from them, and they will profane my concealed place, and robbers will enter it and profane it.

20716.label: Ezekiel 7:23
20716.text: “‘Make the chain, for the land is full of bloodstained judgment and the city is full of violence.

20717.label: Ezekiel 7:24
20717.text: I will bring in the worst of the nations, and they will take possession of their houses, and I will put an end to the pride of the strong ones, and their sanctuaries will be profaned.

20718.label: Ezekiel 7:25
20718.text: When their anguish comes, they will seek peace, but there will be none.

20719.label: Ezekiel 7:26
20719.text: There will come disaster upon disaster, and one report after another, and people will seek a vision from a prophet, but the law will perish from a priest and advice from the elders.

20720.label: Ezekiel 7:27
20720.text: The king will go into mourning, and the chieftain will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble in terror. I will treat them according to their ways, and I will judge them as they have judged. And they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

20721.label: Ezekiel 8:1
20721.text: And in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, when I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, the hand of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah took hold of me there.

20722.label: Ezekiel 8:2
20722.text: As I watched, I saw a form similar to the appearance of fire; there was fire below what appeared to be his waist, and from his waist upward his appearance was bright, like the glow of electrum.

20723.label: Ezekiel 8:3
20723.text: Then he stretched out what appeared to be a hand and took me by a tuft of hair of my head, and a spirit carried me between the earth and the heavens and brought me to Jerusalem by means of the visions from God, to the entrance of the inner gate that faces north, where the idolatrous symbol of jealousy that incites jealousy stood.

20724.label: Ezekiel 8:4
20724.text: And look! the glory of the God of Israel was there, like the appearance that I had seen in the valley plain.

20725.label: Ezekiel 8:5
20725.text: He then said to me: “Son of man, please raise your eyes toward the north.” So I raised my eyes toward the north, and there, north of the gate of the altar, was this symbol of jealousy in the entryway.

20726.label: Ezekiel 8:6
20726.text: And he said to me: “Son of man, do you see what terrible, detestable things the house of Israel is doing here, things that make me go far away from my sanctuary? But you will see detestable things that are even more terrible.”

20727.label: Ezekiel 8:7
20727.text: Then he brought me to the entrance of the courtyard, and when I looked, I saw a hole in the wall.

20728.label: Ezekiel 8:8
20728.text: He said to me: “Son of man, please bore through the wall.” So I bored through the wall, and I saw an entryway.

20729.label: Ezekiel 8:9
20729.text: He said to me: “Go in and see the evil, detestable things that they are doing here.”

20730.label: Ezekiel 8:10
20730.text: So I went in and looked, and I saw all sorts of images of creeping things and loathsome beasts and all the disgusting idols of the house of Israel; they were carved on the wall all around.

20731.label: Ezekiel 8:11
20731.text: And 70 of the elders of the house of Israel were standing before them, with Ja·az·a·niʹah the son of Shaʹphan standing among them. Each one had his censer in his hand, and the perfumed cloud of incense was ascending.

20732.label: Ezekiel 8:12
20732.text: He said to me: “Son of man, do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each one in the inner rooms where his idols are displayed? For they are saying, ‘Jehovah is not seeing us. Jehovah has left the land.’”

20733.label: Ezekiel 8:13
20733.text: And he went on to say to me: “You will see detestable things that are even more terrible that they are doing.”

20734.label: Ezekiel 8:14
20734.text: So he brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of Jehovah, and there I saw women sitting and weeping over the god Tamʹmuz.

20735.label: Ezekiel 8:15
20735.text: And he further said to me: “Do you see this, O son of man? You will see detestable things that are even more terrible than these.”

20736.label: Ezekiel 8:16
20736.text: So he brought me to the inner courtyard of the house of Jehovah. There at the entrance of the temple of Jehovah, between the porch and the altar, were about 25 men with their backs to the temple of Jehovah and their faces to the east; they were bowing down to the sun in the east.

20737.label: Ezekiel 8:17
20737.text: He said to me: “Son of man, do you see this? Is it a trivial thing for the house of Judah to do these detestable things, to fill the land with violence and keep offending me? Here they are thrusting out the branch to my nose.

20738.label: Ezekiel 8:18
20738.text: So I will act in rage. My eye will not feel sorry; nor will I feel compassion. Even though they cry out loudly in my ears, I will not hear them.”

20739.label: Ezekiel 9:1
20739.text: He then called out in my ears with a loud voice, saying: “Summon those who will bring punishment on the city, each one with his weapon for destruction in his hand!”

20740.label: Ezekiel 9:2
20740.text: I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate that faces north, each with his weapon for smashing in his hand; and there was one man among them clothed in linen, with a secretary’s inkhorn at his waist, and they came in and stood beside the copper altar.

20741.label: Ezekiel 9:3
20741.text: Then the glory of the God of Israel rose from where it had rested above the cherubs and moved to the threshold of the doorway of the house, and he began calling out to the man who was clothed in linen, at whose waist was the secretary’s inkhorn.

20742.label: Ezekiel 9:4
20742.text: Jehovah said to him: “Go through the city, through Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of the men who are sighing and groaning over all the detestable things that are being done in the city.”

20743.label: Ezekiel 9:5
20743.text: And to the others he said in my hearing: “Go through the city after him and strike. Do not let your eye feel sorry, and do not feel any compassion.

20744.label: Ezekiel 9:6
20744.text: Old man, young man, virgin, little child, and women you should kill off completely. But do not go near to any man on whom there is the mark. You should start from my sanctuary.” So they started with the elders who were in front of the house.

20745.label: Ezekiel 9:7
20745.text: Then he said to them: “Defile the house and fill the courtyards with the slain. Go!” So they went out and struck down people in the city.

20746.label: Ezekiel 9:8
20746.text: While they were striking them down, I alone was left, and I fell facedown and cried out: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Are you going to destroy all the remaining ones of Israel while you pour out your rage on Jerusalem?”

20747.label: Ezekiel 9:9
20747.text: So he said to me: “The error of the house of Israel and Judah is very, very great. The land is filled with bloodshed, and the city is full of corruption. For they say, ‘Jehovah has left the land, and Jehovah is not seeing.’

20748.label: Ezekiel 9:10
20748.text: But as for me, my eye will not feel sorry; nor will I show compassion. The consequences of their way I will bring down on their own head.”

20749.label: Ezekiel 9:11
20749.text: Then I saw the man clothed in linen with the inkhorn at his waist bringing back word, saying: “I have done just as you have commanded me.”

20750.label: Ezekiel 10:1
20750.text: As I was watching, I saw above the expanse that was over the heads of the cherubs something like a sapphire stone appearing above them, and its appearance resembled a throne.

20751.label: Ezekiel 10:2
20751.text: Then he said to the man clothed in linen: “Enter between the wheelwork, under the cherubs, and fill both your hands with burning coals from between the cherubs and toss them over the city.” So he entered as I watched.

20752.label: Ezekiel 10:3
20752.text: The cherubs were standing to the right of the house when the man entered, and the cloud filled the inner courtyard.

20753.label: Ezekiel 10:4
20753.text: And the glory of Jehovah rose up from the cherubs to the threshold of the doorway of the house, and the house gradually became filled with the cloud, and the courtyard was full of the brightness of the glory of Jehovah.

20754.label: Ezekiel 10:5
20754.text: And the sound of the wings of the cherubs could be heard in the outer courtyard, like the sound of God Almighty when he speaks.

20755.label: Ezekiel 10:6
20755.text: Then he commanded the man clothed in linen: “Take fire from between the wheelwork, from between the cherubs,” and he entered and stood beside the wheel.

20756.label: Ezekiel 10:7
20756.text: Then one of the cherubs stretched his hand out toward the fire that was between the cherubs. He took some and put it into both hands of the one clothed in linen, who now took it and went out.

20757.label: Ezekiel 10:8
20757.text: The cherubs had what looked like the form of human hands under their wings.

20758.label: Ezekiel 10:9
20758.text: As I was watching, I saw four wheels beside the cherubs, one wheel beside each cherub, and the wheels appeared to glow like chrysʹo·lite stone.

20759.label: Ezekiel 10:10
20759.text: As for their appearance, the four of them were alike, looking as though a wheel were within a wheel.

20760.label: Ezekiel 10:11
20760.text: When they moved, they could go in any of the four directions without turning, because they would go to the place where the head would face without turning.

20761.label: Ezekiel 10:12
20761.text: Their entire bodies, their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, the wheels of all four of them, were full of eyes all around.

20762.label: Ezekiel 10:13
20762.text: As regards the wheels, I heard a voice that called to them, “Wheelwork!”

20763.label: Ezekiel 10:14
20763.text: Each one had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub, the second face was the face of a man, the third was the face of a lion, and the fourth was the face of an eagle.

20764.label: Ezekiel 10:15
20764.text: And the cherubs would rise—they were the same living creatures that I had seen at the river Cheʹbar —

20765.label: Ezekiel 10:16
20765.text: and when the cherubs moved, the wheels would move alongside them; and when the cherubs lifted up their wings to be high above the earth, the wheels would not turn or move from their side.

20766.label: Ezekiel 10:17
20766.text: When these stood still, they would stand still; and when these rose, they would rise with them, for the spirit operating on the living creatures was in them.

20767.label: Ezekiel 10:18
20767.text: Then the glory of Jehovah departed from over the threshold of the doorway of the house and stood still over the cherubs.

20768.label: Ezekiel 10:19
20768.text: The cherubs now lifted up their wings and rose from the earth as I watched. The wheels were also alongside them when they departed. They stopped at the entrance of the eastern gate of the house of Jehovah, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

20769.label: Ezekiel 10:20
20769.text: These were the living creatures that I had seen under the God of Israel at the river Cheʹbar, so I came to know that they were cherubs.

20770.label: Ezekiel 10:21
20770.text: All four had four faces, four wings, and what appeared to be human hands under their wings.

20771.label: Ezekiel 10:22
20771.text: And the appearances of their faces were like the faces I had seen by the river Cheʹbar. They would each go straight forward.

20772.label: Ezekiel 11:1
20772.text: And a spirit lifted me up and brought me to the eastern gate of the house of Jehovah, the gate that faces east. There at the entrance of the gate I saw 25 men, and among them were Ja·az·a·niʹah the son of Azʹzur and Pel·a·tiʹah the son of Be·naiʹah, princes of the people.

20773.label: Ezekiel 11:2
20773.text: Then He said to me: “Son of man, these are the men who are scheming evil and giving wicked advice in this city.

20774.label: Ezekiel 11:3
20774.text: They are saying, ‘Is it not the time for building houses? The city is the cooking pot, and we are the flesh.’

20775.label: Ezekiel 11:4
20775.text: “So prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

20776.label: Ezekiel 11:5
20776.text: Then the spirit of Jehovah came upon me, and he said to me: “Say, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “What you have said is correct, O house of Israel, and I know what you are thinking.

20777.label: Ezekiel 11:6
20777.text: You have caused many to die in this city, and you have filled her streets with the dead.”’”

20778.label: Ezekiel 11:7
20778.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘The dead bodies that you have strewn about the city are the flesh, and the city is the cooking pot. But you yourselves will be taken out of it.’”

20779.label: Ezekiel 11:8
20779.text: “‘A sword you have feared, and a sword I will bring against you,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

20780.label: Ezekiel 11:9
20780.text: ‘I will bring you out of her and give you into the hand of foreigners and execute judgment on you.

20781.label: Ezekiel 11:10
20781.text: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you at the border of Israel, and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.

20782.label: Ezekiel 11:11
20782.text: The city will not be a cooking pot for you, and you will not be the flesh within it; I will judge you at the border of Israel,

20783.label: Ezekiel 11:12
20783.text: and you will have to know that I am Jehovah. For you did not walk in my regulations and carry out my judgments, but you have acted in harmony with the judgments of the nations around you.’”

20784.label: Ezekiel 11:13
20784.text: As soon as I prophesied, Pel·a·tiʹah the son of Be·naiʹah died, and I fell facedown and cried with a loud voice: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Are you going to exterminate the remaining ones of Israel?”

20785.label: Ezekiel 11:14
20785.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20786.label: Ezekiel 11:15
20786.text: “Son of man, your brothers, those of your brothers with the right of repurchase, along with the entire house of Israel, have been told by the inhabitants of Jerusalem, ‘Keep far away from Jehovah. The land is ours; it has been given to us as a possession.’

20787.label: Ezekiel 11:16
20787.text: Therefore say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Although I have removed them far away among the nations and I have scattered them among the lands, for a little while I will become a sanctuary for them in the lands to which they have gone.”’

20788.label: Ezekiel 11:17
20788.text: “Therefore say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I will also collect you from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

20789.label: Ezekiel 11:18
20789.text: And they will return there and remove from it all its disgusting things and detestable practices.

20790.label: Ezekiel 11:19
20790.text: And I will give them a unified heart, and I will put a new spirit in them; and I will remove the heart of stone from their bodies and give them a heart of flesh,

20791.label: Ezekiel 11:20
20791.text: in order that they may walk in my statutes and observe my judgments and obey them. Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.”’

20792.label: Ezekiel 11:21
20792.text: “‘“But as for those whose hearts are set to continue in their disgusting things and their detestable practices, I will bring the consequences of their way upon their head,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.’”

20793.label: Ezekiel 11:22
20793.text: The cherubs now lifted up their wings, and the wheels were close to them, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

20794.label: Ezekiel 11:23
20794.text: Then the glory of Jehovah ascended from the city and stopped over the mountain to the east of the city.

20795.label: Ezekiel 11:24
20795.text: A spirit then lifted me up—through a vision by the spirit of God—and brought me to the exiled people in Chal·deʹa. Then the vision that I had seen left me.

20796.label: Ezekiel 11:25
20796.text: And I began to tell the exiled people all the things that Jehovah had shown me.

20797.label: Ezekiel 12:1
20797.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20798.label: Ezekiel 12:2
20798.text: “Son of man, you are living in a rebellious house. They have eyes to see, but they do not see, and ears to hear, but they do not hear, for they are a rebellious house.

20799.label: Ezekiel 12:3
20799.text: As for you, son of man, prepare for yourself luggage for going into exile. Then, during the day while they are watching, you must go into exile. Go into exile from your home to another place while they are watching. Perhaps they will take notice, even though they are a rebellious house.

20800.label: Ezekiel 12:4
20800.text: Bring out your luggage packed for going into exile during the day while they are watching, and then in the evening while they are watching, you should leave like someone being taken into exile.

20801.label: Ezekiel 12:5
20801.text: “While they are watching, bore a hole in the wall, and carry your belongings out through it.

20802.label: Ezekiel 12:6
20802.text: While they are watching, put your belongings on your shoulder and carry them out in the darkness. Cover your face so that you cannot see the ground, for I am making you a sign to the house of Israel.”

20803.label: Ezekiel 12:7
20803.text: I did just as I was commanded. During the day I brought out my luggage as luggage for going into exile, and in the evening I bored a hole through the wall by hand. And when it was dark, I took out my belongings, carrying them on my shoulder right before their eyes.

20804.label: Ezekiel 12:8
20804.text: In the morning the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20805.label: Ezekiel 12:9
20805.text: “Son of man, did not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, ask you, ‘What are you doing?’

20806.label: Ezekiel 12:10
20806.text: Tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “This pronouncement concerns the chieftain in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel within the city.”’

20807.label: Ezekiel 12:11
20807.text: “Say, ‘I am a sign for you. Just as I have done, that is what will be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

20808.label: Ezekiel 12:12
20808.text: The chieftain who is among them will carry his belongings on his shoulder and leave in the darkness. He will bore a hole in the wall and carry his belongings out through it. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the ground.’

20809.label: Ezekiel 12:13
20809.text: I will cast my net over him, and he will be caught in my hunting net. Then I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chal·deʹans, but he will not see it; and there he will die.

20810.label: Ezekiel 12:14
20810.text: And all those around him, his helpers and his troops, I will scatter in every direction; and I will draw out a sword to chase after them.

20811.label: Ezekiel 12:15
20811.text: And they will have to know that I am Jehovah when I disperse them among the nations and I scatter them among the lands.

20812.label: Ezekiel 12:16
20812.text: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, so that they may tell about all their detestable practices among the nations where they will go; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.”

20813.label: Ezekiel 12:17
20813.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20814.label: Ezekiel 12:18
20814.text: “Son of man, you should eat your bread with trembling and drink your water with agitation and anxiety.

20815.label: Ezekiel 12:19
20815.text: Say to the people of the land, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says to the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water with horror, for their land will become completely desolate because of the violence of all those dwelling in it.

20816.label: Ezekiel 12:20
20816.text: The inhabited cities will be devastated, and the land will become a wasteland; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.”’”

20817.label: Ezekiel 12:21
20817.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20818.label: Ezekiel 12:22
20818.text: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in Israel that says, ‘The days go by, and every vision comes to nothing’?

20819.label: Ezekiel 12:23
20819.text: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I will cause this saying to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel.”’ But tell them, ‘The days are near, and every vision will take place.’

20820.label: Ezekiel 12:24
20820.text: For there will no longer be any false vision or flattering divination within the house of Israel.

20821.label: Ezekiel 12:25
20821.text: ‘“For I, Jehovah, will speak. Whatever word I speak will be done without any more delay. In your days, O rebellious house, I will say the word and carry it out,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.’”

20822.label: Ezekiel 12:26
20822.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20823.label: Ezekiel 12:27
20823.text: “Son of man, this is what the people of Israel are saying, ‘The vision that he sees is for a long time from now, and he is prophesying about the distant future.’

20824.label: Ezekiel 12:28
20824.text: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “‘None of my words will be delayed; whatever I say will be done,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”’”

20825.label: Ezekiel 13:1
20825.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20826.label: Ezekiel 13:2
20826.text: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, and say to those who fabricate their own prophecies, ‘Hear the word of Jehovah.

20827.label: Ezekiel 13:3
20827.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Woe to the stupid prophets, who follow their own spirit, when they have seen nothing!

20828.label: Ezekiel 13:4
20828.text: O Israel, your prophets have become like foxes among the ruins.

20829.label: Ezekiel 13:5
20829.text: You will not go to the broken places in the stone walls to rebuild them for the house of Israel, so that Israel may keep standing in the battle in the day of Jehovah.”

20830.label: Ezekiel 13:6
20830.text: “They have seen false visions and foretold a lie, those who are saying, ‘The word of Jehovah is,’ when Jehovah himself has not sent them, and they have waited for their word to come true.

20831.label: Ezekiel 13:7
20831.text: Is it not a false vision that you have seen and a lie that you have foretold when you say, ‘The word of Jehovah is,’ when I have not said anything?”’

20832.label: Ezekiel 13:8
20832.text: “‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “‘Because you have spoken what is false and your visions are a lie, I am against you,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20833.label: Ezekiel 13:9
20833.text: My hand is against the prophets whose visions are false and who foretell a lie. They will not be among the people with whom I confide; nor will they be written in the registry of the house of Israel; nor will they return to the land of Israel; and you will have to know that I am the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

20834.label: Ezekiel 13:10
20834.text: All of this is because they have led my people astray by saying, “There is peace!” when there is no peace. When a flimsy partition wall is built, they are plastering it with whitewash.’

20835.label: Ezekiel 13:11
20835.text: “Tell those plastering with whitewash that it will fall. A torrential downpour will come, hailstones will fall, and powerful windstorms will break it down.

20836.label: Ezekiel 13:12
20836.text: And when the wall falls you will be asked, ‘Where is your coating of plaster?’

20837.label: Ezekiel 13:13
20837.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘I will cause powerful windstorms to burst forth in my wrath, and a torrential downpour in my anger, and hailstones in destructive fury.

20838.label: Ezekiel 13:14
20838.text: I will tear down the wall that you plastered with whitewash and bring it down to the earth, and its foundation will be exposed. When the city falls, you will perish within her; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

20839.label: Ezekiel 13:15
20839.text: “‘When I fully unleash my wrath upon the wall and upon those who plastered it with whitewash, I will say to you: “The wall is no more, and those plastering it are no more.

20840.label: Ezekiel 13:16
20840.text: The prophets of Israel are gone, those who prophesy to Jerusalem and who see visions of peace for her, when there is no peace,”’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

20841.label: Ezekiel 13:17
20841.text: “As for you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who fabricate their own prophecies, and prophesy against them.

20842.label: Ezekiel 13:18
20842.text: Tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Woe to the women who sew together bands for all arms and make veils for heads of every size in order to hunt down people’s lives! Are you hunting for the lives of my people and trying to preserve your own lives?

20843.label: Ezekiel 13:19
20843.text: Will you profane me among my people for handfuls of barley and for scraps of bread, putting to death those who should not die and keeping alive those who should not live, doing so by your lies to my people, who listen to your lies?”’

20844.label: Ezekiel 13:20
20844.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Here I am against your bands, O women, which you use to hunt down people as though they were birds, and I will rip them from your arms and release those whom you are hunting down like birds.

20845.label: Ezekiel 13:21
20845.text: I will rip away your veils and rescue my people out of your hand, and they will no longer be something for you to catch in the hunt; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.

20846.label: Ezekiel 13:22
20846.text: For you have disheartened the righteous one with your falsehood when I was not causing him distress, and you have strengthened the hands of the wicked one, so that he does not turn back from his bad way and stay alive.

20847.label: Ezekiel 13:23
20847.text: Therefore, you women will no longer see false visions and practice divination; and I will rescue my people from your hand, and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

20848.label: Ezekiel 14:1
20848.text: And some of the elders of Israel came and sat down before me.

20849.label: Ezekiel 14:2
20849.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

20850.label: Ezekiel 14:3
20850.text: “Son of man, these men are determined to follow their disgusting idols, and they have set up a stumbling block that causes people to sin. Should I let them inquire of me?

20851.label: Ezekiel 14:4
20851.text: Now speak with them and tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “If an Israelite is determined to follow his disgusting idols and sets up a stumbling block causing people to sin and he then comes to inquire of a prophet, I, Jehovah, will answer him appropriately according to his many disgusting idols.

20852.label: Ezekiel 14:5
20852.text: For I will cause terror in the hearts of the house of Israel because they have all withdrawn from me and have gone after their disgusting idols.”’

20853.label: Ezekiel 14:6
20853.text: “So tell the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Come back and turn away from your disgusting idols and turn your faces away from all your detestable practices.

20854.label: Ezekiel 14:7
20854.text: For if any Israelite or foreign resident living in Israel separates himself from me and is determined to follow his disgusting idols and sets up a stumbling block that causes people to sin and then comes to inquire of my prophet, I, Jehovah, I will personally answer him.

20855.label: Ezekiel 14:8
20855.text: I will set my face against that man and make him a warning sign and a proverbial saying, and I will cut him off from my people; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.”’

20856.label: Ezekiel 14:9
20856.text: “‘But if the prophet is fooled and gives a response, it is I, Jehovah, who have fooled that prophet. I will then stretch out my hand against him and annihilate him from my people Israel.

20857.label: Ezekiel 14:10
20857.text: They will have to bear their guilt; the guilt of the inquirer will be the same as the guilt of the prophet,

20858.label: Ezekiel 14:11
20858.text: so that the house of Israel may stop wandering away from me and stop defiling themselves by all their transgressions. And they will be my people, and I will be their God,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20859.label: Ezekiel 14:12
20859.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20860.label: Ezekiel 14:13
20860.text: “Son of man, if a land sins against me by acting unfaithfully, I will stretch out my hand against it and destroy its food supply, and I will send famine upon it and cut off man and animal from it.”

20861.label: Ezekiel 14:14
20861.text: “‘Even if these three men—Noah, Daniel, and Job —were within it, they would be able to save only themselves because of their righteousness,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20862.label: Ezekiel 14:15
20862.text: “‘Or suppose I make vicious wild animals pass through the land and they depopulate it and make it a wasteland without anyone passing through because of the wild animals.

20863.label: Ezekiel 14:16
20863.text: As surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘even if these three men were in it, they would save neither their sons nor their daughters; they would save only themselves, and the land would become desolate.’”

20864.label: Ezekiel 14:17
20864.text: “‘Or suppose I bring a sword against that land and say: “Let a sword pass through the land,” and cut off from it both man and animal,

20865.label: Ezekiel 14:18
20865.text: even if these three men were in it, as surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘they would save neither their sons nor their daughters; they would save only themselves.’”

20866.label: Ezekiel 14:19
20866.text: “‘Or suppose I send a pestilence into that land and pour out my rage on it with bloodshed to cut off from it man and animal,

20867.label: Ezekiel 14:20
20867.text: even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, as surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘they would save neither their sons nor their daughters; they would save only themselves because of their righteousness.’”

20868.label: Ezekiel 14:21
20868.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘So it will be when I send my four punishments —sword, famine, vicious wild animal, and pestilence —against Jerusalem to cut off man and animal from it.

20869.label: Ezekiel 14:22
20869.text: However, some left in it will escape and be brought out, both sons and daughters. They are coming to you, and when you see their ways and their deeds, you will certainly be comforted over the calamity that I brought on Jerusalem, over everything that I did to it.’”

20870.label: Ezekiel 14:23
20870.text: “‘They will comfort you when you see their ways and their deeds, and you will know that it was not without cause that I did what I had to do to it,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20871.label: Ezekiel 15:1
20871.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20872.label: Ezekiel 15:2
20872.text: “Son of man, how does the wood of the vine compare with that of any other tree or branch from the trees of the forest?

20873.label: Ezekiel 15:3
20873.text: Can a pole from it be used to do work? Or do people make a peg from it to hang utensils on?

20874.label: Ezekiel 15:4
20874.text: Look! It is thrown into the fire for fuel, and the fire consumes both ends and scorches the middle. Is it now fit for any work?

20875.label: Ezekiel 15:5
20875.text: Even when it was whole, it could not be used for anything. How much less useful it will be when the fire has consumed and scorched it!”

20876.label: Ezekiel 15:6
20876.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Just like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given as fuel for the fire, so I will deal with the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

20877.label: Ezekiel 15:7
20877.text: I have set my face against them. They have escaped from the fire, but fire will consume them. And you will have to know that I am Jehovah when I set my face against them.’”

20878.label: Ezekiel 15:8
20878.text: “‘And I will make the land desolate because they have acted unfaithfully,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20879.label: Ezekiel 16:1
20879.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20880.label: Ezekiel 16:2
20880.text: “Son of man, make known to Jerusalem her detestable practices.

20881.label: Ezekiel 16:3
20881.text: You must say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth were in the land of the Caʹnaan·ite. Your father was an Amʹor·ite, and your mother was a Hitʹtite.

20882.label: Ezekiel 16:4
20882.text: As for your birth, on the day you were born, your umbilical cord was not cut, you were not washed in water to make you clean, you were not rubbed with salt, and you were not wrapped in cloths.

20883.label: Ezekiel 16:5
20883.text: No one pitied you enough to do any of these things. No one had compassion for you. Instead, you were thrown into the open field because you were hated on the day you were born.

20884.label: Ezekiel 16:6
20884.text: “‘“When I was passing by, I saw you kicking about in your own blood, and as you lay there in your blood, I said: ‘Keep living!’ Yes, I said to you lying there in your blood: ‘Keep living!’

20885.label: Ezekiel 16:7
20885.text: I made you a very great multitude, like plants sprouting in the field, and you grew up and developed and wore the finest ornaments. Your breasts became firm, and your hair grew; but you were still naked and exposed.”’

20886.label: Ezekiel 16:8
20886.text: “‘When I was passing by and saw you, I noticed that you were old enough for expressions of love. So I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness and made an oath and entered into a covenant with you,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘and you became mine.

20887.label: Ezekiel 16:9
20887.text: Furthermore, I washed you with water and rinsed away your blood and put oil on you.

20888.label: Ezekiel 16:10
20888.text: I then clothed you with an embroidered garment and gave you fine leather sandals and wrapped you in fine linen, and I clothed you with costly garments.

20889.label: Ezekiel 16:11
20889.text: I adorned you with ornaments and put bracelets on your hands and a necklace around your neck.

20890.label: Ezekiel 16:12
20890.text: I also put a ring in your nose and earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.

20891.label: Ezekiel 16:13
20891.text: You kept adorning yourself with gold and silver, and your clothing was fine linen, costly material, and an embroidered garment. Fine flour, honey, and oil were what you ate, and you grew to be extremely beautiful, and you became fit to be a queen.’”

20892.label: Ezekiel 16:14
20892.text: “‘Your fame began to spread among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect because my own splendor I placed upon you,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20893.label: Ezekiel 16:15
20893.text: “‘But you began to trust in your beauty, and you became a prostitute because of your fame. You lavished your acts of prostitution on everyone passing by, and your beauty became his.

20894.label: Ezekiel 16:16
20894.text: You took some of your garments and made colorful high places where you prostituted yourself —such things should not take place, nor should they ever happen.

20895.label: Ezekiel 16:17
20895.text: You also took your beautiful jewelry made from the gold and silver that I had given to you and you made for yourself male images and prostituted yourself with them.

20896.label: Ezekiel 16:18
20896.text: And you took your embroidered garments and covered them, and you offered them my oil and my incense.

20897.label: Ezekiel 16:19
20897.text: And the bread that I had given to you—made from fine flour, oil, and honey that I gave you to eat—you also offered to them as a pleasing aroma. That is exactly what happened,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20898.label: Ezekiel 16:20
20898.text: “‘You took your sons and your daughters whom you had borne to me, and you sacrificed these to idols to be devoured —have your acts of prostitution not gone far enough?

20899.label: Ezekiel 16:21
20899.text: You slaughtered my sons, and you offered them as sacrifices by making them pass through the fire.

20900.label: Ezekiel 16:22
20900.text: While engaging in all your detestable practices and acts of prostitution, you did not remember the days of your youth when you were naked and exposed, kicking about in your own blood.

20901.label: Ezekiel 16:23
20901.text: After all your evil, woe, woe to you,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

20902.label: Ezekiel 16:24
20902.text: ‘You built yourself a mound and made a high place for yourself in every public square.

20903.label: Ezekiel 16:25
20903.text: You built your high places at the most prominent place of every street, and you turned your beauty into something detestable by offering yourself to everyone passing by, and you multiplied your acts of prostitution.

20904.label: Ezekiel 16:26
20904.text: You prostituted yourself to the sons of Egypt, your lustful neighbors, and you offended me with your countless acts of prostitution.

20905.label: Ezekiel 16:27
20905.text: Now I will bring my hand against you and diminish your food allowance and give you over to the will of the women who hate you, the daughters of the Phi·lisʹtines, who were appalled because of your obscene conduct.

20906.label: Ezekiel 16:28
20906.text: “‘Because you could not be satisfied, you then prostituted yourself to the sons of As·syrʹi·a, but after prostituting yourself to them, you still did not find satisfaction.

20907.label: Ezekiel 16:29
20907.text: So you increased your prostitution toward the land of traders and toward the Chal·deʹans, but even then you did not find satisfaction.

20908.label: Ezekiel 16:30
20908.text: How sick your heart was,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘when you did all these things, behaving like a brazen prostitute!

20909.label: Ezekiel 16:31
20909.text: But when you built your mound at the most prominent place of every street and made your high place in every public square, you were not like a prostitute, because you refused any payment.

20910.label: Ezekiel 16:32
20910.text: You are an adulterous wife who takes strangers instead of her own husband!

20911.label: Ezekiel 16:33
20911.text: People give all prostitutes a gift, but you are the one who has given gifts to all those lusting after you, and you bribe them to come to you from all around to commit prostitution.

20912.label: Ezekiel 16:34
20912.text: You are the opposite of other women who engage in prostitution. No one commits prostitution your way! You pay others, and they do not pay you. Your way is the opposite.’

20913.label: Ezekiel 16:35
20913.text: “Therefore, O prostitute, hear the word of Jehovah.

20914.label: Ezekiel 16:36
20914.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because your lust has been poured out and your nakedness has been exposed during your prostitution with your lovers and all your detestable, disgusting idols to which you even sacrificed the blood of your sons,

20915.label: Ezekiel 16:37
20915.text: therefore I am collecting together all the lovers you have given pleasure to, all those you loved together with all those you hated. I will collect them together against you from all around and expose your nakedness to them, and they will see you completely naked.

20916.label: Ezekiel 16:38
20916.text: “‘And I will punish you with the judgments that adulteresses and women shedding blood deserve, and your blood will be shed in rage and jealousy.

20917.label: Ezekiel 16:39
20917.text: I will give you into their hand, and they will tear down your mounds, and your high places will be pulled down; and they will strip you of your garments and take your beautiful jewelry and leave you naked and exposed.

20918.label: Ezekiel 16:40
20918.text: They will bring against you a crowd, and they will stone you and will slaughter you with their swords.

20919.label: Ezekiel 16:41
20919.text: They will burn your houses with fire and execute judgment on you before the eyes of many women; and I will bring an end to your prostitution, and you will stop giving payment.

20920.label: Ezekiel 16:42
20920.text: I will satisfy my rage against you, and my indignation will turn away from you; and I will be calm and no longer feel offended.’

20921.label: Ezekiel 16:43
20921.text: “‘Because you did not remember the days of your youth and you have angered me by doing all these things, I will now bring the consequences of your ways on your own head,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘and you will no longer carry on your obscene conduct and all your detestable practices.

20922.label: Ezekiel 16:44
20922.text: “‘Look! Everyone who uses proverbs will apply this proverb to you: “Like mother, like daughter!”

20923.label: Ezekiel 16:45
20923.text: You are the daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children. And you are the sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hitʹtite, and your father was an Amʹor·ite.’”

20924.label: Ezekiel 16:46
20924.text: “‘Your older sister is Sa·marʹi·a, who is dwelling to the north of you with her daughters, and your younger sister, who is dwelling to the south of you, is Sodʹom with her daughters.

20925.label: Ezekiel 16:47
20925.text: Not only did you walk in their ways and follow their detestable practices, but in a short while you were even more corrupt in all your conduct than they were.

20926.label: Ezekiel 16:48
20926.text: As surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘Sodʹom your sister and her daughters have not done what you and your daughters have done.

20927.label: Ezekiel 16:49
20927.text: Look! This was the error of Sodʹom your sister: She and her daughters were proud and had an abundance of food and carefree tranquility; yet they did not support the afflicted and the poor.

20928.label: Ezekiel 16:50
20928.text: They remained haughty and carried on detestable practices in my sight, so I found it necessary to remove them.

20929.label: Ezekiel 16:51
20929.text: “‘Nor did Sa·marʹi·a commit even half as many sins as you did. You kept making your detestable practices abound more than they have, to the point that your sisters appeared righteous because of all your detestable practices.

20930.label: Ezekiel 16:52
20930.text: You must now bear your humiliation because you have justified the behavior of your sisters. On account of your sin of acting more detestably than they have, they are more righteous than you. So now, be ashamed and bear the humiliation of making your sisters appear righteous.’

20931.label: Ezekiel 16:53
20931.text: “‘And I will gather their captives, the captives of Sodʹom and her daughters and the captives of Sa·marʹi·a and her daughters; I will also gather your captives along with them,

20932.label: Ezekiel 16:54
20932.text: so that you may bear your humiliation; and you will feel humiliated because of what you have done by comforting them.

20933.label: Ezekiel 16:55
20933.text: Your own sisters, Sodʹom and her daughters, will return to their former state, and Sa·marʹi·a and her daughters will return to their former state, and you along with your own daughters will return to your former state.

20934.label: Ezekiel 16:56
20934.text: Sodʹom your sister was not worthy of your mention in the day of your pride,

20935.label: Ezekiel 16:57
20935.text: before your own wickedness was exposed. Now the daughters of Syria and her neighbors reproach you, and the daughters of the Phi·lisʹtines, those all around you, treat you with scorn.

20936.label: Ezekiel 16:58
20936.text: You will bear the consequences of your obscene conduct and your detestable practices,’ declares Jehovah.”

20937.label: Ezekiel 16:59
20937.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘I will now do with you just as you have done, for you despised the oath by breaking my covenant.

20938.label: Ezekiel 16:60
20938.text: But I myself will remember the covenant that I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish with you a permanent covenant.

20939.label: Ezekiel 16:61
20939.text: You will remember your behavior and feel humiliated when you welcome your sisters, those older than you as well as those younger than you, and I will give them to you as daughters, but not because of your covenant.’

20940.label: Ezekiel 16:62
20940.text: “‘And I myself will establish my covenant with you; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.

20941.label: Ezekiel 16:63
20941.text: Then you will remember and be too ashamed to open your mouth because of your humiliation, when I make an atonement for you despite all that you have done,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20942.label: Ezekiel 17:1
20942.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20943.label: Ezekiel 17:2
20943.text: “Son of man, tell a riddle and relate a proverb about the house of Israel.

20944.label: Ezekiel 17:3
20944.text: You must say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “The great eagle, with great wings, long pinions, and full, colorful plumage, came to Lebʹa·non and took the top of the cedar.

20945.label: Ezekiel 17:4
20945.text: He plucked off its topmost shoot and brought it to the land of traders and set it down in a city of traders.

20946.label: Ezekiel 17:5
20946.text: He then took some of the seed of the land and put it in a fertile field. He planted it like a willow by abundant waters.

20947.label: Ezekiel 17:6
20947.text: So it sprouted and became a low, sprawling vine with its foliage facing inward and its roots growing under it. Thus it became a vine and produced shoots and sent out branches.

20948.label: Ezekiel 17:7
20948.text: “‘“And there came another great eagle, with great wings and large pinions. This vine then stretched its roots eagerly toward him, away from the garden beds where it was planted, and it sent out its foliage toward him so that he would irrigate it.

20949.label: Ezekiel 17:8
20949.text: It had already been planted in a good field near abundant waters, in order to produce branches, to bear fruit, and to become a majestic vine.”’

20950.label: Ezekiel 17:9
20950.text: “Say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Will it prosper? Will someone not tear out its roots and make its fruit rot and cause its sprouts to wither? It will become so dry that neither a strong arm nor many people will be needed to pull it up by the roots.

20951.label: Ezekiel 17:10
20951.text: Although it is transplanted, will it prosper? Will it not dry up completely when the east wind blows on it? It will dry up in the garden bed where it sprouted.”’”

20952.label: Ezekiel 17:11
20952.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20953.label: Ezekiel 17:12
20953.text: “Please tell the rebellious house, ‘Do you not realize what these things mean?’ Say, ‘Look! The king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and took its king and its princes and brought them back with him to Babylon.

20954.label: Ezekiel 17:13
20954.text: Furthermore, he took one of the royal offspring and made a covenant with him and put him under an oath. Then he took away the prominent men of the land,

20955.label: Ezekiel 17:14
20955.text: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to rise up, so that only by keeping his covenant might it continue to exist.

20956.label: Ezekiel 17:15
20956.text: But the king finally rebelled against him by sending his messengers to Egypt to obtain horses and a large army from them. Will he succeed? Will the one doing these things escape punishment? Can he break the covenant and still escape?’

20957.label: Ezekiel 17:16
20957.text: “‘“As surely as I am alive,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, “he will die in Babylon, in the place where the king who made him king lives, the one whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke.

20958.label: Ezekiel 17:17
20958.text: And the great army and numerous troops of Pharʹaoh will be of no help in the war, when siege ramparts are raised and siege walls are built to destroy many lives.

20959.label: Ezekiel 17:18
20959.text: He has despised an oath and broken a covenant. Even though he gave his promise, he has done all these things, and he will not escape.”’

20960.label: Ezekiel 17:19
20960.text: “‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “As surely as I am alive, I will bring upon his head the consequences of despising my oath and breaking my covenant.

20961.label: Ezekiel 17:20
20961.text: I will cast my net over him, and he will be caught in my hunting net. I will bring him to Babylon and enter into judgment with him there because of the unfaithfulness he committed against me.

20962.label: Ezekiel 17:21
20962.text: All the fugitives of his troops will fall by the sword, and those remaining will be scattered in every direction. Then you will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have spoken.”’

20963.label: Ezekiel 17:22
20963.text: “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I will take a shoot from the top of the lofty cedar and plant it, from the top of its twigs I will pluck a tender shoot, and I myself will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

20964.label: Ezekiel 17:23
20964.text: On a high mountain of Israel I will plant it; and its branches will grow, and it will produce fruit and become a majestic cedar. And every kind of bird will live beneath it and reside in the shadow of its foliage.

20965.label: Ezekiel 17:24
20965.text: And all the trees of the field will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have brought down the high tree and exalted the low tree; I have dried up the green tree and made the dry tree blossom. I myself, Jehovah, have spoken and have done it.”’”

20966.label: Ezekiel 18:1
20966.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

20967.label: Ezekiel 18:2
20967.text: “What does this proverb that you quote in the land of Israel mean, ‘Fathers have eaten sour grapes, but the teeth of the sons are set on edge’?

20968.label: Ezekiel 18:3
20968.text: “‘As surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘you will not continue to quote this saying in Israel.

20969.label: Ezekiel 18:4
20969.text: Look! All the souls —to me they belong. As the soul of the father so also the soul of the son—to me they belong. The soul who sins is the one who will die.

20970.label: Ezekiel 18:5
20970.text: “‘Suppose that a man is righteous and does what is just and right.

20971.label: Ezekiel 18:6
20971.text: He does not eat idolatrous sacrifices on the mountains; he does not look up to the disgusting idols of the house of Israel; he does not defile his neighbor’s wife or have relations with a woman who is menstruating;

20972.label: Ezekiel 18:7
20972.text: he does not mistreat anyone, but he returns what a debtor has given him in pledge; he does not rob anyone, but he gives his own food to the hungry one and covers the naked one with a garment;

20973.label: Ezekiel 18:8
20973.text: he does not charge interest or engage in usury, but he refrains from acting with injustice; he executes true justice between one man and another;

20974.label: Ezekiel 18:9
20974.text: and he keeps walking in my statutes and observing my judicial decisions in order to act in faithfulness. Such a man is righteous and will surely keep living,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

20975.label: Ezekiel 18:10
20975.text: “‘But suppose that he has become father to a son who is a robber or a murderer or who does any of these other things

20976.label: Ezekiel 18:11
20976.text: (though the father has not done any of these things)—he eats idolatrous sacrifices on the mountains, defiles his neighbor’s wife,

20977.label: Ezekiel 18:12
20977.text: mistreats the needy and the poor, takes things by robbery, does not return a pledge, looks up to the disgusting idols, engages in detestable practices,

20978.label: Ezekiel 18:13
20978.text: engages in usury and charges interest —then the son will not keep living. Because of all these detestable things that he has done, he will surely be put to death. His own blood will be upon him.

20979.label: Ezekiel 18:14
20979.text: “‘But suppose that a father has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed, and though he sees them, he does not do such things.

20980.label: Ezekiel 18:15
