20980.text: He does not eat idolatrous sacrifices on the mountains; he does not look up to the disgusting idols of the house of Israel; he does not defile his neighbor’s wife;

20981.label: Ezekiel 18:16
20981.text: he does not mistreat anyone; he does not seize what was pledged; he does not take anything in robbery; he gives his own food to the hungry one and covers the naked one with a garment;

20982.label: Ezekiel 18:17
20982.text: he refrains from oppressing the poor; he does not engage in usury or charge interest; and he carries out my judicial decisions and walks in my statutes. Such a man will not die because of the error of his father. He will surely keep living.

20983.label: Ezekiel 18:18
20983.text: But because his father practiced fraud, robbed his brother, and did what was wrong among his people, he will die for his error.

20984.label: Ezekiel 18:19
20984.text: “‘But you will say: “Why does the son not bear guilt because of his father’s error?” Since the son has done what is just and righteous, has kept all my statutes and has observed them, he will surely keep living.

20985.label: Ezekiel 18:20
20985.text: The soul who sins is the one who will die. A son will bear no guilt because of the error of his father, and a father will bear no guilt because of the error of his son. The righteousness of the righteous one will be accounted to him alone, and the wickedness of the wicked one will be accounted to him alone.

20986.label: Ezekiel 18:21
20986.text: “‘Now if someone wicked turns away from all the sins he has committed and keeps my statutes and does what is just and righteous, he will surely keep living. He will not die.

20987.label: Ezekiel 18:22
20987.text: None of the transgressions that he has committed will be held against him. He will keep living for doing what is righteous.’

20988.label: Ezekiel 18:23
20988.text: “‘Do I take any pleasure at all in the death of a wicked person?’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. ‘Do I not prefer that he turn away from his ways and keep living?’

20989.label: Ezekiel 18:24
20989.text: “‘But when someone righteous abandons his righteousness and does what is wrong, doing all the detestable things the wicked do, will he live? None of the righteous acts that he did will be remembered. For his unfaithfulness and the sin he has committed, he will die.

20990.label: Ezekiel 18:25
20990.text: “‘But you will say: “The way of Jehovah is unjust.” Please listen, O house of Israel! Is it my way that is unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

20991.label: Ezekiel 18:26
20991.text: “‘When someone righteous abandons his righteousness and does what is wrong and dies because of it, he will die for his own wrongdoing.

20992.label: Ezekiel 18:27
20992.text: “‘And when someone wicked turns away from the wickedness that he has committed and begins to do what is just and righteous, he will preserve his own life.

20993.label: Ezekiel 18:28
20993.text: When he realizes and turns away from all the transgressions that he has committed, he will surely keep living. He will not die.

20994.label: Ezekiel 18:29
20994.text: “‘But the house of Israel will say: “The way of Jehovah is unjust.” Is it really my ways that are unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?’

20995.label: Ezekiel 18:30
20995.text: “‘Therefore, I will judge each one of you according to his ways, O house of Israel,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. ‘Turn away, yes, turn completely away from all your transgressions, so that they will not be a stumbling block bringing guilt upon you.

20996.label: Ezekiel 18:31
20996.text: Rid yourselves of all the transgressions you have committed and acquire a new heart and a new spirit, for why should you die, O house of Israel?’

20997.label: Ezekiel 18:32
20997.text: “‘I do not take any pleasure in the death of anyone,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. ‘So turn back and live.’”

20998.label: Ezekiel 19:1
20998.text: “You must sing a dirge concerning the chieftains of Israel

20999.label: Ezekiel 19:2
20999.text: and say,‘What was your mother? A lioness among lions. She lay down among strong young lions and reared her cubs.

21000.label: Ezekiel 19:3
21000.text: She raised one of her cubs, and he became a strong young lion. He learned how to tear prey apart,He even devoured humans.

21001.label: Ezekiel 19:4
21001.text: Nations heard about him and caught him in their pit,And they brought him to the land of Egypt with hooks.

21002.label: Ezekiel 19:5
21002.text: She waited and eventually saw that there was no hope for his return. So she took another of her cubs and sent him out as a strong young lion.

21003.label: Ezekiel 19:6
21003.text: He also walked about among the lions and became a strong young lion. He learned how to tear prey apart, and he even devoured humans.

21004.label: Ezekiel 19:7
21004.text: He prowled among their fortified towers and devastated their cities,So that the desolate land was filled with the sound of his roaring.

21005.label: Ezekiel 19:8
21005.text: Nations from the surrounding districts came against him to cast their net over him,And he was caught in their pit.

21006.label: Ezekiel 19:9
21006.text: With hooks they put him in a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. There they confined him, so that his voice would no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.

21007.label: Ezekiel 19:10
21007.text: Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by waters. It bore fruit and was full of branches because of the abundant water.

21008.label: Ezekiel 19:11
21008.text: It developed strong branches, fit for the scepters of rulers. It grew and towered over the other trees,And it became visible because of its height and because of the abundance of its foliage.

21009.label: Ezekiel 19:12
21009.text: But in fury she was uprooted and thrown to the earth,And an east wind dried up her fruit. Her strong branches were torn off and became dry, and fire consumed them.

21010.label: Ezekiel 19:13
21010.text: Now she is planted in the wilderness,In a waterless, thirsty land.

21011.label: Ezekiel 19:14
21011.text: The fire spread from her branches and consumed her shoots and her fruit,And there was no strong branch left, no scepter for ruling. “‘That is a dirge, and it will serve as a dirge.’”

21012.label: Ezekiel 20:1
21012.text: Now in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came and sat down before me to inquire of Jehovah.

21013.label: Ezekiel 20:2
21013.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

21014.label: Ezekiel 20:3
21014.text: “Son of man, speak with the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Are you coming to inquire of me? ‘As surely as I am alive, I will not respond to your inquiry,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”’

21015.label: Ezekiel 20:4
21015.text: “Are you ready to judge them? Are you ready to judge them, son of man? Make them know the detestable things that their forefathers did.

21016.label: Ezekiel 20:5
21016.text: Tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “In the day I chose Israel, I also swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and I made myself known to them in the land of Egypt. Yes, I swore to them and said, ‘I am Jehovah your God.’

21017.label: Ezekiel 20:6
21017.text: In that day I swore that I would bring them out of the land of Egypt to a land that I had searched out for them, one flowing with milk and honey. It was the most beautiful of all the lands.

21018.label: Ezekiel 20:7
21018.text: I then said to them, ‘Each of you must throw away the detestable things that are before your eyes; do not defile yourselves with the disgusting idols of Egypt. I am Jehovah your God.’

21019.label: Ezekiel 20:8
21019.text: “‘“But they rebelled against me and were not willing to listen to me. They did not throw away the detestable things that were before them, and they would not abandon the disgusting idols of Egypt. So I promised to pour out my rage on them and to unleash my anger fully against them in the land of Egypt.

21020.label: Ezekiel 20:9
21020.text: But I acted for the sake of my name so that it would not be profaned before the nations among whom they were living. For I made myself known to them before these nations when I brought them out of the land of Egypt.

21021.label: Ezekiel 20:10
21021.text: So I brought them out of the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.

21022.label: Ezekiel 20:11
21022.text: “‘“I then gave them my statutes and made my judicial decisions known to them, so that the man who follows them may have life by them.

21023.label: Ezekiel 20:12
21023.text: I also gave my sabbaths to them as a sign between me and them, so that they would know that I, Jehovah, am the one sanctifying them.

21024.label: Ezekiel 20:13
21024.text: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not walk in my statutes, and they rejected my judicial decisions, which if a man follows them, he will have life by them. They utterly profaned my sabbaths. So I promised to pour out my fury on them in the wilderness to exterminate them.

21025.label: Ezekiel 20:14
21025.text: But I acted for the sake of my own name so that it would not be profaned before the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

21026.label: Ezekiel 20:15
21026.text: I also swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them —a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all the lands—

21027.label: Ezekiel 20:16
21027.text: because they rejected my judicial decisions, they did not walk in my statutes, and they profaned my sabbaths, for their heart was following after their disgusting idols.

21028.label: Ezekiel 20:17
21028.text: “‘“But I felt sorry for them, and I did not destroy them; I did not exterminate them in the wilderness.

21029.label: Ezekiel 20:18
21029.text: I said to their sons in the wilderness, ‘Do not walk in the regulations of your forefathers or keep their judgments or defile yourselves with their disgusting idols.

21030.label: Ezekiel 20:19
21030.text: I am Jehovah your God. Walk in my statutes, and keep my judicial decisions, and carry them out.

21031.label: Ezekiel 20:20
21031.text: And sanctify my sabbaths, and they will serve as a sign between me and you for you to know that I am Jehovah your God.’

21032.label: Ezekiel 20:21
21032.text: “‘“But the sons began to rebel against me. They did not walk in my statutes, and they did not observe and carry out my judicial decisions, which if a man follows them, he will have life by them. My sabbaths they profaned. So I promised to pour out my rage on them and to unleash my anger against them fully in the wilderness.

21033.label: Ezekiel 20:22
21033.text: But I refrained and acted for the sake of my own name, so that it should not be profaned before the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

21034.label: Ezekiel 20:23
21034.text: Also, I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the lands,

21035.label: Ezekiel 20:24
21035.text: because they did not carry out my judicial decisions and they rejected my statutes, they profaned my sabbaths, and they followed after the disgusting idols of their forefathers.

21036.label: Ezekiel 20:25
21036.text: I also allowed them to follow regulations that were not good and judicial decisions by which they could not have life.

21037.label: Ezekiel 20:26
21037.text: I let them become defiled by their own sacrifices—when they made every firstborn child pass through the fire —in order to make them desolate, so that they would know that I am Jehovah.”’

21038.label: Ezekiel 20:27
21038.text: “So speak to the house of Israel, O son of man, and tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “In this way also, your forefathers blasphemed me by acting unfaithfully against me.

21039.label: Ezekiel 20:28
21039.text: I brought them into the land that I swore to give them. When they saw all the high hills and leafy trees, they began offering their sacrifices and their offensive offerings. They presented the pleasing aromas of their sacrifices and poured out their drink offerings there.

21040.label: Ezekiel 20:29
21040.text: So I asked them, ‘What is the meaning of this high place to which you go? (It is still called High Place to this day.)’”’

21041.label: Ezekiel 20:30
21041.text: “Now say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Are you defiling yourselves the same way your forefathers did by going after their disgusting idols to commit spiritual prostitution with them?

21042.label: Ezekiel 20:31
21042.text: And are you still defiling yourselves to this day by offering sacrifices to all your disgusting idols, making your sons pass through the fire? Should I at the same time respond to your inquiry, O house of Israel?”’ “‘As surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘I will not respond to your inquiry.

21043.label: Ezekiel 20:32
21043.text: And what you have in mind when you say, “Let us become like the nations, like the families of the other lands, who worship wood and stone,” it will never happen.’”

21044.label: Ezekiel 20:33
21044.text: “‘As surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘I will rule as king over you with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with an outpouring of rage.

21045.label: Ezekiel 20:34
21045.text: I will bring you out from the peoples and collect you together out of the lands where you have been scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with an outpouring of rage.

21046.label: Ezekiel 20:35
21046.text: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples and enter into judgment with you there face-to-face.

21047.label: Ezekiel 20:36
21047.text: “‘Just as I entered into judgment with your forefathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21048.label: Ezekiel 20:37
21048.text: ‘I will make you pass under the shepherd’s staff and bring you under obligation to the covenant.

21049.label: Ezekiel 20:38
21049.text: But I will remove from you the rebels and those transgressing against me. For I will bring them out of the land of their foreign residence, but they will not enter the land of Israel; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21050.label: Ezekiel 20:39
21050.text: “As for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Each of you go and serve his disgusting idols. But afterward if you do not listen to me, you will no longer be able to profane my holy name by your sacrifices and your disgusting idols.’

21051.label: Ezekiel 20:40
21051.text: “‘For in my holy mountain, on a high mountain of Israel,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘is where the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve me in the land. I will take pleasure in them there, and I will require your contributions and the firstfruits of your offerings, all your holy things.

21052.label: Ezekiel 20:41
21052.text: Because of the pleasing aroma, I will take pleasure in you when I bring you out from the peoples and collect you together from the lands to which you have been scattered; and I will be sanctified among you before the eyes of the nations.’

21053.label: Ezekiel 20:42
21053.text: “‘And you will have to know that I am Jehovah when I bring you to the land of Israel, into the land that I swore to give to your forefathers.

21054.label: Ezekiel 20:43
21054.text: And there you will remember your conduct and all your deeds by which you defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves because of all the bad things that you did.

21055.label: Ezekiel 20:44
21055.text: Then you will have to know that I am Jehovah when I deal with you for the sake of my name, not according to your wicked conduct or according to your corrupted dealings, O house of Israel,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21056.label: Ezekiel 20:45
21056.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21057.label: Ezekiel 20:46
21057.text: “Son of man, turn your face in the direction of the southern quarter and proclaim to the south, and prophesy to the forest of the field of the south.

21058.label: Ezekiel 20:47
21058.text: Say to the forest of the south, ‘Hear the word of Jehovah. This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am setting a fire ablaze against you, and it will consume every green tree and every dry tree in you. The burning flame will not be extinguished, and every face will be scorched by it, from south to north.

21059.label: Ezekiel 20:48
21059.text: And all flesh will see that I myself, Jehovah, have set it afire, so that it will not be extinguished.”’”

21060.label: Ezekiel 20:49
21060.text: And I said: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! They are saying about me, ‘Is he not just speaking in riddles?’”

21061.label: Ezekiel 21:1
21061.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21062.label: Ezekiel 21:2
21062.text: “Son of man, turn your face toward Jerusalem, and make a proclamation against the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

21063.label: Ezekiel 21:3
21063.text: Say to the land of Israel, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Here I am against you, and I will bring my sword out of its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.

21064.label: Ezekiel 21:4
21064.text: Because I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, my sword will be drawn from its sheath against all flesh, from south to north.

21065.label: Ezekiel 21:5
21065.text: All people will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have drawn my sword from its sheath. It will not go back again.”’

21066.label: Ezekiel 21:6
21066.text: “And you, son of man, sigh while you tremble, yes, sigh bitterly before them.

21067.label: Ezekiel 21:7
21067.text: And if they say to you, ‘Why are you sighing?’ you will say, ‘Because of a report.’ For it will certainly come, and every heart will melt with fear and every hand will hang limp and every spirit will become dejected and every knee will drip with water. ‘Look! It will certainly come—it will take place,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21068.label: Ezekiel 21:8
21068.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21069.label: Ezekiel 21:9
21069.text: “Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Say, ‘A sword! A sword is sharpened, and it is polished.

21070.label: Ezekiel 21:10
21070.text: It is sharpened to inflict a great slaughter; it is polished to flash like lightning.’”’” “Should we not rejoice?” “‘Will it reject the scepter of my own son, as it does every tree?

21071.label: Ezekiel 21:11
21071.text: “‘It is given to be polished and to be wielded with the hand. This sword is sharpened and polished, to be put into the hand of an executioner.

21072.label: Ezekiel 21:12
21072.text: “‘Cry out and wail, son of man, for it has come against my people; it is against all the chieftains of Israel. These will be victims of the sword along with my people. So strike your thigh in grief.

21073.label: Ezekiel 21:13
21073.text: For an examination has been made, and what will happen if the sword rejects the scepter? It will cease to exist,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21074.label: Ezekiel 21:14
21074.text: “And you, son of man, prophesy and clap your hands and repeat ‘A sword!’ three times. It is the sword of the slain victims, the sword of great slaughter, that surrounds them.

21075.label: Ezekiel 21:15
21075.text: Their hearts will melt with fear and many will fall at their city gates; I will inflict a slaughter by the sword. Yes, it flashes like lightning and is polished for a slaughter!

21076.label: Ezekiel 21:16
21076.text: Cut sharply to the right! Swing to the left! Go wherever your blade is directed!

21077.label: Ezekiel 21:17
21077.text: I will also clap my hands and satisfy my rage. I myself, Jehovah, have spoken.”

21078.label: Ezekiel 21:18
21078.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21079.label: Ezekiel 21:19
21079.text: “As for you, son of man, mark out two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to come. Both of them will originate from the same land, and a signpost should be set up where the road branches off to the two cities.

21080.label: Ezekiel 21:20
21080.text: You should mark out one way for the sword to come against Rabʹbah of the Amʹmon·ites, and the other way against fortified Jerusalem in Judah.

21081.label: Ezekiel 21:21
21081.text: For the king of Babylon stops to use divination at the fork in the road, where the two roads branch off. He shakes the arrows. He consults his idols; he examines the liver.

21082.label: Ezekiel 21:22
21082.text: The divination in his right hand is pointed toward Jerusalem, to set up battering rams, to give the word for slaughter, to sound the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to throw up a siege rampart, to build a siege wall.

21083.label: Ezekiel 21:23
21083.text: But it will seem like false divination in the eyes of those who had sworn oaths to them. But he remembers their guilt and will capture them.

21084.label: Ezekiel 21:24
21084.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘You have caused your own guilt to be remembered by exposing your transgressions and causing your sins to be seen in all your actions. Now that you have been remembered, you will be taken by force.’

21085.label: Ezekiel 21:25
21085.text: “But your day has come, O fatally wounded, wicked chieftain of Israel, the time of your final punishment.

21086.label: Ezekiel 21:26
21086.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not remain the same. Raise up the low one, and bring low the high one.

21087.label: Ezekiel 21:27
21087.text: A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I will make it. And it will not belong to anyone until the one who has the legal right comes, and I will give it to him.’

21088.label: Ezekiel 21:28
21088.text: “And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says about the Amʹmon·ites and about their insults.’ Say, ‘A sword! A sword is drawn for a slaughter; it is polished to devour and to flash like lightning.

21089.label: Ezekiel 21:29
21089.text: Despite the false visions and lying divination about you, you will be piled up on the slain, the wicked men whose day has come, the time of their final punishment.

21090.label: Ezekiel 21:30
21090.text: Return it to its sheath. I will judge you in the place that you were created, in the land of your origin.

21091.label: Ezekiel 21:31
21091.text: I will pour out my indignation on you. I will blow upon you with the fire of my fury, and I will hand you over to brutal men, the craftsmen of destruction.

21092.label: Ezekiel 21:32
21092.text: You will become fuel for the fire; your own blood will be shed in the land, and you will be remembered no more, for I myself, Jehovah, have spoken.’”

21093.label: Ezekiel 22:1
21093.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21094.label: Ezekiel 22:2
21094.text: “As for you, son of man, are you prepared to pronounce judgment on the bloodguilty city and to make known to her all her detestable things?

21095.label: Ezekiel 22:3
21095.text: You are to say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “O city that sheds blood within herself, whose time is coming, who makes disgusting idols to defile herself,

21096.label: Ezekiel 22:4
21096.text: your bloodshed has made you guilty, and your disgusting idols have made you unclean. You have hastened the end of your days, and the end of your years has come. That is why I will make you an object of reproach to the nations and an object of mockery to all the lands.

21097.label: Ezekiel 22:5
21097.text: The lands nearby and those far away from you will mock you, you whose name is unclean and who are filled with turmoil.

21098.label: Ezekiel 22:6
21098.text: Look! Each of the chieftains of Israel among you uses his authority to shed blood.

21099.label: Ezekiel 22:7
21099.text: Within you they treat their father and mother with contempt. They defraud the foreign resident, and they mistreat the fatherless child and the widow.”’”

21100.label: Ezekiel 22:8
21100.text: “‘My holy places you despise, and my sabbaths you profane.

21101.label: Ezekiel 22:9
21101.text: Within you are slanderers intent on shedding blood. Within you they eat sacrifices on the mountains and carry on obscene conduct in your midst.

21102.label: Ezekiel 22:10
21102.text: Within you they dishonor their father’s bed, and they violate a woman unclean in her menstruation.

21103.label: Ezekiel 22:11
21103.text: Within you one man acts detestably with his neighbor’s wife, another defiles his own daughter-in-law with obscene conduct, and another violates his sister, the daughter of his own father.

21104.label: Ezekiel 22:12
21104.text: Within you they take a bribe to shed blood. You lend on interest or for a profit, and you extort money from your neighbors. Yes, you have entirely forgotten me,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21105.label: Ezekiel 22:13
21105.text: “‘Look! I clap my hands in disgust at the dishonest gain you have made and over the acts of bloodshed in your midst.

21106.label: Ezekiel 22:14
21106.text: Will your courage endure and your hands remain strong in the days when I take action against you? I myself, Jehovah, have spoken, and I will take action.

21107.label: Ezekiel 22:15
21107.text: I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the lands, and I will put an end to your uncleanness.

21108.label: Ezekiel 22:16
21108.text: And you will be dishonored before the nations, and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

21109.label: Ezekiel 22:17
21109.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21110.label: Ezekiel 22:18
21110.text: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become like worthless dross to me. All of them are copper and tin and iron and lead in a furnace. They have become the dross of silver.

21111.label: Ezekiel 22:19
21111.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because all of you have become like worthless dross, I am collecting you together inside Jerusalem.

21112.label: Ezekiel 22:20
21112.text: Just as silver and copper and iron and lead and tin are collected inside a furnace in order to blow fire upon them and melt them, so I will collect you together in my anger and in my rage, and I will blow upon you and make you melt.

21113.label: Ezekiel 22:21
21113.text: I will bring you together and blow upon you with the fire of my fury, and you will be melted inside of her.

21114.label: Ezekiel 22:22
21114.text: Just as silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted inside her; and you will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have poured out my rage on you.’”

21115.label: Ezekiel 22:23
21115.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21116.label: Ezekiel 22:24
21116.text: “Son of man, say to her, ‘You are a land that will not be cleansed or rained on in the day of indignation.

21117.label: Ezekiel 22:25
21117.text: Her prophets have conspired within her, like a roaring lion tearing prey. They are devouring people. They are seizing treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within her.

21118.label: Ezekiel 22:26
21118.text: Her priests have violated my law, and they keep profaning my holy places. They make no distinction between what is holy and what is common, and they fail to make known what is unclean and what is clean, and they refuse to observe my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

21119.label: Ezekiel 22:27
21119.text: Her princes in her midst are like wolves tearing prey; they shed blood and kill people to make dishonest gain.

21120.label: Ezekiel 22:28
21120.text: But her prophets have plastered over their deeds with whitewash. They see false visions and give lying divination, and they say: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says,” when Jehovah himself has not spoken.

21121.label: Ezekiel 22:29
21121.text: The people of the land have defrauded and committed robbery, they have mistreated the needy and the poor, and they have defrauded the foreign resident and denied him justice.’

21122.label: Ezekiel 22:30
21122.text: “‘I was looking for a man from among them who would repair the stone wall or stand before me in the breach in behalf of the land, so that it would not be destroyed, but I found no one.

21123.label: Ezekiel 22:31
21123.text: So I will pour out my indignation on them and exterminate them with the fire of my fury. I will bring the consequences of their way on their own head,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21124.label: Ezekiel 23:1
21124.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21125.label: Ezekiel 23:2
21125.text: “Son of man, there were two women who were the daughters of the same mother.

21126.label: Ezekiel 23:3
21126.text: They became prostitutes in Egypt; from their youth they engaged in prostitution. Their breasts were squeezed there, and their virgin bosoms were fondled.

21127.label: Ezekiel 23:4
21127.text: Their names were O·hoʹlah, the older one, and her sister O·hoʹli·bah. They became mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their names, O·hoʹlah is Sa·marʹi·a, and O·hoʹli·bah is Jerusalem.

21128.label: Ezekiel 23:5
21128.text: “O·hoʹlah began to prostitute herself while she belonged to me. She lusted after her passionate lovers, her neighbors the As·syrʹi·ans.

21129.label: Ezekiel 23:6
21129.text: They were governors clothed in blue and deputy rulers—all desirable young men mounted on their horses.

21130.label: Ezekiel 23:7
21130.text: She continued to prostitute herself with all the choicest sons of As·syrʹi·a, and she defiled herself with the disgusting idols of those she lusted after.

21131.label: Ezekiel 23:8
21131.text: She did not abandon the prostitution she practiced in Egypt, for in her youth they had lain down with her, and they fondled her virgin bosom and poured out their lust on her.

21132.label: Ezekiel 23:9
21132.text: So I gave her into the hand of her passionate lovers, the sons of As·syrʹi·a, after whom she had lusted.

21133.label: Ezekiel 23:10
21133.text: They exposed her nakedness and seized her sons and daughters, and they killed her with a sword. She became notorious among women, and they executed judgment against her.

21134.label: Ezekiel 23:11
21134.text: “When her sister O·hoʹli·bah saw it, her lust became even more depraved, and her prostitution was worse than that of her sister.

21135.label: Ezekiel 23:12
21135.text: She lusted after her neighbors the sons of As·syrʹi·a, the governors and deputy rulers who were clothed in splendor and mounted on horses—all desirable young men.

21136.label: Ezekiel 23:13
21136.text: When she defiled herself, I saw that both of them had followed the same course.

21137.label: Ezekiel 23:14
21137.text: But she kept adding to her acts of prostitution. She saw men carved on the wall, images of Chal·deʹans carved in vermilion,

21138.label: Ezekiel 23:15
21138.text: wearing belts around their waist, with flowing turbans on their heads, having the appearance of warriors, all of them depicting Babylonians, born in the land of the Chal·deʹans.

21139.label: Ezekiel 23:16
21139.text: She began to lust after them as soon as she saw them, and she sent messengers to them in Chal·deʹa.

21140.label: Ezekiel 23:17
21140.text: So the sons of Babylon kept coming to her bed of lovemaking, and they defiled her with their lust. After she was defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust.

21141.label: Ezekiel 23:18
21141.text: “When she went on brazenly engaging in prostitution and exposing her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister in disgust.

21142.label: Ezekiel 23:19
21142.text: And she kept increasing her acts of prostitution, calling to mind the days of her youth when she prostituted herself in the land of Egypt.

21143.label: Ezekiel 23:20
21143.text: She lusted after them like the concubines of men whose male members are like those of a donkey and whose genitals are like those of a horse.

21144.label: Ezekiel 23:21
21144.text: You yearned for the obscene conduct of your youth in Egypt when they fondled your bosom, the breasts of your youth.

21145.label: Ezekiel 23:22
21145.text: “Therefore, O·hoʹli·bah, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Here I am stirring up your lovers whom you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every direction,

21146.label: Ezekiel 23:23
21146.text: the sons of Babylon and all the Chal·deʹans, the men of Peʹkod and Shoʹa and Koʹa, along with all the sons of As·syrʹi·a. All of them are desirable young men, governors and deputy rulers, warriors and handpicked, all mounted on horses.

21147.label: Ezekiel 23:24
21147.text: They will attack you with rumbling war chariots and wheels and with a great assembly of troops, with large shield and buckler and helmet. They will take up positions all around you, and I will authorize them to pass judgment, and they will judge you as they see fit.

21148.label: Ezekiel 23:25
21148.text: I will express my indignation against you, and they will deal with you in their rage. They will cut off your nose and your ears, and those of you who remain will fall by the sword. They will take away your sons and your daughters, and those of you who remain will be consumed by fire.

21149.label: Ezekiel 23:26
21149.text: They will strip off your garments and seize your beautiful jewelry.

21150.label: Ezekiel 23:27
21150.text: I will put an end to your obscene conduct and your prostitution, which started in the land of Egypt. You will stop looking at them, and you will remember Egypt no more.’

21151.label: Ezekiel 23:28
21151.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Here I am about to hand you over to those you hate, those you turned away from in disgust.

21152.label: Ezekiel 23:29
21152.text: They will deal with you in hatred and take away all you have toiled for and leave you naked and exposed. The shameful nakedness of your immorality and your obscene conduct and your prostitution will be exposed.

21153.label: Ezekiel 23:30
21153.text: These things will be done to you because you chased after the nations like a prostitute, because you defiled yourself with their disgusting idols.

21154.label: Ezekiel 23:31
21154.text: You have followed the same course as your sister, and I will put her cup into your hand.’

21155.label: Ezekiel 23:32
21155.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘You will drink the deep and wide cup of your sister, And you will become an object of laughter and ridicule, of which the cup contains much.

21156.label: Ezekiel 23:33
21156.text: You will be overcome by drunkenness and grief,A cup of horror and desolation,The cup of your sister, Sa·marʹi·a.

21157.label: Ezekiel 23:34
21157.text: You will have to drink it and drain it dry and gnaw on its earthenware fragmentsAnd then tear out your breasts. “For I myself have spoken,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.’

21158.label: Ezekiel 23:35
21158.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and have completely disregarded me, you will bear the consequences of your obscene conduct and your acts of prostitution.’”

21159.label: Ezekiel 23:36
21159.text: Jehovah then said to me: “Son of man, will you pronounce judgment on O·hoʹlah and O·hoʹli·bah and confront them with their disgusting practices?

21160.label: Ezekiel 23:37
21160.text: They have committed adultery, and there is blood on their hands. Not only have they committed adultery with their disgusting idols, but they have also made their sons whom they bore to me pass through the fire as food for their idols.

21161.label: Ezekiel 23:38
21161.text: Moreover, this is what they have done to me: They defiled my sanctuary on that day, and they profaned my sabbaths.

21162.label: Ezekiel 23:39
21162.text: After they slaughtered their sons as sacrifices to their disgusting idols, they came into my sanctuary to profane it on that very day. That is what they did inside my own house.

21163.label: Ezekiel 23:40
21163.text: They even sent a messenger for men to come from far away. When they were coming, you washed yourself and painted your eyes and adorned yourself with ornaments.

21164.label: Ezekiel 23:41
21164.text: And you sat down on a magnificent couch with a table set in front of it, on which you put my incense and my oil.

21165.label: Ezekiel 23:42
21165.text: The sound of a carefree crowd of men was heard there, among whom were drunkards brought in from the wilderness. They put bracelets on the hands of the women and beautiful crowns on their heads.

21166.label: Ezekiel 23:43
21166.text: “Then I said regarding her who was worn out with adultery: ‘Now she will keep committing her prostitution.’

21167.label: Ezekiel 23:44
21167.text: So they kept going in to her, just as one goes to a prostitute. That is how they went in to O·hoʹlah and to O·hoʹli·bah, the women of obscene conduct.

21168.label: Ezekiel 23:45
21168.text: But righteous men will render to her the appropriate judgment for adultery and bloodshed; for adulteresses is what they are, and they have blood on their hands.

21169.label: Ezekiel 23:46
21169.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘An army will be brought against them to make them an object of horror and something to plunder.

21170.label: Ezekiel 23:47
21170.text: The army will hurl stones at them and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn their houses with fire.

21171.label: Ezekiel 23:48
21171.text: I will put an end to the obscene conduct in the land, and all the women will learn a lesson and not copy your obscene conduct.

21172.label: Ezekiel 23:49
21172.text: They will bring on you the consequences of your obscene conduct and of your sins with your disgusting idols; and you will have to know that I am the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.’”

21173.label: Ezekiel 24:1
21173.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying:

21174.label: Ezekiel 24:2
21174.text: “Son of man, record this date, this very day. The king of Babylon has begun his attack against Jerusalem on this very day.

21175.label: Ezekiel 24:3
21175.text: And relate a proverb concerning the rebellious house, and say concerning them: “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Put the cooking pot on; put it on the fire and pour water into it.

21176.label: Ezekiel 24:4
21176.text: Put pieces of meat into it, every good piece,The thigh and the shoulder; fill it with the choicest bones.

21177.label: Ezekiel 24:5
21177.text: Take the choicest sheep of the flock, and stack the logs all around under the pot. Boil the pieces, and cook the bones inside it.”’

21178.label: Ezekiel 24:6
21178.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed, the rusty cooking pot, whose rust has not been removed! Empty it piece by piece; do not cast lots for them.

21179.label: Ezekiel 24:7
21179.text: For its blood is within it; she poured it out on the bare rock. She did not pour it out on the earth, to cover it over with dust.

21180.label: Ezekiel 24:8
21180.text: To stir up rage for executing vengeance,I have put her blood on the shining, bare rockSo that it may not be covered over.’

21181.label: Ezekiel 24:9
21181.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I will pile the wood high.

21182.label: Ezekiel 24:10
21182.text: Heap on the logs and kindle the fire,Boil the flesh thoroughly, pour out the broth, and let the bones be charred.

21183.label: Ezekiel 24:11
21183.text: Set the empty pot on the coals to make it hotSo that its copper will become red hot. Its uncleanness will melt away within it, and its rust will be consumed.

21184.label: Ezekiel 24:12
21184.text: It is frustrating and exhausting,For the heavy rust will not come off. Throw it into the fire with its rust!’

21185.label: Ezekiel 24:13
21185.text: “‘Your uncleanness was due to your obscene conduct. I tried to cleanse you, but you would not become clean from your uncleanness. You will not become clean until my rage against you subsides.

21186.label: Ezekiel 24:14
21186.text: I myself, Jehovah, have spoken. It will come to pass. I will act without holding back, without sorrow, without regret. They will judge you according to your ways and your dealings,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21187.label: Ezekiel 24:15
21187.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21188.label: Ezekiel 24:16
21188.text: “Son of man, in a single blow I am about to take away your dear one from you. You should not mourn; nor should you weep or shed tears.

21189.label: Ezekiel 24:17
21189.text: Groan in silence, and do not observe mourning rites for the dead. Bind on your turban, and put on your sandals. You should not cover over the mustache, and do not eat the bread brought to you by others.”

21190.label: Ezekiel 24:18
21190.text: And I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening. So I did in the morning just as I had been commanded.

21191.label: Ezekiel 24:19
21191.text: The people were saying to me: “Will you not tell us what these things you are doing have to do with us?”

21192.label: Ezekiel 24:20
21192.text: I replied to them: “The word of Jehovah has come to me, saying,

21193.label: Ezekiel 24:21
21193.text: ‘Tell the house of Israel: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says, ‘I am about to profane my sanctuary, the source of your great pride, the thing dear to you and the desire of your heart. Your own sons and daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.

21194.label: Ezekiel 24:22
21194.text: Then you will have to do just as I have done. You will not cover over your mustache, and you will not eat the bread brought to you by others.

21195.label: Ezekiel 24:23
21195.text: Your turbans will be on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep. Instead, you will rot away in your errors, and you will groan to one another.

21196.label: Ezekiel 24:24
21196.text: Ezekiel has become a sign for you. Just as he has done, you will do. When it happens, you will have to know that I am the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.’”’”

21197.label: Ezekiel 24:25
21197.text: “And as for you, son of man, on the day that I take away from them their fortress—the beautiful object of their joy, the thing dear to them, their heart’s desire—along with their sons and daughters,

21198.label: Ezekiel 24:26
21198.text: it will be reported to you by one who has escaped.

21199.label: Ezekiel 24:27
21199.text: In that day you will open your mouth and speak to the one who escaped, and you will no longer be mute. You will become a sign to them, and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.”

21200.label: Ezekiel 25:1
21200.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21201.label: Ezekiel 25:2
21201.text: “Son of man, turn your face toward the Amʹmon·ites, and prophesy against them.

21202.label: Ezekiel 25:3
21202.text: You must say concerning the Amʹmon·ites, ‘Hear the word of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Because you said ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was laid desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into exile,

21203.label: Ezekiel 25:4
21203.text: therefore I am giving you to the people of the East as a possession. They will set up their encampments within you and pitch their tents among you. They will eat your fruitage, and they will drink your milk.

21204.label: Ezekiel 25:5
21204.text: I will make Rabʹbah a pasture ground for camels, and the land of the Amʹmon·ites a resting-place for the flock; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.”’”

21205.label: Ezekiel 25:6
21205.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because you clapped your hands and stamped your feet and you rejoiced over the land of Israel with such utter scorn,

21206.label: Ezekiel 25:7
21206.text: therefore I will stretch out my hand against you to give you to the nations as something to plunder. I will cut you off from the peoples and destroy you from the lands. I will annihilate you, and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21207.label: Ezekiel 25:8
21207.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because Moʹab and Seʹir have said, “Look! The house of Judah is like all the other nations,”

21208.label: Ezekiel 25:9
21208.text: I am exposing Moʹab’s flank at his frontier cities, the beauty of his land, Beth-jeshʹi·moth, Baʹal-meʹon, and clear to Kir·i·a·thaʹim.

21209.label: Ezekiel 25:10
21209.text: I will give it along with the Amʹmon·ites as a possession to the people of the East, so that the Amʹmon·ites will not be remembered among the nations.

21210.label: Ezekiel 25:11
21210.text: And I will execute judgment in Moʹab, and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21211.label: Ezekiel 25:12
21211.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Eʹdom has acted vengefully against the house of Judah and has incurred great guilt in taking revenge on them;

21212.label: Ezekiel 25:13
21212.text: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I will also stretch out my hand against Eʹdom and cut off from it both man and livestock, and I will make it desolate. From Teʹman clear to Deʹdan, they will fall by the sword.

21213.label: Ezekiel 25:14
21213.text: ‘I will take vengeance on Eʹdom by the hand of my people Israel. They will bring my anger and my wrath on Eʹdom, so that they experience my own vengeance,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”’

21214.label: Ezekiel 25:15
21214.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because of their unrelenting hostility, the Phi·lisʹtines have maliciously sought to bring vengeance and destruction.

21215.label: Ezekiel 25:16
21215.text: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am stretching out my hand against the Phi·lisʹtines, and I will cut off the Cherʹe·thites and will destroy the remaining inhabitants of the seacoast.

21216.label: Ezekiel 25:17
21216.text: I will execute on them great acts of vengeance with furious punishments, and they will have to know that I am Jehovah when I bring my vengeance on them.”’”

21217.label: Ezekiel 26:1
21217.text: In the 11th year, on the first day of the month, the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

21218.label: Ezekiel 26:2
21218.text: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gateway of the peoples has been broken! Everything will come my way, and I will become rich now that she is devastated’;

21219.label: Ezekiel 26:3
21219.text: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Here I am against you, O Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, just as the sea brings up its waves.

21220.label: Ezekiel 26:4
21220.text: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers, and I will scrape away soil and make her a shining, bare rock.

21221.label: Ezekiel 26:5
21221.text: She will become a drying yard for dragnets in the midst of the sea.’ “‘For I myself have spoken,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘and she will become plunder for the nations.

21222.label: Ezekiel 26:6
21222.text: And her settlements in the countryside will be slaughtered by the sword, and people will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21223.label: Ezekiel 26:7
21223.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Here I am bringing King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon against Tyre from the north; he is a king of kings, with horses, war chariots, cavalrymen, and an army of many soldiers.

21224.label: Ezekiel 26:8
21224.text: He will destroy your settlements in the countryside with the sword, and he will build a siege wall and throw up a siege rampart against you and raise up a great shield against you.

21225.label: Ezekiel 26:9
21225.text: He will pound your walls with his battering ram, and with his axes he will pull down your towers.

21226.label: Ezekiel 26:10
21226.text: His horses will be so many that they will cover you with dust, and the sound of the cavalry, the wheels, and the chariots will cause your walls to shake when he enters your gates, like men storming a city with broken walls.

21227.label: Ezekiel 26:11
21227.text: The hooves of his horses will trample down all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and your mighty pillars will crash to the ground.

21228.label: Ezekiel 26:12
21228.text: They will loot your resources, plunder your merchandise, tear down your walls, and pull down your fine houses; then they will throw your stones and your woodwork and your soil into the water.’

21229.label: Ezekiel 26:13
21229.text: “‘I will put an end to the noise of your songs, and the sound of your harps will be heard no more.

21230.label: Ezekiel 26:14
21230.text: And I will make you a shining, bare rock, and you will become a drying yard for dragnets. You will never be rebuilt, for I myself, Jehovah, have spoken,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21231.label: Ezekiel 26:15
21231.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says to Tyre: ‘At the sound of your downfall, when the dying ones are groaning, when a slaughter takes place in your midst, will the islands not shudder?

21232.label: Ezekiel 26:16
21232.text: All the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones and remove their robes and strip off their embroidered garments, and they will be seized with trembling. They will sit on the ground and tremble constantly and stare at you in amazement.

21233.label: Ezekiel 26:17
21233.text: And they will sing a dirge over you and say to you: “How you have perished, you who were inhabited from the seas, the praised city;You and your inhabitants were mighty on the sea, Spreading terror to all the inhabitants of the earth!

21234.label: Ezekiel 26:18
21234.text: The islands will tremble on the day of your downfall,The islands of the sea will be disturbed when you are gone.”’

21235.label: Ezekiel 26:19
21235.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘When I devastate you like the cities that are not inhabited, when I overwhelm you with the surging waters and the mighty waters have covered you,

21236.label: Ezekiel 26:20
21236.text: I will bring you and those going down into the pit with you to the people of long ago; I will cause you to dwell in the lowest place, like the places of old that have been devastated, together with those going down into the pit, so that you may not be inhabited. Then I will glorify the land of the living.

21237.label: Ezekiel 26:21
21237.text: “‘I will bring sudden terror upon you, and you will no longer be. They will search for you, but you will never again be found,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21238.label: Ezekiel 27:1
21238.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21239.label: Ezekiel 27:2
21239.text: “As for you, son of man, sing a dirge over Tyre,

21240.label: Ezekiel 27:3
21240.text: and say to Tyre,‘You who dwell at the gateways of the sea,The merchant for the peoples of many islands,This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “O Tyre, you yourself have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

21241.label: Ezekiel 27:4
21241.text: Your territories are in the heart of the sea,And your builders have perfected your beauty.

21242.label: Ezekiel 27:5
21242.text: They made all your planks from the juniper trees of Seʹnir, And they took a cedar from Lebʹa·non to make a mast for you.

21243.label: Ezekiel 27:6
21243.text: They made your oars from oaks of Baʹshan,And your prow was of cypress inlaid with ivory from the islands of Kitʹtim.

21244.label: Ezekiel 27:7
21244.text: Colorful linen from Egypt served as cloth for your sail,And your deck awnings were of blue thread and purple wool from the islands of E·liʹshah.

21245.label: Ezekiel 27:8
21245.text: The inhabitants of Siʹdon and of Arʹvad were your rowers. Your own skilled men, O Tyre, were your sailors.

21246.label: Ezekiel 27:9
21246.text: The experienced and skilled men of Geʹbal caulked your seams. All the ships of the sea and their mariners came to you to trade merchandise.

21247.label: Ezekiel 27:10
21247.text: Men of Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung their shields and helmets in you, and they brought you splendor.

21248.label: Ezekiel 27:11
21248.text: The men of Arʹvad in your army were stationed on your walls all around,And brave men manned your towers. They hung circular shields all around your wallsAnd perfected your beauty.

21249.label: Ezekiel 27:12
21249.text: “‘“Tarʹshish did business with you because of your abundant wealth. They exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead for your goods.

21250.label: Ezekiel 27:13
21250.text: Jaʹvan, Tuʹbal, and Meʹshech traded with you, exchanging slaves and articles of copper for your merchandise.

21251.label: Ezekiel 27:14
21251.text: The house of To·garʹmah exchanged horses and steeds and mules for your goods.

21252.label: Ezekiel 27:15
21252.text: The people of Deʹdan traded with you; you employed merchants on many islands; they gave ivory tusks and ebony as your tribute.

21253.label: Ezekiel 27:16
21253.text: Eʹdom did business with you because of the abundance of your products. They gave turquoise, purple wool, colorful embroidery, fine fabric, corals, and rubies in exchange for your goods.

21254.label: Ezekiel 27:17
21254.text: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel traded with you, giving the wheat of Minʹnith, choice foods, honey, oil, and balsam in exchange for your goods.

21255.label: Ezekiel 27:18
21255.text: “‘“Damascus did business with you because of the abundance of your products and all your wealth, trading the wine of Helʹbon and wool of Zaʹhar.

21256.label: Ezekiel 27:19
21256.text: Veʹdan and Jaʹvan from Uʹzal gave wrought iron, cassia, and cane in exchange for your goods.

21257.label: Ezekiel 27:20
21257.text: Deʹdan traded with you in saddlecloths for riding.

21258.label: Ezekiel 27:21
21258.text: You employed the Arabs and all the chieftains of Keʹdar, who were merchants of lambs and rams and goats.

21259.label: Ezekiel 27:22
21259.text: The merchants of Sheʹba and Raʹa·mah traded with you; they gave all sorts of the finest perfumes, precious stones, and gold in exchange for your goods.

21260.label: Ezekiel 27:23
21260.text: Haʹran, Canʹneh, Eʹden, the merchants of Sheʹba, Asʹshur, and Chilʹmad traded with you.

21261.label: Ezekiel 27:24
21261.text: In your marketplace they traded beautiful garments, cloaks made of blue material and colorful embroidery, and multicolored carpets, all bound and secured with ropes.

21262.label: Ezekiel 27:25
21262.text: The ships of Tarʹshish were the caravans for your merchandise,So that you were filled and loaded down in the heart of the open sea.

21263.label: Ezekiel 27:26
21263.text: Your rowers have brought you into heavy seas;The east wind has wrecked you in the heart of the open sea.

21264.label: Ezekiel 27:27
21264.text: Your wealth, your goods, your merchandise, your mariners, and your sailors,Those caulking your seams, those trading your merchandise, and all the men of war —The entire multitude within you—They will all sink in the heart of the open sea on the day of your downfall.

21265.label: Ezekiel 27:28
21265.text: When your sailors cry out, the coastlands will shudder.

21266.label: Ezekiel 27:29
21266.text: All the oarsmen, the mariners, and the seamenWill come down from their ships and stand on the land.

21267.label: Ezekiel 27:30
21267.text: They will raise their voices and cry out bitterly over you As they throw dust on their heads and wallow in ashes.

21268.label: Ezekiel 27:31
21268.text: They will make themselves bald and put on sackcloth;They will weep bitterly over you with intense wailing.

21269.label: Ezekiel 27:32
21269.text: In their lamentation they will sing a dirge and chant over you: ‘Who is like Tyre, now silent in the midst of the sea?

21270.label: Ezekiel 27:33
21270.text: When your goods came in from the open sea, you satisfied many peoples. Your abundant wealth and your merchandise enriched earth’s kings.

21271.label: Ezekiel 27:34
21271.text: Now you have been wrecked in the open sea, in the deep waters, And all your merchandise and your people have sunk with you.

21272.label: Ezekiel 27:35
21272.text: All the inhabitants of the islands will stare at you in amazement, And their kings will shudder with horror —their faces will be troubled.

21273.label: Ezekiel 27:36
21273.text: The merchants among the nations will whistle over what happened to you. Your end will be sudden and terrible,And you will cease to exist for all time.’”’”

21274.label: Ezekiel 28:1
21274.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21275.label: Ezekiel 28:2
21275.text: “Son of man, tell the leader of Tyre, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Because your heart has become haughty, you keep saying, ‘I am a god. I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the sea.’ But you are only a man, not a god,Though in your heart you feel that you are a god.

21276.label: Ezekiel 28:3
21276.text: Look! You are wiser than Daniel. No secrets have been hidden from you.

21277.label: Ezekiel 28:4
21277.text: You have made yourself wealthy by your wisdom and your discernment,And you keep storing up gold and silver in your treasuries.

21278.label: Ezekiel 28:5
21278.text: Your skillful trading brought you great wealth, And your heart grew haughty because of your wealth.”’

21279.label: Ezekiel 28:6
21279.text: “‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Because in your heart you feel that you are a god,

21280.label: Ezekiel 28:7
21280.text: I am bringing foreigners against you, the most ruthless of the nations, And they will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdomAnd defile your glorious splendor.

21281.label: Ezekiel 28:8
21281.text: They will bring you down to the pit, And you will die a violent death in the heart of the open sea.

21282.label: Ezekiel 28:9
21282.text: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ to the one killing you? You will be a mere man, not a god, in the hand of those defiling you.”’

21283.label: Ezekiel 28:10
21283.text: ‘By the hand of foreigners, you will die the death of the uncircumcised ones,For I myself have spoken,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21284.label: Ezekiel 28:11
21284.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21285.label: Ezekiel 28:12
21285.text: “Son of man, sing a dirge concerning the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “You were the model of perfection, Full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

21286.label: Ezekiel 28:13
21286.text: You were in Eʹden, the garden of God. You were adorned with every precious stone—Ruby, topaz, and jasper; chrysʹo·lite, onyx, and jade; sapphire, turquoise, and emerald;And their settings and mountings were made of gold. They were prepared on the day you were created.

21287.label: Ezekiel 28:14
21287.text: I assigned you as the anointed covering cherub. You were on the holy mountain of God, and you walked about among fiery stones.

21288.label: Ezekiel 28:15
21288.text: You were faultless in your ways from the day you were createdUntil unrighteousness was found in you.

21289.label: Ezekiel 28:16
21289.text: Because of your abundant trade, You became filled with violence, and you began to sin. So I will cast you out as profane from the mountain of God and destroy you, O covering cherub, away from the stones of fire.

21290.label: Ezekiel 28:17
21290.text: Your heart became haughty because of your beauty. You corrupted your wisdom because of your own glorious splendor. I will throw you down to the earth. I will make you a spectacle before kings.

21291.label: Ezekiel 28:18
21291.text: Because of your great guilt and your dishonest trading, you have profaned your sanctuaries. I will cause a fire to break out in your midst, and it will consume you. I will reduce you to ashes on the earth before all those looking at you.

21292.label: Ezekiel 28:19
21292.text: All who knew you among the peoples will stare at you in amazement. Your end will be sudden and terrible,And you will cease to exist for all time.”’”

21293.label: Ezekiel 28:20
21293.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21294.label: Ezekiel 28:21
21294.text: “Son of man, turn your face toward Siʹdon, and prophesy against her.

21295.label: Ezekiel 28:22
21295.text: You should say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am against you, O Siʹdon, and I will be glorified in your midst;And people will have to know that I am Jehovah when I execute judgment on her and I am sanctified in her.

21296.label: Ezekiel 28:23
21296.text: I will send pestilence into her and blood will flow in her streets. The slain will fall in her midst when the sword comes against her from all sides;And they will have to know that I am Jehovah.

21297.label: Ezekiel 28:24
21297.text: “‘“Then the house of Israel will no longer be surrounded by injurious briars and painful thorns, those who treat them with scorn; and people will have to know that I am the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”’

21298.label: Ezekiel 28:25
21298.text: “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “When I regather the house of Israel from among the peoples where they were scattered, I will be sanctified among them in the eyes of the nations. And they will dwell on their land that I gave to my servant Jacob.

21299.label: Ezekiel 28:26
21299.text: They will dwell on it in security and build houses and plant vineyards, and they will dwell in security when I execute judgment on all those around them who treat them with scorn; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah their God.”’”

21300.label: Ezekiel 29:1
21300.text: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the 12th day of the month, the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

21301.label: Ezekiel 29:2
21301.text: “Son of man, turn your face toward Pharʹaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

21302.label: Ezekiel 29:3
21302.text: Speak these words: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am against you, Pharʹaoh king of Egypt, The great sea monster lying among the streams of his Nile, Who has said, ‘My Nile River belongs to me. I made it for myself.’

21303.label: Ezekiel 29:4
21303.text: But I will put hooks in your jaws and cause the fish of your Nile to cling to your scales. I will bring you up out of your Nile along with all the fish of the Nile that cling to your scales.

21304.label: Ezekiel 29:5
21304.text: I will abandon you in the desert, you and all the fish of your Nile. You will fall on the open field, and you will not be gathered up nor be collected together. I will give you as food to the wild beasts of the earth and the birds of the sky.

21305.label: Ezekiel 29:6
21305.text: Then all the inhabitants of Egypt will have to know that I am Jehovah,For they were no more support to the house of Israel than a piece of straw.

21306.label: Ezekiel 29:7
21306.text: When they grasped your hand, you were crushed,And you caused them to tear their shoulder. When they supported themselves on you, you were broken,And you caused their legs to wobble.”

21307.label: Ezekiel 29:8
21307.text: “‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am bringing a sword upon you, and I will cut off from you both man and beast.

21308.label: Ezekiel 29:9
21308.text: The land of Egypt will become a desolate and devastated place; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah, for you have said, ‘The Nile River belongs to me; I am the one who made it.’

21309.label: Ezekiel 29:10
21309.text: So I am against you and against your Nile, and I will make the land of Egypt devastated and dry, a desolate wasteland, from Migʹdol to Sy·eʹne to the boundary of E·thi·oʹpi·a.

21310.label: Ezekiel 29:11
21310.text: Neither man nor livestock will pass through it on foot, and it will not be inhabited for 40 years.

21311.label: Ezekiel 29:12
21311.text: I will make the land of Egypt the most desolate of lands, and its cities will be the most desolate of cities for 40 years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands.”

21312.label: Ezekiel 29:13
21312.text: “‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “After 40 years I will gather back the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered;

21313.label: Ezekiel 29:14
21313.text: I will bring the Egyptian captives back to the land of Pathʹros, to the land of their origin, and there they will become an insignificant kingdom.

21314.label: Ezekiel 29:15
21314.text: Egypt will become lower than the other kingdoms and will no longer dominate the other nations, and I will make them so small that they will not be able to subdue other nations.

21315.label: Ezekiel 29:16
21315.text: It will never again be a source of confidence for the house of Israel, but it will only remind them of their error in turning to the Egyptians for help. And they will have to know that I am the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”’”

21316.label: Ezekiel 29:17
21316.text: Now in the 27th year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

21317.label: Ezekiel 29:18
21317.text: “Son of man, King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon made his army labor greatly against Tyre. Every head became bald, and every shoulder was rubbed bare. But he and his army received no wages for the labor he expended on Tyre.

21318.label: Ezekiel 29:19
21318.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says, ‘Here I am giving the land of Egypt to King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth and take much spoil and plunder from it; and it will become wages for his army.’

21319.label: Ezekiel 29:20
21319.text: “‘As compensation for his labor against her, I will give him the land of Egypt because they acted for me,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21320.label: Ezekiel 29:21
21320.text: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will give you an opportunity to speak among them; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.”

21321.label: Ezekiel 30:1
21321.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21322.label: Ezekiel 30:2
21322.text: “Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Wail, ‘Alas, the day is coming!’

21323.label: Ezekiel 30:3
21323.text: For the day is near, yes, a day of Jehovah is near. It will be a day of clouds, an appointed time of nations.

21324.label: Ezekiel 30:4
21324.text: A sword will come against Egypt, and panic will overtake E·thi·oʹpi·a when the slain fall in Egypt;Its wealth is taken and its foundations are torn down.

21325.label: Ezekiel 30:5
21325.text: E·thi·oʹpi·a, Put, Lud, and all the mixed populations, And Chub, along with the sons of the land of the covenant, By the sword they will all fall.”’

21326.label: Ezekiel 30:6
21326.text: This is what Jehovah says: ‘The supporters of Egypt will also fall,And its arrogant power will be brought down.’ “‘From Migʹdol to Sy·eʹne they will fall by the sword in the land,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21327.label: Ezekiel 30:7
21327.text: ‘They will be made the most desolate of lands, and its own cities will become the most devastated cities.

21328.label: Ezekiel 30:8
21328.text: And they will have to know that I am Jehovah when I set a fire in Egypt and all its allies are crushed.

21329.label: Ezekiel 30:9
21329.text: In that day I will send messengers in ships to make self-confident E·thi·oʹpi·a tremble; panic will seize them in the day that is coming upon Egypt, for it will surely come.’

21330.label: Ezekiel 30:10
21330.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘I will bring an end to Egypt’s hordes by the hand of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon.

21331.label: Ezekiel 30:11
21331.text: He and his troops, the most ruthless of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.

21332.label: Ezekiel 30:12
21332.text: I will turn the canals of the Nile into dry ground and will sell the land into the hand of wicked men. I will make the land and everything in it desolate by the hand of foreigners. I myself, Jehovah, have spoken.’

21333.label: Ezekiel 30:13
21333.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘I will also destroy the disgusting idols and bring an end to the worthless gods of Noph. There will no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt, and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.

21334.label: Ezekiel 30:14
21334.text: I will desolate Pathʹros and set a fire in Zoʹan and execute judgment on No.

21335.label: Ezekiel 30:15
21335.text: I will pour out my rage on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and destroy the population of No.

21336.label: Ezekiel 30:16
21336.text: I will set a fire in Egypt; and Sin will be seized with terror and No will be broken through and Noph will face attack in broad daylight!

21337.label: Ezekiel 30:17
21337.text: The young men of On and Pi·beʹseth will fall by the sword, and the cities will go into captivity.

21338.label: Ezekiel 30:18
21338.text: In Te·haphʹne·hes the day will grow dark when I break the yoke bars of Egypt there. Her arrogant power will come to an end, clouds will cover her, and her towns will go into captivity.

21339.label: Ezekiel 30:19
21339.text: I will execute judgment on Egypt, and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

21340.label: Ezekiel 30:20
21340.text: And in the 11th year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

21341.label: Ezekiel 30:21
21341.text: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharʹaoh king of Egypt; it will not be bound up to be healed or wrapped with a bandage to make it strong enough to take up the sword.”

21342.label: Ezekiel 30:22
21342.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Here I am against Pharʹaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, the strong one and the broken one, and I will make the sword fall from his hand.

21343.label: Ezekiel 30:23
21343.text: Then I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands.

21344.label: Ezekiel 30:24
21344.text: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword into his hand, and I will break the arms of Pharʹaoh, and he will groan loudly like a dying man before him.

21345.label: Ezekiel 30:25
21345.text: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharʹaoh will fall limp; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he wields it against the land of Egypt.

21346.label: Ezekiel 30:26
21346.text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands, and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

21347.label: Ezekiel 31:1
21347.text: In the 11th year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21348.label: Ezekiel 31:2
21348.text: “Son of man, say to Pharʹaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes, ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?

21349.label: Ezekiel 31:3
21349.text: There was an As·syrʹi·an, a cedar in Lebʹa·non,With beautiful branches like a shady thicket, lofty in stature;Its top was among the clouds.

21350.label: Ezekiel 31:4
21350.text: The waters made it grow big, the deep springs of water caused it to grow high. Streams were all around where it was planted;Their channels watered all the trees of the field.

21351.label: Ezekiel 31:5
21351.text: That is why it grew taller than all the other trees of the field. Its boughs multiplied, and its branches grew longBecause of the abundant water in its streams.

21352.label: Ezekiel 31:6
21352.text: All the birds of the sky nested in its boughs,All the wild animals of the field gave birth under its branches,And all the populous nations were dwelling in its shade.

21353.label: Ezekiel 31:7
21353.text: It became majestic in beauty and in the length of its branches,For its roots went down into abundant waters.

21354.label: Ezekiel 31:8
21354.text: No other cedars in the garden of God could compare to it. None of the juniper trees had boughs like it,And none of the plane trees could match its branches. No other tree in the garden of God could rival its beauty.

21355.label: Ezekiel 31:9
21355.text: I made it beautiful, with abundant foliage,And all the other trees of Eʹden, the garden of the true God, envied it.’

21356.label: Ezekiel 31:10
21356.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because it became so tall, lifting its top among the clouds, and its heart became arrogant because of its height,

21357.label: Ezekiel 31:11
21357.text: I will hand it over to the mighty ruler of the nations. He will surely act against it, and I will reject it for its wickedness.

21358.label: Ezekiel 31:12
21358.text: And foreigners, the most ruthless of the nations, will cut it down, and they will abandon it on the mountains, and its foliage will fall in all the valleys, and its branches will lie broken in all the streams of the land. All the peoples of the earth will depart from its shade and abandon it.

21359.label: Ezekiel 31:13
21359.text: All the birds of the sky will live on its fallen trunk, and all the wild animals of the field on its branches.

21360.label: Ezekiel 31:14
21360.text: This is so that no tree near the waters should grow so tall or lift up its top among the clouds and that no well-watered tree may reach up to them in height. For they will all be given over to death, to the land down below, along with the sons of mankind, who are going down into the pit.’

21361.label: Ezekiel 31:15
21361.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘On the day it goes down to the Grave, I will cause a mourning. Therefore, I will cover over the deep waters and hold back its streams so that the abundant waters are restrained. I will darken Lebʹa·non because of it, and the trees of the field will all wither away.

21362.label: Ezekiel 31:16
21362.text: At the sound of its downfall, I will cause nations to shudder when I bring it down to the Grave along with all those going down into the pit, and all the trees of Eʹden, the choicest and the best of Lebʹa·non, all that are well-watered, will be comforted in the land down below.

21363.label: Ezekiel 31:17
21363.text: They have gone down to the Grave with him, to those slain by the sword, together with his supporters who lived in his shadow among the nations.’

21364.label: Ezekiel 31:18
21364.text: “‘Which of the trees of Eʹden was like you in glory and greatness? But you will certainly be brought down with the trees of Eʹden to the land down below. You will lie down among the uncircumcised ones, with those slain by the sword. This will happen to Pharʹaoh and all his hordes,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21365.label: Ezekiel 32:1
21365.text: And in the 12th year, in the 12th month, on the first day of the month, the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21366.label: Ezekiel 32:2
21366.text: “Son of man, sing a dirge concerning Pharʹaoh king of Egypt, and say to him,‘You were like a strong young lion of the nations,But you have been silenced. You were like a sea monster, thrashing about in your rivers,Muddying the waters with your feet and fouling the rivers.’

21367.label: Ezekiel 32:3
21367.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘By means of an assembly of many nations I will cast my net over you,And they will haul you up in my dragnet.

21368.label: Ezekiel 32:4
21368.text: I will abandon you on the land;I will cast you onto the open field. I will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you,And I will satisfy the wild beasts of the whole earth with you.

21369.label: Ezekiel 32:5
21369.text: I will cast your flesh on the mountainsAnd fill the valleys with your remains.

21370.label: Ezekiel 32:6
21370.text: I will drench the land with your gushing blood up to the mountains,And it will fill the streams.’

21371.label: Ezekiel 32:7
21371.text: ‘And when you are extinguished I will cover the heavens and darken their stars. I will cover the sun with clouds,And the moon will not give its light.

21372.label: Ezekiel 32:8
21372.text: I will darken all the shining luminaries in the heavens because of you,And I will cover your land with darkness,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21373.label: Ezekiel 32:9
21373.text: ‘I will distress the hearts of many peoples when I lead your captives to other nations,To lands that you have not known.

21374.label: Ezekiel 32:10
21374.text: I will cause many peoples to be awestruck,And their kings will shudder in horror over you when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble continually, each fearing for his life,On the day of your downfall.’

21375.label: Ezekiel 32:11
21375.text: For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come upon you.

21376.label: Ezekiel 32:12
21376.text: I will cause your hordes to fall by the swords of mighty warriors,The most ruthless of the nations, all of them. They will bring down the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be annihilated.

21377.label: Ezekiel 32:13
21377.text: I will destroy all her livestock beside her abundant waters, And no foot of a human or hoof of the livestock will muddy them again.’

21378.label: Ezekiel 32:14
21378.text: ‘At that time I will clear up their waters,And I will make their rivers flow like oil,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21379.label: Ezekiel 32:15
21379.text: ‘When I make Egypt a desolate wasteland, a land stripped of all that filled it, When I strike down all the inhabitants in it,They will have to know that I am Jehovah.

21380.label: Ezekiel 32:16
21380.text: This is a dirge, and people will certainly chant it;The daughters of the nations will chant it. They will chant it over Egypt and over all its hordes,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21381.label: Ezekiel 32:17
21381.text: Then in the 12th year, on the 15th day of the month, the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

21382.label: Ezekiel 32:18
21382.text: “Son of man, wail over the hordes of Egypt and bring her down to the land below, her and the daughters of mighty nations, with those going down into the pit.

21383.label: Ezekiel 32:19
21383.text: “‘Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down, and lie with the uncircumcised ones!’

21384.label: Ezekiel 32:20
21384.text: “‘They will fall among those slain by the sword. She has been given to the sword; drag her away along with all her hordes.

21385.label: Ezekiel 32:21
21385.text: “‘From the depths of the Grave the mightiest warriors will speak to him and his helpers. They will certainly go down and will lie just like the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

21386.label: Ezekiel 32:22
21386.text: As·syrʹi·a is there with all her assembly. Their graves are all around him, all of them fallen by the sword.

21387.label: Ezekiel 32:23
21387.text: Her graves are in the depths of the pit, and her assembly is all around her grave, all of them struck down by the sword, because they caused terror in the land of the living.

21388.label: Ezekiel 32:24
