21388.text: “‘Eʹlam is there with all her hordes around her grave, all of them fallen by the sword. They have gone down uncircumcised to the land below, those who caused terror in the land of the living. Now they will bear their shame with those going down into the pit.

21389.label: Ezekiel 32:25
21389.text: They have made a bed for her among the slain, along with all her hordes around her graves. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they caused terror in the land of the living; and they will bear their shame with those going down into the pit. He has been put among the slain.

21390.label: Ezekiel 32:26
21390.text: “‘There is where Meʹshech and Tuʹbal and all their hordes are. Their graves are all around him. All of them are uncircumcised, pierced through by the sword, because they caused terror in the land of the living.

21391.label: Ezekiel 32:27
21391.text: Will they not lie with mighty uncircumcised warriors who have fallen, who went down to the Grave with their weapons of war? And they will put their swords under their heads and their sins on their bones, because these mighty warriors terrorized the land of the living.

21392.label: Ezekiel 32:28
21392.text: But as for you, you will be crushed among the uncircumcised ones, and you will lie with those who were slain by the sword.

21393.label: Ezekiel 32:29
21393.text: “‘Eʹdom is there, her kings and all her chieftains, who despite their mightiness, were laid among those slain by the sword; they too will lie with the uncircumcised ones and with those going down into the pit.

21394.label: Ezekiel 32:30
21394.text: “‘There all the princes of the north are, along with all the Si·doʹni·ans, who have gone down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror caused by their mightiness. They will lie uncircumcised with those who were slain by the sword and will bear their shame with those going down into the pit.

21395.label: Ezekiel 32:31
21395.text: “‘Pharʹaoh will see all of these, and he will be comforted over all that happened to his hordes; Pharʹaoh and all his army will be slain by the sword,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21396.label: Ezekiel 32:32
21396.text: “‘Because he caused terror in the land of the living, Pharʹaoh and all his hordes will be laid to rest with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21397.label: Ezekiel 33:1
21397.text: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

21398.label: Ezekiel 33:2
21398.text: “Son of man, speak to the sons of your people, and say to them,“‘Suppose that I bring a sword upon a land, and all the people of that land take a man and make him their watchman,

21399.label: Ezekiel 33:3
21399.text: and he sees the sword coming upon the land and blows the horn and warns the people.

21400.label: Ezekiel 33:4
21400.text: If someone hears the sound of the horn but does not heed the warning and a sword comes and takes his life, his blood will be on his own head.

21401.label: Ezekiel 33:5
21401.text: He heard the sound of the horn, but he did not heed the warning. His blood will be upon himself. If he had heeded the warning, his life would have been saved.

21402.label: Ezekiel 33:6
21402.text: “‘But if the watchman sees the sword coming and he does not blow the horn and the people receive no warning and a sword comes and takes the life of one of them, that person will die for his own error, but I will ask his blood back from the watchman.’

21403.label: Ezekiel 33:7
21403.text: “As for you, son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman to the house of Israel; and when you hear a word from my mouth you must warn them from me.

21404.label: Ezekiel 33:8
21404.text: When I say to someone wicked, ‘Wicked one, you will surely die!’ but you do not speak out to warn the wicked one to change his course, he will die as a wicked man because of his own error, but I will ask his blood back from you.

21405.label: Ezekiel 33:9
21405.text: But if you warn someone wicked to turn back from his way and he refuses to change his course, he will die for his error, but you will certainly save your own life.

21406.label: Ezekiel 33:10
21406.text: “And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, ‘You have said: “Our revolts and our sins weigh heavily upon us, causing us to waste away; so how will we keep living?”’

21407.label: Ezekiel 33:11
21407.text: Tell them, ‘“As surely as I am alive,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, “I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that someone wicked changes his way and keeps living. Turn back, turn back from your bad ways, for why should you die, O house of Israel?”’

21408.label: Ezekiel 33:12
21408.text: “And you, son of man, tell the sons of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous man will not save him when he revolts; nor will the wickedness of the wicked man make him stumble when he turns away from his wickedness; nor will anyone righteous be able to keep living because of his righteousness in the day that he sins.

21409.label: Ezekiel 33:13
21409.text: When I say to the righteous one: “You will surely keep living,” and he trusts in his own righteousness and does what is wrong, none of his righteous acts will be remembered, but he will die for the wrong that he has done.

21410.label: Ezekiel 33:14
21410.text: “‘And when I say to the wicked one: “You will surely die,” and he turns away from his sin and does what is just and righteous,

21411.label: Ezekiel 33:15
21411.text: and the wicked one returns what was taken in pledge and pays back what was taken by robbery, and he walks in the statutes of life by not doing what is wrong, he will surely keep living. He will not die.

21412.label: Ezekiel 33:16
21412.text: None of the sins he committed will be held against him. For doing what is just and righteous, he will surely keep living.’

21413.label: Ezekiel 33:17
21413.text: “But your people have said, ‘The way of Jehovah is unjust,’ when it is actually their way that is unjust.

21414.label: Ezekiel 33:18
21414.text: “When someone righteous abandons his righteousness and does what is wrong, he must die for it.

21415.label: Ezekiel 33:19
21415.text: But when someone wicked turns away from his wickedness and does what is just and righteous, he will keep living for doing so.

21416.label: Ezekiel 33:20
21416.text: “But you have said, ‘The way of Jehovah is unjust.’ I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.”

21417.label: Ezekiel 33:21
21417.text: At length in the 12th year, in the tenth month, on the fifth day of the month of our exile, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said: “The city has been struck down!”

21418.label: Ezekiel 33:22
21418.text: Now the evening before the escaped man came, the hand of Jehovah had come upon me, and he had opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened, and I was no longer speechless.

21419.label: Ezekiel 33:23
21419.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

21420.label: Ezekiel 33:24
21420.text: “Son of man, the inhabitants of these ruins are saying concerning the land of Israel, ‘Abraham was just one man, and yet he took possession of the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’

21421.label: Ezekiel 33:25
21421.text: “Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “You are eating food with the blood, and you lift up your eyes to your disgusting idols, and you keep shedding blood. So why should you possess the land?

21422.label: Ezekiel 33:26
21422.text: You have relied on your sword, you engage in detestable practices, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. So why should you possess the land?”’

21423.label: Ezekiel 33:27
21423.text: “This is what you should say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “As surely as I am alive, those living in the ruins will fall by the sword; those in the open field, I will give as food to the wild beasts; and those in the strongholds and the caves will die by disease.

21424.label: Ezekiel 33:28
21424.text: I will make the land an utterly desolate wasteland, and its arrogant pride will be brought to an end, and the mountains of Israel will be desolated, with no one passing through.

21425.label: Ezekiel 33:29
21425.text: And they will have to know that I am Jehovah when I make the land an utterly desolate wasteland because of all the detestable things that they have done.”’

21426.label: Ezekiel 33:30
21426.text: “As for you, son of man, your people are speaking with one another about you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses. They are saying to each other, each to his brother, ‘Come, and let us hear the word that comes from Jehovah.’

21427.label: Ezekiel 33:31
21427.text: They will crowd in to sit before you as my people; and they will hear your words, but they will not do them. For with their mouth they flatter you, but their heart is greedy for dishonest gain.

21428.label: Ezekiel 33:32
21428.text: Look! You are to them like a romantic love song, sung with a beautiful voice and skillfully played on a stringed instrument. They will hear your words, but no one will act on them.

21429.label: Ezekiel 33:33
21429.text: And when it comes true—and it will come true—they will have to know that a prophet has been among them.”

21430.label: Ezekiel 34:1
21430.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21431.label: Ezekiel 34:2
21431.text: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and say to the shepherds, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who have been feeding themselves! Is it not the flock that the shepherds should feed?

21432.label: Ezekiel 34:3
21432.text: You eat the fat, you clothe yourselves with the wool, and you slaughter the fattest animal, but you do not feed the flock.

21433.label: Ezekiel 34:4
21433.text: You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bandaged the injured or brought back the strays or looked for the lost; rather, you have ruled them with harshness and tyranny.

21434.label: Ezekiel 34:5
21434.text: So they were scattered because there was no shepherd; they were scattered and became food for every wild beast of the field.

21435.label: Ezekiel 34:6
21435.text: My sheep were straying on all the mountains and on every high hill; my sheep were scattered over all the surface of the earth, with no one searching for them or seeking to find them.

21436.label: Ezekiel 34:7
21436.text: “‘“Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:

21437.label: Ezekiel 34:8
21437.text: ‘“As surely as I am alive,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, “because my sheep have become prey, food for every wild beast of the field, for there was no shepherd, and my shepherds did not search for my sheep; rather, they kept feeding themselves and did not feed my sheep,”’

21438.label: Ezekiel 34:9
21438.text: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah.

21439.label: Ezekiel 34:10
21439.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘I am against the shepherds, and I will demand an accounting of them for my sheep, and I will dismiss them from feeding my sheep, and the shepherds will no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my sheep from their mouth, and they will no longer be food for them.’”

21440.label: Ezekiel 34:11
21440.text: “‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am, and I myself will search for my sheep, and I will care for them.

21441.label: Ezekiel 34:12
21441.text: I will care for my sheep like a shepherd who has found his scattered sheep and is feeding them. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered in the day of clouds and thick gloom.

21442.label: Ezekiel 34:13
21442.text: I will bring them out from the peoples and collect them together from the lands and bring them into their land and feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the streams and by all the dwelling places of the land.

21443.label: Ezekiel 34:14
21443.text: In a good pasture I will feed them, and the land where they graze will be on Israel’s high mountains. They will lie down there in a good grazing land, and they will feed on choice pastures on the mountains of Israel.”

21444.label: Ezekiel 34:15
21444.text: “‘“I myself will feed my sheep, and I myself will make them lie down,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21445.label: Ezekiel 34:16
21445.text: “The lost one I will search for, the stray I will bring back, the injured I will bandage, and the weak I will strengthen; but the fat one and the strong one I will annihilate. I will feed that one with judgment.”

21446.label: Ezekiel 34:17
21446.text: “‘As for you, my sheep, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I am about to judge between one sheep and another sheep, between the rams and the male goats.

21447.label: Ezekiel 34:18
21447.text: Is it not enough for you to feed on the very best pastures? Must you also trample the rest of your pastures with your feet? And after drinking the clearest water, must you foul the water by stamping with your feet?

21448.label: Ezekiel 34:19
21448.text: Should my sheep now feed on the pasture trampled by your feet and drink the water befouled by the stamping of your feet?”

21449.label: Ezekiel 34:20
21449.text: “‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says to them: “Here I am, and I myself will judge between a fat sheep and a lean sheep,

21450.label: Ezekiel 34:21
21450.text: for with your flank and shoulder you kept pushing, and with your horns you kept shoving all the sick ones until you had scattered them abroad.

21451.label: Ezekiel 34:22
21451.text: And I will save my sheep, and they will no longer become something to prey upon; and I will judge between a sheep and a sheep.

21452.label: Ezekiel 34:23
21452.text: I will raise up one shepherd over them, my servant David, and he will feed them. He himself will feed them and become their shepherd.

21453.label: Ezekiel 34:24
21453.text: And I, Jehovah, will become their God, and my servant David a chieftain among them. I myself, Jehovah, have spoken.

21454.label: Ezekiel 34:25
21454.text: “‘“And I will make a covenant of peace with them, and I will rid the land of vicious wild beasts, so that they may dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forests.

21455.label: Ezekiel 34:26
21455.text: I will make them and the area around my hill a blessing, and I will cause the rain to fall at the proper time. Blessings will pour down like the rains.

21456.label: Ezekiel 34:27
21456.text: The trees of the field will yield their fruit, and the soil will give its produce, and they will dwell securely on the land. And they will have to know that I am Jehovah when I break their yoke bars and rescue them from those who enslaved them.

21457.label: Ezekiel 34:28
21457.text: They will no longer become something for the nations to prey upon, and the wild beasts of the earth will not devour them, and they will dwell in security, with no one to make them afraid.

21458.label: Ezekiel 34:29
21458.text: “‘“I will establish for them a plantation of fame, and they will no longer die from famine in the land, and they will no longer be humiliated by the nations.

21459.label: Ezekiel 34:30
21459.text: ‘Then they will have to know that I, Jehovah their God, am with them and that they, the house of Israel, are my people,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”’

21460.label: Ezekiel 34:31
21460.text: “‘As for you, my sheep, the sheep that I care for, you are but men, and I am your God,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21461.label: Ezekiel 35:1
21461.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21462.label: Ezekiel 35:2
21462.text: “Son of man, turn your face toward the mountainous region of Seʹir, and prophesy against it.

21463.label: Ezekiel 35:3
21463.text: Say to it, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am against you, O mountainous region of Seʹir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate wasteland.

21464.label: Ezekiel 35:4
21464.text: I will turn your cities into ruins, and you will become a desolate wasteland; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.

21465.label: Ezekiel 35:5
21465.text: For you showed unrelenting hostility, and you gave the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their disaster, at the time of their final punishment.”’

21466.label: Ezekiel 35:6
21466.text: “‘Therefore as surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘I will prepare you for bloodshed, and bloodshed will pursue you. Since it was blood that you hated, bloodshed will pursue you.

21467.label: Ezekiel 35:7
21467.text: I will make the mountainous region of Seʹir a desolate wasteland, and I will cut off from it anyone passing through and anyone returning.

21468.label: Ezekiel 35:8
21468.text: I will fill its mountains with the slain; and those slain by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your streams.

21469.label: Ezekiel 35:9
21469.text: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21470.label: Ezekiel 35:10
21470.text: “Because you said, ‘These two nations and these two lands will become mine, and we will take possession of both,’ even though Jehovah himself was there,

21471.label: Ezekiel 35:11
21471.text: ‘therefore as surely as I am alive,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘I will deal with you according to the same anger and jealousy that you displayed in your hatred toward them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

21472.label: Ezekiel 35:12
21472.text: You will then have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have heard all the insolent things you spoke against the mountains of Israel when you said, “They have been laid desolate and have been given to us to devour.”

21473.label: Ezekiel 35:13
21473.text: And you spoke arrogantly against me, and you multiplied your words against me. I heard it all.’

21474.label: Ezekiel 35:14
21474.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘The whole earth will rejoice when I will make you a desolate wasteland.

21475.label: Ezekiel 35:15
21475.text: Just as you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel was laid desolate, that is how I will deal with you. You will become a desolate ruin, O mountainous region of Seʹir, yes, all of Eʹdom; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

21476.label: Ezekiel 36:1
21476.text: “As for you, son of man, prophesy about the mountains of Israel and say, ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of Jehovah.

21477.label: Ezekiel 36:2
21477.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “The enemy has said against you, ‘Aha! Even the ancient high places have become our possession!’”’

21478.label: Ezekiel 36:3
21478.text: “So prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Because they have desolated and attacked you from every direction, so that you would become a possession of the survivors from among the nations and people keep talking about you and slandering you,

21479.label: Ezekiel 36:4
21479.text: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah! This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says to the mountains and the hills, to the streams and the valleys, to the ruins that were desolated, and to the abandoned cities that have been plundered and ridiculed by the survivors of the nations around them;

21480.label: Ezekiel 36:5
21480.text: to these the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘In the fire of my zeal I will speak against the survivors of the nations and against all Eʹdom, those who with great rejoicing and utter scorn have claimed my land as their own possession, to take over its pastures and to plunder it.’”’

21481.label: Ezekiel 36:6
21481.text: “So prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the streams and to the valleys, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Look! I will speak in my zeal and in my rage, because you have borne humiliation by the nations.”’

21482.label: Ezekiel 36:7
21482.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘I myself raise my hand in an oath that the surrounding nations will themselves bear their own shame.

21483.label: Ezekiel 36:8
21483.text: But you, O mountains of Israel, will produce branches and bear your fruitage for my people Israel, for they will soon return.

21484.label: Ezekiel 36:9
21484.text: For I am with you, and I will turn toward you, and you will be cultivated and sown with seed.

21485.label: Ezekiel 36:10
21485.text: I will multiply your people—the whole house of Israel, all of it—and the cities will be inhabited and the ruins will be rebuilt.

21486.label: Ezekiel 36:11
21486.text: Yes, I will multiply your people and your livestock; they will increase and be fruitful. And I will cause you to be inhabited as you were formerly, and I will make you prosper more than in the past; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.

21487.label: Ezekiel 36:12
21487.text: I will cause people—my people Israel—to walk upon you, and they will take possession of you. You will become their inheritance, and you will never again make them childless.’”

21488.label: Ezekiel 36:13
21488.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Because they are saying to you, “You are a land that devours people and bereaves your nations of children,”’

21489.label: Ezekiel 36:14
21489.text: ‘therefore, you will no longer devour people or make your nations childless,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21490.label: Ezekiel 36:15
21490.text: ‘I will not subject you to any more insults of the nations or make you bear the taunts of people, and you will no longer cause your nations to stumble,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21491.label: Ezekiel 36:16
21491.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21492.label: Ezekiel 36:17
21492.text: “Son of man, when the house of Israel was dwelling in their land, they made it unclean by their ways and their dealings. Their ways were like the uncleanness of menstruation to me.

21493.label: Ezekiel 36:18
21493.text: So I poured out my rage on them because of the blood that they had shed upon the land and because they made the land unclean with their disgusting idols.

21494.label: Ezekiel 36:19
21494.text: So I scattered them among the nations and dispersed them among the lands. I judged them according to their way and according to their dealings.

21495.label: Ezekiel 36:20
21495.text: But when they came to those nations, people profaned my holy name by saying about them, ‘These are the people of Jehovah, but they had to leave his land.’

21496.label: Ezekiel 36:21
21496.text: So I will show concern for my holy name, which the house of Israel profaned among the nations where they have gone.”

21497.label: Ezekiel 36:22
21497.text: “Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Not for your sakes am I acting, O house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you have gone.”’

21498.label: Ezekiel 36:23
21498.text: ‘I will certainly sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the nations, which you profaned among them; and the nations will have to know that I am Jehovah,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘when I am sanctified among you before their eyes.

21499.label: Ezekiel 36:24
21499.text: I will take you from the nations and gather you back from all the lands and bring you into your land.

21500.label: Ezekiel 36:25
21500.text: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will become clean; I will cleanse you from all your uncleanness and from all your disgusting idols.

21501.label: Ezekiel 36:26
21501.text: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit inside you. I will remove the heart of stone from your body and give you a heart of flesh.

21502.label: Ezekiel 36:27
21502.text: I will put my spirit inside you, and I will cause you to walk in my regulations, and you will observe and carry out my judicial decisions.

21503.label: Ezekiel 36:28
21503.text: Then you will dwell in the land that I gave to your forefathers, and you will be my people and I will be your God.’

21504.label: Ezekiel 36:29
21504.text: “‘I will save you from all your uncleanness and summon the grain and make it abound, and I will not bring famine upon you.

21505.label: Ezekiel 36:30
21505.text: I will make the fruitage of the tree and the produce of the field abound, so that you may never again suffer the disgrace of famine among the nations.

21506.label: Ezekiel 36:31
21506.text: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves because of your guilt and your detestable practices.

21507.label: Ezekiel 36:32
21507.text: But know this: I am not doing this for your sakes,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. ‘Instead, be ashamed and feel humiliated because of your ways, O house of Israel.’

21508.label: Ezekiel 36:33
21508.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘In the day that I cleanse you from all your guilt, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the ruins to be rebuilt.

21509.label: Ezekiel 36:34
21509.text: The desolate land that was lying desolate for everyone passing by to see will be cultivated.

21510.label: Ezekiel 36:35
21510.text: And people will say: “The desolate land has become like the garden of Eʹden, and the cities that were in ruins and desolate and torn down are now fortified and inhabited.”

21511.label: Ezekiel 36:36
21511.text: And the nations that are left remaining around you will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have built what was torn down, and I have planted what was desolate. I myself, Jehovah, have spoken, and I have done it.’

21512.label: Ezekiel 36:37
21512.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘I will also let the house of Israel ask me to do this for them: I will multiply their people like a flock.

21513.label: Ezekiel 36:38
21513.text: Like the flock of holy ones, like the flock of Jerusalem during her festivals, the cities that were in ruins will become full of flocks of people; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

21514.label: Ezekiel 37:1
21514.text: The hand of Jehovah was upon me, and by his spirit Jehovah took me and set me down in the middle of the valley plain, and it was full of bones.

21515.label: Ezekiel 37:2
21515.text: He had me pass all around them, and I saw that there were very many bones lying in the valley plain, and they were very dry.

21516.label: Ezekiel 37:3
21516.text: He asked me: “Son of man, can these bones come to life?” To that I said: “Sovereign Lord Jehovah, you are the one who knows.”

21517.label: Ezekiel 37:4
21517.text: So he said to me: “Prophesy over these bones, and say to them, ‘You dry bones, hear the word of Jehovah:

21518.label: Ezekiel 37:5
21518.text: “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says to these bones: “I will cause breath to enter you, and you will come to life.

21519.label: Ezekiel 37:6
21519.text: I will put sinews and flesh on you, and I will cover you with skin and put breath in you, and you will come to life; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.”’”

21520.label: Ezekiel 37:7
21520.text: Then I prophesied just as I had been commanded. As soon as I prophesied, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones began to come together, bone to bone.

21521.label: Ezekiel 37:8
21521.text: Then I saw sinews and flesh come on them, and skin covered over them. But there was still no breath in them.

21522.label: Ezekiel 37:9
21522.text: He then said to me: “Prophesy to the wind. Prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “From the four winds come in, O wind, and blow upon these people who were killed, so that they may come to life.”’”

21523.label: Ezekiel 37:10
21523.text: So I prophesied just as he commanded me, and breath came into them, and they began to live and to stand on their feet, an extremely large army.

21524.label: Ezekiel 37:11
21524.text: Then he said to me: “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Here they are saying, ‘Our bones are dry, and our hope has perished. We are completely cut off.’

21525.label: Ezekiel 37:12
21525.text: So prophesy and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I will open your graves and raise you up from your graves, my people, and bring you to the land of Israel.

21526.label: Ezekiel 37:13
21526.text: And you will have to know that I am Jehovah when I open your graves and when I raise you up out of your graves, O my people.”’

21527.label: Ezekiel 37:14
21527.text: ‘I will put my spirit in you and you will come to life, and I will settle you on your land; and you will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have spoken and I have done it,’ declares Jehovah.”

21528.label: Ezekiel 37:15
21528.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21529.label: Ezekiel 37:16
21529.text: “And you, son of man, take a stick and write on it, ‘For Judah and for the people of Israel who are with him.’ Then take another stick and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Eʹphra·im, and all the house of Israel who are with him.’

21530.label: Ezekiel 37:17
21530.text: Then bring them close to each other so that they become just one stick in your hand.

21531.label: Ezekiel 37:18
21531.text: When your people say to you, ‘Will you not tell us what these things mean?’

21532.label: Ezekiel 37:19
21532.text: tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Eʹphra·im, and the tribes of Israel who are with him, and I will join them to the stick of Judah; and I will make them one stick, and they will become one in my hand.”’

21533.label: Ezekiel 37:20
21533.text: The sticks that you write on should be in your hand for them to see.

21534.label: Ezekiel 37:21
21534.text: “Then tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I will take the Israelites from among the nations where they have gone, and I will collect them together from every direction and bring them to their land.

21535.label: Ezekiel 37:22
21535.text: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel, and one king will rule over all of them, and they will no longer be two nations; nor will they be divided any longer into two kingdoms.

21536.label: Ezekiel 37:23
21536.text: They will no longer defile themselves with their disgusting idols and their detestable practices and all their transgressions. I will save them from all their unfaithfulness by which they have sinned, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I myself will be their God.

21537.label: Ezekiel 37:24
21537.text: “‘“My servant David will be their king, and they will all have one shepherd. They will walk in my judicial decisions and carefully observe my statutes.

21538.label: Ezekiel 37:25
21538.text: They will dwell on the land that I gave to my servant, to Jacob, where your forefathers lived, and they will dwell on it forever, they and their children and their children’s children; and David my servant will be their chieftain forever.

21539.label: Ezekiel 37:26
21539.text: “‘“And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an eternal covenant with them. I will establish them and make them many and place my sanctuary among them forever.

21540.label: Ezekiel 37:27
21540.text: My tent will be with them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people.

21541.label: Ezekiel 37:28
21541.text: And the nations will have to know that I, Jehovah, am sanctifying Israel when my sanctuary is in their midst forever.”’”

21542.label: Ezekiel 38:1
21542.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

21543.label: Ezekiel 38:2
21543.text: “Son of man, set your face against Gog of the land of Maʹgog, the head chieftain of Meʹshech and Tuʹbal, and prophesy against him.

21544.label: Ezekiel 38:3
21544.text: Say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am against you, O Gog, head chieftain of Meʹshech and Tuʹbal.

21545.label: Ezekiel 38:4
21545.text: I will turn you around and put hooks in your jaws and bring you out with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in splendor, a vast assembly with large shields and bucklers, all of them wielding swords;

21546.label: Ezekiel 38:5
21546.text: Persia, E·thi·oʹpi·a, and Put are with them, all of them with buckler and helmet;

21547.label: Ezekiel 38:6
21547.text: Goʹmer and all its troops, the house of To·garʹmah from the remotest parts of the north, along with all its troops—many peoples are with you.

21548.label: Ezekiel 38:7
21548.text: “‘“Be ready, prepare yourselves, you with all your armies that are assembled with you, and you will be their commander.

21549.label: Ezekiel 38:8
21549.text: “‘“You will be given attention after many days. In the final part of the years you will invade the land whose people have been restored from the ravages of the sword, collected together out of many peoples onto the mountains of Israel, which had long been lying devastated. The inhabitants of this land were restored from the peoples, and all of them dwell in security.

21550.label: Ezekiel 38:9
21550.text: You will come against them like a storm, and you will cover the land like clouds, you and all your troops and many peoples with you.”’

21551.label: Ezekiel 38:10
21551.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘In that day thoughts will come into your heart, and you will devise an evil plan.

21552.label: Ezekiel 38:11
21552.text: You will say: “I will invade the land of unprotected settlements. I will come against those living in security, without disturbance, all of them living in settlements unprotected by walls, bars, or gates.”

21553.label: Ezekiel 38:12
21553.text: It will be to take much spoil and plunder, to attack the devastated places that are now inhabited and a people regathered from the nations, who are accumulating wealth and property, those who are living in the center of the earth.

21554.label: Ezekiel 38:13
21554.text: “‘Sheʹba and Deʹdan, the merchants of Tarʹshish and all its warriors will say to you: “Are you invading to get much spoil and plunder? Have you assembled your armies to carry off silver and gold, to take wealth and property, to seize a very great spoil?”’

21555.label: Ezekiel 38:14
21555.text: “So prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “On that day when my people Israel are dwelling in security, will you not know it?

21556.label: Ezekiel 38:15
21556.text: You will come from your place, from the remotest parts of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great assembly, a vast army.

21557.label: Ezekiel 38:16
21557.text: Like clouds covering the land, you will come against my people Israel. In the final part of the days I will bring you against my land so that the nations may know me when I sanctify myself through you before their eyes, O Gog.”’

21558.label: Ezekiel 38:17
21558.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Are you not the same one I spoke about in the former days through my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied for many years that you would be brought against them?’

21559.label: Ezekiel 38:18
21559.text: “‘On that day, the day when Gog invades the land of Israel,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘my great rage will flare up.

21560.label: Ezekiel 38:19
21560.text: In my zeal, in the fire of my fury, I will speak; and in that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

21561.label: Ezekiel 38:20
21561.text: Because of me the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the wild beasts of the field, all the reptiles that creep on the ground, and all humans on the surface of the earth will tremble, and the mountains will be thrown down, and the cliffs will fall, and every wall will collapse to the ground.’

21562.label: Ezekiel 38:21
21562.text: “‘I will call for a sword against him on all my mountains,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. ‘Every man’s sword will be against his own brother.

21563.label: Ezekiel 38:22
21563.text: I will bring my judgment against him with pestilence and bloodshed; and I will rain down a torrential downpour and hailstones and fire and sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many peoples with him.

21564.label: Ezekiel 38:23
21564.text: And I will certainly magnify myself and sanctify myself and make myself known before the eyes of many nations; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21565.label: Ezekiel 39:1
21565.text: “And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and tell him, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “I am against you, Gog, head chieftain of Meʹshech and Tuʹbal.

21566.label: Ezekiel 39:2
21566.text: I will turn you around and lead you and make you come up from the remotest parts of the north and bring you in upon the mountains of Israel.

21567.label: Ezekiel 39:3
21567.text: I will knock your bow out of your left hand and make your arrows fall from your right hand.

21568.label: Ezekiel 39:4
21568.text: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the peoples who will be with you. I will give you as food to all kinds of birds of prey and the wild beasts of the field.”’

21569.label: Ezekiel 39:5
21569.text: “‘You will fall on the open field, for I myself have spoken,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21570.label: Ezekiel 39:6
21570.text: “‘And I will send fire against Maʹgog and against those who are inhabiting the islands in security, and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.

21571.label: Ezekiel 39:7
21571.text: I will make my holy name known among my people Israel, and I will not allow my holy name to be profaned any longer; and the nations will have to know that I am Jehovah, the Holy One in Israel.’

21572.label: Ezekiel 39:8
21572.text: “‘Yes, this is coming, and it will be done,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. ‘This is the day I have spoken about.

21573.label: Ezekiel 39:9
21573.text: The inhabitants of the cities of Israel will go out and make fires with the weapons—the bucklers and shields, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and lances. And they will use them to light fires for seven years.

21574.label: Ezekiel 39:10
21574.text: They will not need to take wood from the field or gather firewood from the forests because they will use the weapons to light fires.’ “‘They will take spoil from those who despoiled them and plunder from those who had been plundering them,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21575.label: Ezekiel 39:11
21575.text: “‘On that day I will give Gog a burial place there in Israel, in the valley of those who travel east of the sea, and it will block the path of those passing through. That is where they will bury Gog and all his hordes, and they will call it the Valley of Haʹmon-Gog.

21576.label: Ezekiel 39:12
21576.text: The house of Israel will spend seven months burying them in order to cleanse the land.

21577.label: Ezekiel 39:13
21577.text: All the people of the land will work at burying them, and this will bring them fame in the day that I glorify myself,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21578.label: Ezekiel 39:14
21578.text: “‘Men will be assigned to pass through the land constantly and bury the bodies left remaining on the surface of the earth, in order to cleanse it. They will continue the search for seven months.

21579.label: Ezekiel 39:15
21579.text: When those who pass through the land see a human bone, they will set up a marker beside it. Then those assigned to do the burying will bury it in the Valley of Haʹmon-Gog.

21580.label: Ezekiel 39:16
21580.text: And there will also be a city there named Ha·moʹnah. And they will cleanse the land.’

21581.label: Ezekiel 39:17
21581.text: “As for you, son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘Say to every sort of bird and to all the wild beasts of the field, “Gather yourselves together and come. Gather all around my sacrifice that I am preparing for you, a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. You will eat flesh and drink blood.

21582.label: Ezekiel 39:18
21582.text: You will eat the flesh of mighty ones and drink the blood of the chieftains of the earth—the rams, lambs, goats, and bulls—all the fattened animals of Baʹshan.

21583.label: Ezekiel 39:19
21583.text: You will gorge yourselves on fat and drink blood until you are drunk from the sacrifice that I prepare for you.”’

21584.label: Ezekiel 39:20
21584.text: “‘At my table you will be filled up with horses and charioteers, mighty ones and all sorts of warriors,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21585.label: Ezekiel 39:21
21585.text: “‘I will display my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the judgment that I have executed and the power that I have demonstrated among them.

21586.label: Ezekiel 39:22
21586.text: From that day on the house of Israel will have to know that I am Jehovah their God.

21587.label: Ezekiel 39:23
21587.text: And the nations will have to know that the house of Israel went into exile because of their own error, because they were unfaithful to me. So I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.

21588.label: Ezekiel 39:24
21588.text: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their transgressions, and I hid my face from them.’

21589.label: Ezekiel 39:25
21589.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘I will restore the captives of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel; and I will zealously defend my holy name.

21590.label: Ezekiel 39:26
21590.text: After they have been humiliated for all their unfaithfulness toward me, they will dwell securely on their land, with no one to make them afraid.

21591.label: Ezekiel 39:27
21591.text: When I bring them back from the peoples and collect them together from the lands of their enemies, I will also sanctify myself among them before the eyes of many nations.’

21592.label: Ezekiel 39:28
21592.text: “‘They will have to know that I am Jehovah their God when I send them into exile among the nations and then gather them back to their land, not leaving any of them behind.

21593.label: Ezekiel 39:29
21593.text: I will not hide my face from them any longer, for I will pour out my spirit on the house of Israel,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21594.label: Ezekiel 40:1
21594.text: In the 25th year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month, in the 14th year after the city had fallen, on that very day the hand of Jehovah was upon me, and he took me to the city.

21595.label: Ezekiel 40:2
21595.text: By means of visions from God, he brought me to the land of Israel and set me down on a very high mountain, on which there was a structure like a city to the south.

21596.label: Ezekiel 40:3
21596.text: When he brought me there, I saw a man whose appearance was like that of copper. He had a flax cord and a measuring reed in his hand, and he was standing in the gateway.

21597.label: Ezekiel 40:4
21597.text: The man said to me: “Son of man, look closely, listen carefully, and pay attention to everything I show you, for that is why you were brought here. Tell the house of Israel everything that you see.”

21598.label: Ezekiel 40:5
21598.text: I saw a wall surrounding the outside of the temple. In the man’s hand was a measuring reed six cubits long (to each cubit, a handbreadth was added). He began to measure the wall, and its thickness was one reed and its height was one reed.

21599.label: Ezekiel 40:6
21599.text: Then he came to the gate that faced east and climbed its steps. When he measured the threshold of the gate, its width was one reed, and the width of the other threshold was also one reed.

21600.label: Ezekiel 40:7
21600.text: Each guard chamber was one reed long and one reed wide, and there were five cubits between the guard chambers. The threshold of the gate beside the porch of the gate facing the interior measured one reed.

21601.label: Ezekiel 40:8
21601.text: He measured the porch of the gate toward the interior, and it was one reed.

21602.label: Ezekiel 40:9
21602.text: He then measured the porch of the gate, which was eight cubits; and he measured its side pillars, which were two cubits; and the porch of the gate was on the side facing the interior.

21603.label: Ezekiel 40:10
21603.text: There were three guard chambers on each side of the east gate. The three were the same size, and the side pillars on either side were the same size.

21604.label: Ezekiel 40:11
21604.text: Then he measured the width of the entrance of the gate, which was 10 cubits; and the length of the gate was 13 cubits.

21605.label: Ezekiel 40:12
21605.text: The partitioned area in front of the guard chambers on either side was one cubit. The guard chambers on both sides were six cubits each.

21606.label: Ezekiel 40:13
21606.text: He then measured the gate from the roof of the one guard chamber to the roof of the other, and it was 25 cubits wide; one entrance was across from the other entrance.

21607.label: Ezekiel 40:14
21607.text: Then he measured the side pillars, which were 60 cubits tall, as well as the side pillars in the gates all around the courtyard.

21608.label: Ezekiel 40:15
21608.text: From the front of the entrance of the gate to the front of the porch on the inner side of the gate was 50 cubits.

21609.label: Ezekiel 40:16
21609.text: There were windows with narrowing frames for the guard chambers and for their side pillars inside the gate on each side. The interior of the porches also had windows on each side, and there were palm-tree figures on the side pillars.

21610.label: Ezekiel 40:17
21610.text: He then brought me into the outer courtyard, and I saw dining rooms and a pavement around the courtyard. There were 30 dining rooms on the pavement.

21611.label: Ezekiel 40:18
21611.text: The pavement at the side of the gates corresponded to the length of the gates—this was the lower pavement.

21612.label: Ezekiel 40:19
21612.text: Then he measured the distance from the front of the lower gate to the perimeter of the inner courtyard. It was 100 cubits on the east and on the north.

21613.label: Ezekiel 40:20
21613.text: The outer courtyard had a gate facing north, and he measured its length and its width.

21614.label: Ezekiel 40:21
21614.text: There were three guard chambers on each side. Its side pillars and porch had the same measurements as the first gate. It was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

21615.label: Ezekiel 40:22
21615.text: Its windows, its porch, and its palm-tree figures were the same size as those of the east gate. People could reach it by climbing seven steps, and its porch was in front of them.

21616.label: Ezekiel 40:23
21616.text: There was a gate in the inner courtyard opposite the north gate and one opposite the east gate. He measured the distance from gate to gate, and it was 100 cubits.

21617.label: Ezekiel 40:24
21617.text: Next he brought me toward the south, and I saw a gate on the south side. He measured its side pillars and its porch, and they were the same size as the others.

21618.label: Ezekiel 40:25
21618.text: There were windows on each side of it and its porch, like the other windows. It was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

21619.label: Ezekiel 40:26
21619.text: There were seven steps leading up to it, and its porch was in front of them. And it had palm-tree figures on its side pillars, one on each side.

21620.label: Ezekiel 40:27
21620.text: The inner courtyard had a gate facing south; he measured southward from gate to gate, and the distance was 100 cubits.

21621.label: Ezekiel 40:28
21621.text: Next he brought me into the inner courtyard through the south gate; when he measured the south gate, it was the same size as the others.

21622.label: Ezekiel 40:29
21622.text: Its guard chambers, its side pillars, and its porch were the same size as the others. There were windows on each side of it and its porch. It was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

21623.label: Ezekiel 40:30
21623.text: There were porches all around; they were 25 cubits long and 5 cubits wide.

21624.label: Ezekiel 40:31
21624.text: Its porch faced the outer courtyard, and there were palm-tree figures on its side pillars, and eight steps led up to it.

21625.label: Ezekiel 40:32
21625.text: When he brought me into the inner courtyard from the east, he measured the gate, and it was the same size as the others.

21626.label: Ezekiel 40:33
21626.text: Its guard chambers, its side pillars, and its porch were the same size as the others, and there were windows on each side of it and its porch. It was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

21627.label: Ezekiel 40:34
21627.text: Its porch faced the outer courtyard, and there were palm-tree figures on both of its side pillars, and eight steps led up to it.

21628.label: Ezekiel 40:35
21628.text: He then brought me into the north gate and measured it; it was the same size as the others.

21629.label: Ezekiel 40:36
21629.text: Its guard chambers, its side pillars, and its porch were the same as the others. It had windows on each side. It was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

21630.label: Ezekiel 40:37
21630.text: Its side pillars faced the outer courtyard, and there were palm-tree figures on both of its side pillars, and eight steps led up to it.

21631.label: Ezekiel 40:38
21631.text: A dining room with its entrance was near the side pillars of the gates, where the whole burnt offerings were washed.

21632.label: Ezekiel 40:39
21632.text: There were two tables on each side of the porch of the gate on which to slaughter the whole burnt offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings.

21633.label: Ezekiel 40:40
21633.text: On the way up to the north gate, there were two tables outside the entrance. There were also two tables on the other side of the porch of the gate.

21634.label: Ezekiel 40:41
21634.text: There were four tables on each side of the gate—eight tables in all—on which the sacrifices were slaughtered.

21635.label: Ezekiel 40:42
21635.text: The four tables for the whole burnt offering were of hewn stone. They were one and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one cubit high. On them were kept the implements used to slaughter the burnt offerings and the sacrifices.

21636.label: Ezekiel 40:43
21636.text: Shelves, one handbreadth wide, were attached all around the interior walls; and the flesh of the gift offerings would be placed on the tables.

21637.label: Ezekiel 40:44
21637.text: Outside the inner gate were the dining rooms for the singers; they were in the inner courtyard near the north gate, facing south. Another dining room was near the east gate, facing north.

21638.label: Ezekiel 40:45
21638.text: He said to me: “This dining room that faces south is for the priests who are responsible for the services in the temple.

21639.label: Ezekiel 40:46
21639.text: The dining room that faces north is for the priests who are responsible for the service of the altar. They are the sons of Zaʹdok, those from the Levites who are assigned to approach Jehovah to minister to him.”

21640.label: Ezekiel 40:47
21640.text: Then he measured the inner courtyard. It was 100 cubits long and 100 cubits wide, foursquare. The altar was in front of the temple.

21641.label: Ezekiel 40:48
21641.text: Then he brought me into the porch of the temple, and he measured the side pillar of the porch, and it was five cubits on one side and five cubits on the other side. The width of the gate was three cubits on one side and three cubits on the other side.

21642.label: Ezekiel 40:49
21642.text: The porch was 20 cubits long and 11 cubits wide. People would reach it by climbing the steps. There were pillars by the side posts, one on each side.

21643.label: Ezekiel 41:1
21643.text: Then he brought me into the outer sanctuary, and he measured the side pillars; they were six cubits wide on one side and six cubits wide on the other side.

21644.label: Ezekiel 41:2
21644.text: The entrance was ten cubits wide, and the sidewalls of the entrance were five cubits on one side and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, which was 40 cubits, and its width, 20 cubits.

21645.label: Ezekiel 41:3
21645.text: He then went inside and measured the side pillar of the entrance, and it was two cubits thick, and the entrance was six cubits wide. The sidewalls of the entrance were seven cubits.

21646.label: Ezekiel 41:4
21646.text: Next he measured the room facing the outer sanctuary, and it was 20 cubits long and 20 cubits wide. And he said to me: “This is the Most Holy.”

21647.label: Ezekiel 41:5
21647.text: Then he measured the wall of the temple, and it was six cubits thick. The side chambers around the temple were four cubits wide.

21648.label: Ezekiel 41:6
21648.text: The side chambers were three stories high, one on top of the other, with 30 chambers on each story. There were ledges around the wall of the temple that served as supports for the side chambers, so that the supports did not go into the wall of the temple itself.

21649.label: Ezekiel 41:7
21649.text: On both sides of the temple was a winding passage that widened as it ascended to the upper chambers. The width increased from story to story as one ascended from the lowest story to the uppermost story by passing through the middle story.

21650.label: Ezekiel 41:8
21650.text: I saw that there was a raised platform all around the temple, and the foundations of the side chambers measured a full reed of six cubits to the corner.

21651.label: Ezekiel 41:9
21651.text: The width of the outside wall of the side chambers was five cubits. There was an open space alongside the structure of the side chambers that was part of the temple.

21652.label: Ezekiel 41:10
21652.text: Between the temple and the dining rooms was an area that was 20 cubits wide on each side.

21653.label: Ezekiel 41:11
21653.text: There was an entrance between the side chambers and the open space on the north side and another entrance on the south side. The width of the open space was five cubits all around.

21654.label: Ezekiel 41:12
21654.text: The building that was on the west facing the open area was 70 cubits wide and 90 cubits long; the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around.

21655.label: Ezekiel 41:13
21655.text: He measured the temple, and it was 100 cubits long. The open area, the building, and its walls were also 100 cubits long.

21656.label: Ezekiel 41:14
21656.text: The width of the front of the temple facing east and the open area was 100 cubits.

21657.label: Ezekiel 41:15
21657.text: He measured the length of the building that faced the open area in the rear, along with its galleries on both sides, and it was 100 cubits. He also measured the outer sanctuary, the inner sanctuary, and the porches of the courtyard,

21658.label: Ezekiel 41:16
21658.text: as well as the thresholds, the windows with narrowing frames, and the galleries that were in those three areas. Near the threshold were wood panels from the floor up to the windows; and the windows were covered.

21659.label: Ezekiel 41:17
21659.text: Measurements were taken above the entrance and in the inner temple and on the outside and on the entire wall all around.

21660.label: Ezekiel 41:18
21660.text: It had carved cherubs and palm-tree figures, with each palm tree between two cherubs, and each cherub had two faces.

21661.label: Ezekiel 41:19
21661.text: The human face was toward the palm tree on one side, and the face of a lion was toward the palm tree on the other side. They were carved this way throughout the entire temple.

21662.label: Ezekiel 41:20
21662.text: From the floor to the area above the entrance were carved cherubs and palm-tree figures on the wall of the sanctuary.

21663.label: Ezekiel 41:21
21663.text: The doorposts of the sanctuary were square. In front of the holy place was something like

21664.label: Ezekiel 41:22
21664.text: a wooden altar that was three cubits high and two cubits long. It had corner posts, and its base and its sides were made of wood. He then said to me: “This is the table that is before Jehovah.”

21665.label: Ezekiel 41:23
21665.text: The outer sanctuary and the holy place each had two doors.

21666.label: Ezekiel 41:24
21666.text: The doors had two swinging leaves, two leaves for each door.

21667.label: Ezekiel 41:25
21667.text: There were carved cherubs and palm-tree figures on the doors of the sanctuary, like those on the walls. There was also a wooden overhang on the front of the porch on the outside.

21668.label: Ezekiel 41:26
21668.text: There were also windows with narrowing frames and palm-tree figures along both sides of the porch, as well as along the side chambers of the temple and the overhangs.

21669.label: Ezekiel 42:1
21669.text: Then he led me to the outer courtyard toward the north. And he brought me to the dining-room block that was next to the open area, north of the adjoining building.

21670.label: Ezekiel 42:2
21670.text: Its length at the north entrance was 100 cubits, and it was 50 cubits wide.

21671.label: Ezekiel 42:3
21671.text: It was located between the inner courtyard, which was 20 cubits wide, and the pavement of the outer courtyard. Its galleries faced each other and were three stories high.

21672.label: Ezekiel 42:4
21672.text: Before the dining rooms was an inner walkway 10 cubits wide and 100 cubits long, and their entrances were to the north.

21673.label: Ezekiel 42:5
21673.text: The upper dining rooms of the building were narrower than those in the lower and middle stories, because the galleries took up more of their space.

21674.label: Ezekiel 42:6
21674.text: For they were three stories high, but they had no pillars like the pillars of the courtyards. That is why more floor space was taken away from them than from the lower and middle stories.

21675.label: Ezekiel 42:7
21675.text: The outer stone wall near the dining rooms toward the outer courtyard that faced the other dining rooms was 50 cubits long.

21676.label: Ezekiel 42:8
21676.text: For the length of the dining rooms that were toward the outer courtyard was 50 cubits, but for those facing the sanctuary, it was 100 cubits.

21677.label: Ezekiel 42:9
21677.text: The dining rooms had an entryway on the east side leading up to them from the outer courtyard.

21678.label: Ezekiel 42:10
21678.text: There were also dining rooms inside the stone wall of the courtyard toward the east, near the open area and the building.

21679.label: Ezekiel 42:11
21679.text: There was a walkway before them like that of the northern dining rooms. They were the same length and width, and they had the same exits and layouts. Their entrances

21680.label: Ezekiel 42:12
21680.text: were like the entrances of the dining rooms that were toward the south. There was an entrance at the beginning of the walkway, before the adjacent stone wall toward the east, where one could enter.

21681.label: Ezekiel 42:13
21681.text: Then he said to me: “The dining rooms of the north and the dining rooms of the south that are next to the open area are the holy dining rooms where the priests who are approaching Jehovah eat the most holy offerings. There they place the most holy offerings, the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering, because the place is holy.

21682.label: Ezekiel 42:14
21682.text: When the priests enter, they should not go out of the holy place to the outer courtyard without first removing the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They will clothe themselves with other garments in order to approach the areas permitted to the people.”

21683.label: Ezekiel 42:15
21683.text: When he finished measuring the inner temple area, he led me out by way of the gate that faces east, and he measured the entire area.

21684.label: Ezekiel 42:16
21684.text: He measured the eastern side with the measuring reed. According to the measuring reed, it was 500 reed lengths from one side to the other.

21685.label: Ezekiel 42:17
21685.text: He measured the northern side, and according to the measuring reed, it was 500 reed lengths.

21686.label: Ezekiel 42:18
21686.text: He measured the southern side, and according to the measuring reed, it was 500 reed lengths.

21687.label: Ezekiel 42:19
21687.text: He went around to the western side. He measured 500 reed lengths with the measuring reed.

21688.label: Ezekiel 42:20
21688.text: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall all around it that was 500 reeds long and 500 reeds wide, to make a division between what is holy and what is for common use.

21689.label: Ezekiel 43:1
21689.text: Then he led me to the gate that is facing east.

21690.label: Ezekiel 43:2
21690.text: There I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east, and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters; and the earth was illuminated by his glory.

21691.label: Ezekiel 43:3
21691.text: What I saw was like the vision I had seen when I came to bring the city to ruin, and it appeared to be like what I had seen near the river Cheʹbar; and I fell with my face to the ground.

21692.label: Ezekiel 43:4
21692.text: Then the glory of Jehovah entered the temple through the gate facing the east.

21693.label: Ezekiel 43:5
21693.text: A spirit then raised me up and brought me into the inner courtyard, and I saw that the temple had become full of the glory of Jehovah.

21694.label: Ezekiel 43:6
21694.text: Then I heard someone speaking to me out of the temple, and the man came and stood beside me.

21695.label: Ezekiel 43:7
21695.text: He said to me: “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place for the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the people of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no longer defile my holy name, they and their kings, by their spiritual prostitution and by the carcasses of their kings at their death.

21696.label: Ezekiel 43:8
21696.text: By putting their threshold next to my threshold and their doorpost beside my doorpost, with only a wall between me and them, they defiled my holy name by the detestable things they did, so I exterminated them in my anger.

21697.label: Ezekiel 43:9
21697.text: Now let them put their spiritual prostitution and the carcasses of their kings far away from me, and I will dwell among them forever.

21698.label: Ezekiel 43:10
21698.text: “As for you, son of man, describe the temple to the house of Israel, so that they will feel ashamed because of their errors, and they should study its plan.

21699.label: Ezekiel 43:11
21699.text: If they feel ashamed of all they have done, you should make known to them the ground plan of the temple, its arrangement, its exits, and its entrances. Show them all its ground plans and its statutes, its ground plans and its laws, and write them down before their eyes, so that they may observe all its ground plan and carry out its statutes.

21700.label: Ezekiel 43:12
21700.text: This is the law of the temple. The entire territory all around the top of the mountain is most holy. Look! This is the law of the temple.

21701.label: Ezekiel 43:13
21701.text: “These are the measurements of the altar in cubits (to each cubit a handbreadth was added). Its base is a cubit, and it is a cubit wide. It has a border all around the edge that is one span in width. This is the base of the altar.

21702.label: Ezekiel 43:14
21702.text: From the base on the floor to the lower surrounding ledge is two cubits, and its width is one cubit. From the small surrounding ledge to the big surrounding ledge is four cubits, and its width is a cubit.

21703.label: Ezekiel 43:15
21703.text: The altar hearth is four cubits high, and projecting up from the altar hearth are the four horns.

21704.label: Ezekiel 43:16
21704.text: The altar hearth is square, 12 cubits long and 12 cubits wide.

21705.label: Ezekiel 43:17
21705.text: The four sides of the surrounding ledge are 14 cubits long and 14 cubits wide; and the surrounding border is half a cubit, and its base is a cubit on all sides. “And its steps are facing east.”

21706.label: Ezekiel 43:18
21706.text: He then said to me, “Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘These are the directions to follow when the altar is made, so that whole burnt offerings may be offered and blood may be sprinkled on it.’

21707.label: Ezekiel 43:19
21707.text: “‘You are to give a young bull of the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests of the offspring of Zaʹdok, who approach me to minister to me,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21708.label: Ezekiel 43:20
21708.text: ‘You should take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the surrounding ledge, and on the border all around, in order to purify it from sin and to make atonement for it.

21709.label: Ezekiel 43:21
21709.text: Then take the young bull, the sin offering, in order to burn it in the appointed place of the temple, outside the sanctuary.

21710.label: Ezekiel 43:22
21710.text: On the second day you will offer a sound male goat as a sin offering; and they will purify the altar from sin just as they purified it from sin with the young bull.’

21711.label: Ezekiel 43:23
21711.text: “‘When you finish purifying it from sin, you will offer a sound young bull of the herd and a sound ram from the flock.

21712.label: Ezekiel 43:24
21712.text: You are to present them to Jehovah, and the priests must throw salt on them and offer them up as a whole burnt offering to Jehovah.

21713.label: Ezekiel 43:25
21713.text: For seven days you will offer a male goat as a daily sin offering, as well as a young bull of the herd and a ram of the flock; you will offer unblemished animals.

21714.label: Ezekiel 43:26
21714.text: For seven days they are to make atonement for the altar, and they must cleanse it and install it.

21715.label: Ezekiel 43:27
21715.text: When the days are completed, on the eighth day and thereafter, the priests will offer your whole burnt offerings and communion sacrifices on the altar; and I will find pleasure in you,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21716.label: Ezekiel 44:1
21716.text: He brought me back by way of the outer gate of the sanctuary facing east, and it was shut.

21717.label: Ezekiel 44:2
21717.text: Then Jehovah said to me: “This gate will remain shut. It is not to be opened, and no human will enter by it; for Jehovah, the God of Israel, has entered through it, so it must remain shut.

21718.label: Ezekiel 44:3
21718.text: However, the chieftain will sit in it to eat bread before Jehovah, for he is a chieftain. He will come in through the porch of the gate, and he will go out through it.”

21719.label: Ezekiel 44:4
21719.text: Then he brought me through the north gate to the front of the temple. When I looked, I saw that the glory of Jehovah had filled the temple of Jehovah. So I fell with my face to the ground.

21720.label: Ezekiel 44:5
21720.text: Then Jehovah said to me: “Son of man, pay attention, watch, and listen carefully to everything I tell you about the statutes and the laws of the temple of Jehovah. Pay close attention to the entryway of the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.

21721.label: Ezekiel 44:6
21721.text: You must say to the rebellious house of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “That is enough of your detestable practices, O house of Israel.

21722.label: Ezekiel 44:7
21722.text: When you bring foreigners who are uncircumcised in heart and flesh into my sanctuary, they profane my temple. You present my bread, fat and blood, while my covenant is being broken because of all your detestable practices.

21723.label: Ezekiel 44:8
21723.text: You have not taken care of my holy things. Instead, you assign others to take care of the duties in my sanctuary.”’

21724.label: Ezekiel 44:9
21724.text: “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “No foreigner living in Israel who is uncircumcised in heart and in flesh may enter my sanctuary.”’

21725.label: Ezekiel 44:10
21725.text: “‘But the Levites who strayed far from me when Israel strayed from me to follow their disgusting idols will bear the consequences of their error.

21726.label: Ezekiel 44:11
21726.text: And they will become ministers in my sanctuary to oversee the gates of the temple and to minister at the temple. They will slaughter the whole burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they will stand before the people to minister to them.

21727.label: Ezekiel 44:12
21727.text: Because they ministered to them before their disgusting idols and became a stumbling block causing the house of Israel to sin, that is why I have raised my hand against them in an oath,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘and they will bear the consequences of their error.

21728.label: Ezekiel 44:13
21728.text: They will not approach me to serve as my priests or approach any of my holy or most holy things, and they will bear their shame because of the detestable things that they did.

21729.label: Ezekiel 44:14
21729.text: But I will make them caretakers of the responsibilities of the temple, to take care of its service and all the things that should be done in it.’

21730.label: Ezekiel 44:15
21730.text: “‘As for the Levitical priests, the sons of Zaʹdok, who took care of the responsibilities of my sanctuary when the Israelites strayed from me, they will approach me to minister to me, and they will stand before me to offer me the fat and the blood,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21731.label: Ezekiel 44:16
21731.text: ‘They are the ones who will enter my sanctuary, and they will approach my table to minister to me, and they will take care of their responsibilities to me.

21732.label: Ezekiel 44:17
21732.text: “‘When they come into the gates of the inner courtyard, they should wear linen garments. They should not wear any wool when they minister in the gates of the inner courtyard or inside it.

21733.label: Ezekiel 44:18
21733.text: They should wear linen turbans on their head, and linen shorts should cover their hips. They should not wear anything that makes them perspire.

21734.label: Ezekiel 44:19
21734.text: Before they go out to the outer courtyard—the outer courtyard where the people are—they should remove the garments they were ministering in and place them in the holy dining rooms. Then they will put on other garments, so that they will not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.

21735.label: Ezekiel 44:20
21735.text: They should not shave their head or let the hair of their head grow long. They should trim the hair of their heads.

21736.label: Ezekiel 44:21
21736.text: The priests should not drink wine when they enter the inner courtyard.

21737.label: Ezekiel 44:22
21737.text: They should not take a widow or a divorced woman as a wife; but they may marry either a virgin of the offspring of Israel or the widow of a priest.’

21738.label: Ezekiel 44:23
21738.text: “‘They should instruct my people about the difference between what is holy and what is common; and they will teach them the difference between what is unclean and what is clean.

21739.label: Ezekiel 44:24
21739.text: They should preside as judges in a legal case; they must judge it in harmony with my judicial decisions. They should keep my laws and my statutes regarding all my festivals and sanctify my sabbaths.

21740.label: Ezekiel 44:25
21740.text: They should not approach any dead human, or they will become unclean. However, they may make themselves unclean for their father, mother, son, daughter, brother, or an unmarried sister.

21741.label: Ezekiel 44:26
21741.text: And after the purification of a priest, they should count off seven days for him.

21742.label: Ezekiel 44:27
21742.text: On the day he enters into the holy place, into the inner courtyard, to minister in the holy place, he should present his sin offering,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21743.label: Ezekiel 44:28
21743.text: “‘And this will be their inheritance: I am their inheritance. You should not give them any possession in Israel, for I am their possession.

21744.label: Ezekiel 44:29
21744.text: They will be the ones to eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering, and every devoted thing in Israel will become theirs.

21745.label: Ezekiel 44:30
21745.text: The choicest of all the first ripe fruits and every sort of contribution from you will belong to the priests. And you should give the firstfruits of your coarse meal to the priest. This will cause a blessing to rest on your households.

21746.label: Ezekiel 44:31
21746.text: The priests should not eat any bird or animal that was found dead or torn to pieces.’

21747.label: Ezekiel 45:1
21747.text: “‘When you allot the land as an inheritance, you should offer as a contribution to Jehovah a holy portion out of the land. Its length should be 25,000 cubits, and its width, 10,000 cubits. Its entire area will be a holy portion.

21748.label: Ezekiel 45:2
21748.text: Within this will be a square lot for the holy place measuring 500 cubits by 500 cubits, and it will have 50 cubits as pastures on each side.

21749.label: Ezekiel 45:3
21749.text: Out of this measurement you should measure the length of 25,000 and the width of 10,000, and within it will be the sanctuary, something most holy.

21750.label: Ezekiel 45:4
21750.text: It will be a holy portion of the land for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who approach to minister to Jehovah. It will be a place for their houses and a sacred place for the sanctuary.

21751.label: Ezekiel 45:5
21751.text: “‘For the Levites, the ministers of the temple, there will be a portion 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide, and they will have 20 dining rooms as a possession.

21752.label: Ezekiel 45:6
21752.text: “‘You should give as the possession of the city an area that is 25,000 cubits long (corresponding to the holy contribution) and 5,000 cubits wide. It will belong to all the house of Israel.

21753.label: Ezekiel 45:7
21753.text: “‘And for the chieftain there will be land on both sides of the holy contribution and of the area allotted to the city. It will be next to the holy contribution and the possession of the city. It will be on the west side and on the east side. Its length from the western boundary to the eastern boundary will correspond to one of the tribal portions.

21754.label: Ezekiel 45:8
21754.text: This land will become his possession in Israel. My chieftains will no longer mistreat my people, and they will give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.’

21755.label: Ezekiel 45:9
21755.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘You have gone far enough, chieftains of Israel!’ “‘Put an end to your violence and oppression, and do what is just and righteous. Stop seizing the property of my people,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21756.label: Ezekiel 45:10
21756.text: ‘You should use accurate scales, an accurate eʹphah measure and an accurate bath measure.

21757.label: Ezekiel 45:11
21757.text: There should be a fixed measurement for the eʹphah measure and the bath measure. The bath measure should hold a tenth of a hoʹmer, and the eʹphah measure should hold a tenth of a hoʹmer. The hoʹmer will be the standard for measuring.

21758.label: Ezekiel 45:12
21758.text: The shekel is to be 20 geʹrahs. And 20 shekels plus 25 shekels plus 15 shekels will make up one maʹneh for you.’

21759.label: Ezekiel 45:13
21759.text: “‘This is the contribution that you should offer: one sixth of an eʹphah from each hoʹmer of wheat and one sixth of an eʹphah from each hoʹmer of barley.

21760.label: Ezekiel 45:14
21760.text: The allowance of the oil is to be based on the bath measure. The bath is a tenth of a cor, and ten baths are a hoʹmer, for ten baths equal a hoʹmer.

21761.label: Ezekiel 45:15
21761.text: And from the flock of the livestock of Israel, one sheep out of every 200 should be given. These will be for the grain offering, the whole burnt offering, and the communion sacrifices, in order to make atonement for the people,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21762.label: Ezekiel 45:16
21762.text: “‘All the people of the land will make this contribution to the chieftain in Israel.

21763.label: Ezekiel 45:17
21763.text: But the chieftain will be responsible for the whole burnt offerings, the grain offering, and the drink offering during the festivals, the new moons, the Sabbaths, and all the designated festivals of the house of Israel. He will be the one to provide the sin offering, the grain offering, the whole burnt offering, and the communion sacrifices, in order to make atonement in behalf of the house of Israel.’

21764.label: Ezekiel 45:18
21764.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘In the first month, on the first day of the month, you should take a sound young bull of the herd, and you are to purify the sanctuary from sin.

21765.label: Ezekiel 45:19
21765.text: The priest will take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorpost of the temple, on the four corners of the surrounding ledge of the altar, and on the doorpost of the gate of the inner courtyard.

21766.label: Ezekiel 45:20
21766.text: That is what you will do on the seventh day of the month because of anyone who sins by mistake or through ignorance; and you are to make atonement for the temple.

21767.label: Ezekiel 45:21
21767.text: “‘In the first month, on the 14th day of the month, you will observe the festival of the Passover. For seven days unleavened bread should be eaten.

21768.label: Ezekiel 45:22
21768.text: On that day the chieftain will provide a young bull as a sin offering in his own behalf and in behalf of all the people of the land.

21769.label: Ezekiel 45:23
21769.text: For the seven days of the festival he will provide as a whole burnt offering to Jehovah seven sound young bulls and seven sound rams each of the seven days, as well as a male goat each day as a sin offering.

21770.label: Ezekiel 45:24
21770.text: He should also provide as a grain offering an eʹphah for each young bull and an eʹphah for each ram, as well as a hin of oil for each eʹphah.

21771.label: Ezekiel 45:25
21771.text: “‘In the seventh month, on the 15th day of the month, for seven days during the festival, he should provide the same sin offering, whole burnt offering, grain offering, and oil.’”

21772.label: Ezekiel 46:1
21772.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘The gate of the inner courtyard that is facing east should remain shut for the six workdays, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the new moon it should be opened.

21773.label: Ezekiel 46:2
21773.text: The chieftain will enter from outside by way of the porch of the gate, and he will stand by the doorpost of the gate. The priests will offer his whole burnt offering and his communion sacrifices, and he will bow down at the threshold of the gate and then go out. But the gate should not be shut until the evening.

21774.label: Ezekiel 46:3
21774.text: The people of the land will also bow down before Jehovah at the entrance of that gate on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

21775.label: Ezekiel 46:4
21775.text: “‘The whole burnt offering that the chieftain will present to Jehovah on the Sabbath day should consist of six sound male lambs and a sound ram.

21776.label: Ezekiel 46:5
