21776.text: The grain offering will be an eʹphah for the ram and whatever he is able to give for the male lambs, along with a hin of oil with each eʹphah.

21777.label: Ezekiel 46:6
21777.text: On the day of the new moon the offering will consist of a sound young bull of the herd, six male lambs, and a ram; they should be sound ones.

21778.label: Ezekiel 46:7
21778.text: He should offer as a grain offering an eʹphah for the young bull, an eʹphah for the ram, and whatever he can afford for the male lambs. And he should offer a hin of oil with each eʹphah.

21779.label: Ezekiel 46:8
21779.text: “‘When the chieftain enters, he should enter by way of the porch of the gate, and he should go out the same way.

21780.label: Ezekiel 46:9
21780.text: And when the people of the land come in before Jehovah during the festivals, those who come in to worship through the north gate should go out through the south gate, and those who come in through the south gate should go out through the north gate. No one should go back by way of the gate through which he entered, for they should exit through the gate that is opposite them.

21781.label: Ezekiel 46:10
21781.text: As for the chieftain who is among them, he should come in when they come in, and he should go out when they go out.

21782.label: Ezekiel 46:11
21782.text: During the festivals and the festal seasons the grain offering should be an eʹphah for the young bull, an eʹphah for the ram, and whatever he is able to give for the male lambs, along with a hin of oil with each eʹphah.

21783.label: Ezekiel 46:12
21783.text: “‘If the chieftain provides a whole burnt offering or communion sacrifices as a voluntary offering to Jehovah, the gate facing east will be opened for him, and he will provide his whole burnt offering and his communion sacrifices just as he does on the Sabbath day. After he goes out, the gate should be shut behind him.

21784.label: Ezekiel 46:13
21784.text: “‘Each day you should provide a sound male lamb in its first year as a whole burnt offering to Jehovah. You should do this morning by morning.

21785.label: Ezekiel 46:14
21785.text: Along with it, each morning you should provide a sixth of an eʹphah as a grain offering, along with a third of a hin of oil for sprinkling on the fine flour as a regular grain offering to Jehovah. This is a lasting statute.

21786.label: Ezekiel 46:15
21786.text: They must provide the male lamb, the grain offering, and the oil each morning as a regular whole burnt offering.’

21787.label: Ezekiel 46:16
21787.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: ‘If the chieftain gives a gift to each one of his sons as an inheritance, it will become the property of his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.

21788.label: Ezekiel 46:17
21788.text: But if he gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it will be his until the year of liberty; and then it will return to the chieftain. Only the inheritance of his sons will be permanently theirs.

21789.label: Ezekiel 46:18
21789.text: The chieftain should not take any of the inheritance of the people by forcing them off their property. He should give his sons an inheritance from his own property, so that no one among my people may be driven from his property.’”

21790.label: Ezekiel 46:19
21790.text: Then he brought me in by the entryway that was beside the gate leading to the holy dining rooms of the priests, which faced north, and there I saw a place at the rear toward the west.

21791.label: Ezekiel 46:20
21791.text: He said to me: “This is the place where the priests will boil the guilt offering and the sin offering and where they will bake the grain offering, so that they will not carry anything out to the outer courtyard and transmit holiness to the people.”

21792.label: Ezekiel 46:21
21792.text: He brought me out to the outer courtyard and led me past the four corners of the courtyard, and I saw a courtyard by each corner of the outer courtyard.

21793.label: Ezekiel 46:22
21793.text: At the four corners of the courtyard were small courtyards, 40 cubits long and 30 cubits wide. All four of them were the same size.

21794.label: Ezekiel 46:23
21794.text: There were ledges all around the four of them, and beneath the ledges were built places to boil the offerings.

21795.label: Ezekiel 46:24
21795.text: Then he said to me: “These are the houses where the ministers of the temple boil the sacrifice of the people.”

21796.label: Ezekiel 47:1
21796.text: Then he brought me back to the entrance of the temple, and there I saw water flowing eastward from under the threshold of the temple, for the front of the temple was facing east. The water was flowing down from under the right side of the temple, south of the altar.

21797.label: Ezekiel 47:2
21797.text: He then led me out by way of the north gate and took me outside and around to the outer gate that is facing east, and I saw water trickling from the right side.

21798.label: Ezekiel 47:3
21798.text: When the man went out toward the east with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off 1,000 cubits and had me pass through the water; the water was ankle deep.

21799.label: Ezekiel 47:4
21799.text: Then he measured off another 1,000 and had me pass through the water, and it was up to the knees. He measured off another 1,000 and had me pass through, and the water was up to the hips.

21800.label: Ezekiel 47:5
21800.text: When he measured off another 1,000, it was a torrent that I was unable to walk across, for the water was so deep that one had to swim, a torrent of water that could not be crossed on foot.

21801.label: Ezekiel 47:6
21801.text: He asked me: “Have you seen this, son of man?” Then he had me walk and return to the bank of the stream.

21802.label: Ezekiel 47:7
21802.text: When I returned, I saw that on the bank of the stream were very many trees on both sides.

21803.label: Ezekiel 47:8
21803.text: Then he said to me: “This water flows toward the eastern region and continues down through the Arʹa·bah and enters the sea. When it enters the sea, the water there will be healed.

21804.label: Ezekiel 47:9
21804.text: Swarms of living creatures will be able to live wherever the waters flow. There will be an abundance of fish, because this water will flow there. The seawater will be healed, and everything will live wherever the stream goes.

21805.label: Ezekiel 47:10
21805.text: “Fishermen will stand beside it from En-gedʹi clear to En-egʹla·im, where there will be a drying yard for dragnets. There will be an abundance of many kinds of fish, like the fish of the Great Sea.

21806.label: Ezekiel 47:11
21806.text: “It will have swampy places and marshy places, and these will not be healed. They will be abandoned to salt.

21807.label: Ezekiel 47:12
21807.text: “All sorts of trees for food will grow on both banks of the stream. Their leaves will not wither; nor will their fruitage fail. Each month they will bear new fruit, because the water for them flows from the sanctuary. Their fruitage will serve as food and their leaves for healing.”

21808.label: Ezekiel 47:13
21808.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “This is the territory that you will assign as the land inheritance of the 12 tribes of Israel, and Joseph will have two portions.

21809.label: Ezekiel 47:14
21809.text: You will inherit it and receive equal shares. I swore to give this land to your forefathers, and now it is assigned to you as an inheritance.

21810.label: Ezekiel 47:15
21810.text: “This is the boundary of the land on the northern side: It goes from the Great Sea by the way to Hethʹlon toward Zeʹdad,

21811.label: Ezekiel 47:16
21811.text: Haʹmath, Be·roʹthah, and Sibʹra·im, which is between the territory of Damascus and the territory of Haʹmath, to Haʹzer-hatʹti·con, which is by the boundary of Ha·u·ranʹ.

21812.label: Ezekiel 47:17
21812.text: So the boundary will run from the sea to Haʹzar-eʹnon, along the boundary of Damascus to the north, and the boundary of Haʹmath. This is the northern border.

21813.label: Ezekiel 47:18
21813.text: “The eastern side runs between Ha·u·ranʹ and Damascus and along the Jordan between Gilʹe·ad and the land of Israel. You should measure from the boundary to the eastern sea. This is the eastern border.

21814.label: Ezekiel 47:19
21814.text: “The southern border will be from Taʹmar to the waters of Merʹi·bath-kaʹdesh, then to the Wadi and to the Great Sea. This is the southern border.

21815.label: Ezekiel 47:20
21815.text: “On the western side is the Great Sea, from the boundary up to a point opposite Leʹbo-haʹmath. This is the western border.”

21816.label: Ezekiel 47:21
21816.text: “You are to apportion this land among yourselves, among the 12 tribes of Israel.

21817.label: Ezekiel 47:22
21817.text: You should distribute it for inheritance among yourselves and to the foreigners residing with you who have had children while living among you; and they will be like native-born Israelites to you. They will receive an inheritance among the tribes of Israel along with you.

21818.label: Ezekiel 47:23
21818.text: You should give the foreign resident an inheritance in the territory of the tribe where he has taken up residence,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21819.label: Ezekiel 48:1
21819.text: “These are the names of the tribes, starting from the northern extremity: Dan’s portion runs along the way of Hethʹlon to Leʹbo-haʹmath to Haʹzar-eʹnan, along the boundary of Damascus northward, beside Haʹmath; and it extends from the eastern to the western border.

21820.label: Ezekiel 48:2
21820.text: Ashʹer’s portion is on the boundary of Dan, from the eastern border to the western border.

21821.label: Ezekiel 48:3
21821.text: Naphʹta·li’s portion is on the boundary of Ashʹer, from the eastern border to the western border.

21822.label: Ezekiel 48:4
21822.text: Ma·nasʹseh’s portion is on the boundary of Naphʹta·li, from the eastern border to the western border.

21823.label: Ezekiel 48:5
21823.text: Eʹphra·im’s portion is on the boundary of Ma·nasʹseh, from the eastern border to the western border.

21824.label: Ezekiel 48:6
21824.text: Reuʹben’s portion is on the boundary of Eʹphra·im, from the eastern border to the western border.

21825.label: Ezekiel 48:7
21825.text: Judah’s portion is on the boundary of Reuʹben, from the eastern border to the western border.

21826.label: Ezekiel 48:8
21826.text: On the boundary of Judah, from the eastern border to the western border, the contribution that you are to set apart should be 25,000 cubits wide and correspond to the length of the other tribal portions from the eastern border to the western border. The sanctuary will be in the middle of it.

21827.label: Ezekiel 48:9
21827.text: “The contribution that you are to set apart to Jehovah will be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 wide.

21828.label: Ezekiel 48:10
21828.text: This will be the holy contribution for the priests. It will be 25,000 cubits on the north side, 10,000 on the west, 10,000 on the east, and 25,000 on the south. The sanctuary of Jehovah will be in the middle of it.

21829.label: Ezekiel 48:11
21829.text: It will be for the sanctified priests from the sons of Zaʹdok, those who took care of their responsibilities toward me and did not go astray when the Israelites and the Levites went astray.

21830.label: Ezekiel 48:12
21830.text: They will have a portion of the contribution of the land set apart as something most holy, on the boundary of the Levites.

21831.label: Ezekiel 48:13
21831.text: “Right next to the territory of the priests, the Levites will have a portion 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 wide. (The whole length will be 25,000 long and 10,000 wide.)

21832.label: Ezekiel 48:14
21832.text: They should not sell, exchange, or transfer any of this choicest portion of the land, for it is something holy to Jehovah.

21833.label: Ezekiel 48:15
21833.text: “The remaining area that is 5,000 cubits wide alongside the 25,000 cubit border will be for common use of the city, for housing and pasture ground. The city will be in the middle of it.

21834.label: Ezekiel 48:16
21834.text: These are the city’s measurements: The northern border is 4,500 cubits, the southern border is 4,500, the eastern border is 4,500, and the western border is 4,500.

21835.label: Ezekiel 48:17
21835.text: The pasture ground of the city will be 250 cubits to the north, 250 to the south, 250 to the east, and 250 to the west.

21836.label: Ezekiel 48:18
21836.text: “The length of the remaining portion will correspond to the holy contribution, 10,000 cubits to the east and 10,000 to the west. It will correspond to the holy contribution, and its produce will provide food for those serving the city.

21837.label: Ezekiel 48:19
21837.text: Those who are serving the city from all the tribes of Israel will cultivate it.

21838.label: Ezekiel 48:20
21838.text: “The whole contribution is 25,000 cubits square. You should set it aside as the holy contribution along with the possession of the city.

21839.label: Ezekiel 48:21
21839.text: “What remains on both sides of the holy contribution and of the possession of the city will belong to the chieftain. It will be alongside the 25,000 cubit borders that are east and west of the contribution. It will correspond to those adjoining portions, and it will be for the chieftain. The holy contribution and the sanctuary of the temple will be in the middle of it.

21840.label: Ezekiel 48:22
21840.text: “The possession of the Levites and the possession of the city will be between what belongs to the chieftain. The chieftain’s territory will be between the boundary of Judah and the boundary of Benjamin.

21841.label: Ezekiel 48:23
21841.text: “As for the remaining tribes, Benjamin’s portion is from the eastern border to the western border.

21842.label: Ezekiel 48:24
21842.text: Simʹe·on’s portion is by the boundary of Benjamin, from the eastern border to the western border.

21843.label: Ezekiel 48:25
21843.text: Isʹsa·char’s portion is by the boundary of Simʹe·on, from the eastern border to the western border.

21844.label: Ezekiel 48:26
21844.text: Zebʹu·lun’s portion is by the boundary of Isʹsa·char, from the eastern border to the western border.

21845.label: Ezekiel 48:27
21845.text: Gad’s portion is by the boundary of Zebʹu·lun, from the eastern border to the western border.

21846.label: Ezekiel 48:28
21846.text: The southern border by the boundary of Gad will run from Taʹmar to the waters of Merʹi·bath-kaʹdesh, to the Wadi and on to the Great Sea.

21847.label: Ezekiel 48:29
21847.text: “This is the land that you should distribute as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21848.label: Ezekiel 48:30
21848.text: “These will be the exits of the city: The northern side will measure 4,500 cubits.

21849.label: Ezekiel 48:31
21849.text: “The gates of the city will be named according to the tribes of Israel. Of the three gates on the north, there is one gate for Reuʹben, one gate for Judah, and one gate for Leʹvi.

21850.label: Ezekiel 48:32
21850.text: “The eastern side will be 4,500 cubits long, and there are three gates: one gate for Joseph, one gate for Benjamin, and one gate for Dan.

21851.label: Ezekiel 48:33
21851.text: “The southern side will measure 4,500 cubits, with three gates: one gate for Simʹe·on, one gate for Isʹsa·char, and one gate for Zebʹu·lun.

21852.label: Ezekiel 48:34
21852.text: “The western side will be 4,500 cubits long, with three gates: one gate for Gad, one gate for Ashʹer, and one gate for Naphʹta·li.

21853.label: Ezekiel 48:35
21853.text: “The perimeter will be 18,000 cubits. And the name of the city from that day on will be Jehovah Is There.”
